EMAIL INFRASTRUCTURE

Step-by-Step Mailgun Setup: Namecheap Domain Setup

Sign up for Mailgun, add your domain, and publish the TXT, MX, and CNAME records in Namecheap so your emails verify and deliver.

What You'll Learn

This guide covers creating a Mailgun account, adding a sending domain, choosing between a main domain and a subdomain, and publishing the 5 required DNS records — 2 TXT, 2 MX, and 1 CNAME — inside Namecheap's Advanced DNS settings.

## Sign Up for Mailgun

Create your account at [Mailgun.com](https://signup.mailgun.com/new/signup).

## Verify Your Email Address

Check your email inbox to verify the email address you signed up with.

![Mailgun signup confirmation screen](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284378416/original/VewuZVN3oFOFIvBdf4XqMAOX4vtVGv_jNg.png?1677630998)
![Email verification confirmation screen](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284378421/original/GU6IL6Y3N81qm6KMH9aTz7l5FV5IEv7ySA.png?1677630999)

## Add a New Domain in Mailgun

Log in to Mailgun and click **Sending → Add New Domain**.

![Sending menu with Add New Domain option in Mailgun](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284378418/original/kxsnymCeuFAsBWkXaOes6QaaWED2_bfASA.png?1677630999)

## Choose a Main Domain or Subdomain

If your domain is **companyname.com**, you can set up either the main domain or a subdomain with Mailgun.

Option A

Main Domain

If you add the main domain, [it should not be used with Google Workspace or any other email provider](https://help.mailgun.com/hc/en-us/articles/203357040-Can-I-Use-the-Same-Domain-Name-for-Mailgun-and-for-Google-Apps-Or-Another-Email-Server-).

Option B

Subdomain

To set up a subdomain with Mailgun, you can type **anything\_here.companyname.com**. Examples:

- mg.companyname.com
- replies.companyname.com
- support.companyname.com

Note

Set up the domain or subdomain under the **US** region, not EU. Then click **Add domain**.

![Add domain form in Mailgun with US region selected](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284382652/original/woVjMqNw3YY_Zjs20LoBHUb4KrThVvj_Rw.png?1677635102)

Setup Guide

Now let's publish 5 DNS records in Namecheap

2 TXT records, 2 MX records, and 1 CNAME record — follow each sub-step carefully.

## Add Your DNS Records in Namecheap

Log in to [Namecheap.com](https://www.namecheap.com/myaccount/login/), then click **Domain List → Manage**.

![Namecheap Domain List with Manage button](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284379162/original/ZFfDWZRqEj2vF1mZu2LLamthayVacfWNdQ.png?1677631852)

Click **Advanced DNS** — this is where we'll add all 5 DNS records.

![Namecheap Advanced DNS tab](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284379194/original/lbM_9qwxdQuZYJgoO8k_Bbs6207ECEULCA.png?1677631892)

DNS Record 1 of 5

To Add the 1st TXT Record

Click **Add New Record**.

![Add New Record button in Namecheap Advanced DNS](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284379255/original/z9t88DrLLsk_x-5McqcmUoQay6Rtpl-3JA.png?1677631962)

Select **TXT Record** from the dropdown.

![TXT Record selected in record type dropdown](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284379274/original/XZhGADHABEyG3gpE2kfSb4glLSsGZ7X29g.png?1677631986)
![TXT record row in Namecheap DNS table](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284379750/original/afOhZ_mYDjiPnMtdsXB_BaUvpK7-fBAbEg.png?1677632454)

**A. Host:** depending on the subdomain you're setting up:

- mg.companyname.com → host name is mg
- replies.companyname.com → host name is replies
- Main domain (companyname.com) → host name is @

**B. Value:** head back to Mailgun and copy the first TXT record — it will look like v=spf1 include:mailgun.org ~all — and paste it here.

![TXT record value field with SPF record pasted](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284379641/original/OtndbakIxEwGec0uzyy6VhrQ9ahdwqWR4g.png?1677632355)

**C.** Click the green check to save.

DNS Record 2 of 5

To Add the 2nd TXT Record

Click **Add New Record** again, and select **TXT Record** from the dropdown.

![Add New Record button for the second TXT record](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284380045/original/p3EI2E6cXdPA44wNy1dlbvL9SeMlPsN_pg.png?1677632706)
![TXT Record type selected for the second record](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284380093/original/ymsCp1tf0vOpw8jh_ELv1eyAHoFR08klKA.png?1677632745)
![Second TXT record row in Namecheap DNS table](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284380135/original/h15o-HQi5ZlCUWfi23NsIp_ULoUljPMbDw.png?1677632789)

**A. Host:** this one is a bit tricky — copy everything from the beginning until the subdomain part. **Do not copy the main domain.**

![Mailgun host value highlighted up to the subdomain](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284379962/original/S6JIQJ-twEQMWBwUw7Do7908kLEMK8w9gg.png?1677632628)

Examples — copy the highlighted part:

| Scenario | Screenshot |
| --- | --- |
| Using a subdomain | Example host value when using a subdomain |
| Using the main domain | Example host value when using the main domain |

**B. Value:** paste the second, longer TXT record from Mailgun here.

![Second TXT record value pasted into Namecheap](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284380189/original/a5LTwyG6FV_Hp-L232_fAj2g1VUUDlSyPw.png?1677632888)

**C.** Click the green check to save.

DNS Record 3 of 5

To Add the 1st MX Record

Scroll down to **Mail Settings** and switch the dropdown to **Custom MX**.

![Mail Settings dropdown switched to Custom MX](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284380651/original/s-vIse48Y60uv4ODRMU02N4qsPS5I5uYeg.png?1677633315)

Heads Up

Switching to Custom MX will affect your existing Google Workspace account for incoming mail on the main domain if Gmail was originally selected. Make sure you're using a subdomain for Mailgun. See [Can I Use the Same Domain Name for Mailgun and for Google Apps (Or Another Email Server)?](https://help.mailgun.com/hc/en-us/articles/203357040-Can-I-Use-the-Same-Domain-Name-for-Mailgun-and-for-Google-Apps-Or-Another-Email-Server-)

You'll need to add back the **5** [MX records for Google Gmail](https://support.google.com/a/answer/140034?hl=en):

| Host | TTL | Priority | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ | 3600 | 1 | ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM |
| @ | 3600 | 5 | ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM |
| @ | 3600 | 5 | ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM |
| @ | 3600 | 10 | ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM |
| @ | 3600 | 10 | ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM |

Once all **five** MX records above are added back, add the Mailgun MX record. Click **Add New Record**.

![Add New Record button for the first MX record](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284381008/original/Hvcyh4kYnFgfuL6SKPnyDNBFReckD-0qqg.png?1677633693)
![MX record row being configured in Namecheap](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284380997/original/nSuGvsypPVy3uastd0-zS4Dpu71FC2figA.png?1677633659)

**A. Host:** depending on the subdomain you're setting up:

- mg.companyname.com → host name is mg
- replies.companyname.com → host name is replies
- Main domain (companyname.com) → host name is @

**B. Value:** mxa.mailgun.org

**C. Priority:** 10

**D.** Click the green check to save.

![First MX record saved in Namecheap](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284381240/original/2nrnlf9BwTPbv5cKXKZS8QStDqfFbqz-7w.png?1677633916)

DNS Record 4 of 5

To Add the 2nd MX Record

**A. Host:** depending on the subdomain you're setting up:

- mg.companyname.com → host name is mg
- replies.companyname.com → host name is replies
- Main domain (companyname.com) → host name is @

**B. Value:** mxb.mailgun.org

**C. Priority:** 10

**D.** Click the green check to save.

![Second MX record saved in Namecheap](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284381184/original/wao3EJjnKT5qAO1wn_ZxZqBdEusgs_E8Qw.png?1677633856)

DNS Record 5 of 5

To Add the CNAME Record

Scroll back up to the **Host Records** section and click **Add New Record**.

![Add New Record button for the CNAME record](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284381639/original/UJxPcf-rUHX7AwbK1pwp4kMH-N9VjEx62w.png?1677634175)

Select **CNAME Record** from the dropdown.

![CNAME Record selected in record type dropdown](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284381737/original/kaXoDz-tFmwEhnhJ-NOwZcvVlkk_b8I-bg.png?1677634268)

Head back to Mailgun to copy the host name — copy everything from the beginning until the subdomain part. **Do not copy the main domain.**

![Mailgun CNAME host value to copy](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284382024/original/SKui5c_vVTAOKtN714Bl9mx8OdjgxebDSA.png?1677634552)

Go back to Namecheap:

![Namecheap CNAME record row](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284381724/original/zDKUjwzlyWytyho6PuhbQEvKuqGiKzYypQ.png?1677634245)

**A. Host:** depending on the subdomain you're setting up:

- mg.companyname.com → host name is email.mg
- replies.companyname.com → host name is email.replies
- Main domain (companyname.com) → host name is email

**B. Value:** mailgun.org

**C.** Click the green check to save.

Now that all 5 records have been added, go back to Mailgun and click **Verify DNS Settings**. Click the same button again if some records still aren't showing a green checkmark.

![Mailgun Verify DNS Settings results](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48284382101/original/PQecmA9d0ihGiF3VchOhZL1VKMrOZmUvDQ.png?1677634628)

## Get Your API Key & Send a Test Email

Once all the DNS records are added and verified, grab your key from [Mailgun API Key: Where to Find It in Mailgun and Add It to the Platform](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000981682).

You're Almost Done

Send a test email to confirm everything works. See [How to Send a Test Email in the Conversation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001208887) for the steps.

Video Recap

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/783af06c11d147b4b238f11022ba7c9b)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Will switching to Custom MX break my existing Gmail or Google Workspace email?

It can, if you're adding the MX records to your main domain and it's already used with Google Workspace. Re-add all 5 Google MX records alongside the Mailgun ones, and consider using a subdomain instead to avoid the risk entirely.

Q: What's the difference between the "Host" value for the TXT/MX records and the CNAME record?

For TXT and MX records, the host is just your subdomain (e.g. "mg"). For the CNAME record, Namecheap expects "email.mg" — the tracking subdomain Mailgun uses for click and open tracking.

Q: My records aren't showing a green checkmark after verifying — what should I do?

DNS changes can take time to propagate. Double-check each host and value against what Mailgun shows, then click Verify DNS Settings again after a few minutes.

Q: Why do I need two separate TXT records?

The first TXT record is your SPF record, which authorizes Mailgun to send on your behalf. The second, longer TXT record is your DKIM key, which cryptographically signs your outgoing mail.

Q: Do I need to copy the exact values shown in this guide, or the ones from my own Mailgun account?

Always copy the exact host and value strings shown in your own Mailgun dashboard — the mxa.mailgun.org and mxb.mailgun.org values are standard, but your TXT record values are unique to your domain.

Q: Can I use this same process for a domain provider other than Namecheap?

The record types and values are the same everywhere, but the interface for adding them differs by provider. Check the related provider-specific setup guides below.

title_en: What is the Graphic Library
source_md:
The Graphic Library in HighLevel lets you easily add icons, emojis, and illustrations to your funnels, websites, stores, and webinar pages. With over 11,000 icons and emojis, customizable icon colors, and AI-generated illustrations, you can create visually engaging designs without relying on external tools. This article covers how to access the Graphic Library, explore its features, and add graphics to your pages.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Graphic Library in HighLevel?](#What-is-the-Graphic-Library-in-HighLevel?)
- [Key Benefits of the Graphic Library](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Graphic-Library)
- [Icons in the Graphic Library](#Icons-in-the-Graphic-Library)
- [Emojis in the Graphic Library](#Emojis-in-the-Graphic-Library)
- [Illustrations in the Graphic Library](#Illustrations-in-the-Graphic-Library)
- [Using Icons in Buttons and Text Elements](#Using-Icons-in-Buttons-and-Text-Elements)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is the Graphic Library in HighLevel?**

The Graphic Library in HighLevel makes it easy to add icons, emojis, and illustrations directly to your funnels, websites, stores, and webinar pages. With over 11,000 icons and emojis available, you can search, browse categories, and customize icon colors without leaving the builder. You can also create unique illustrations using AI or upload your own graphics to personalize your designs. This helps you build visually engaging pages while reducing the need for third-party design tools.

The Graphic Library is a built-in collection of visual assets available through the **Icons & Graphics** panel in supported HighLevel builders. Instead of searching external websites for graphics, you can find and insert visual elements directly into your page.

The library includes three main types of graphics:

- **Icons:** Add visual symbols to highlight features, communicate ideas, or complement page content.
- **Emojis:** Make headings, messages, and other content more expressive with familiar visual characters.
- **Illustrations:** Enhance your designs using built-in artwork, AI-generated illustrations, or graphics uploaded from your device.

Graphics can be added directly to the canvas, and icons can also be used within supported text and button elements.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083539333/original/67i6vQmRFazQ_RFd4qhG1KRvS56sFiHXnw.png?1792166723)**

---

## **Key Benefits of the Graphic Library**

Using the Graphic Library helps you create more visually appealing pages without interrupting your workflow. Its built-in collection and customization capabilities make it easier to find graphics that suit your content and maintain consistent designs across your pages.

- **Access Thousands of Graphics:** Choose from more than 11,000 icons and emojis directly within HighLevel.
- **Save Time Designing Pages:** Find and insert graphics without searching external websites or manually importing every asset.
- **Maintain Brand Consistency:** Customize icon colors to complement your website or funnel design.
- **Find Graphics Faster:** Search for specific icons and emojis or explore organized categories.
- **Create Custom Illustrations with AI:** Generate illustrations when the available artwork does not match your needs.
- **Use Your Own Graphics:** Upload custom illustrations to personalize your pages.
- **Enhance Text and Buttons:** Add icons within headings, paragraphs, and supported buttons to make content easier to recognize and navigate.

---

## **Icons in the Graphic Library**

Icons are visual symbols that help communicate information quickly, highlight important content, and guide visitors through a page. The Graphic Library provides a searchable collection of icons that can be added to page designs and customized to match your brand.

### **Browsing and Searching for Icons**

You can explore available icons by category or search for a specific graphic using keywords.

1. Open the **Icons & Graphics** panel from the builder's (sites or funnels or email or any builder) left sidebar.
2. Select the **Icons** tab.
3. Browse the available icon categories.
4. Use the **Search** field to find a specific icon.
5. Select an icon to add it to your page, or drag it directly onto the canvas.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083546972/original/-Z4P7AfXMV4BCnWmOq-qEN70u7S48JL19g.png?1792173018)**

### **Customizing Icon Colors**

Icon colors can be adjusted to complement your page's visual design. This is particularly useful when you want icons to match your brand colors, buttons, or other page elements.

To select an icon color:

1. Open the **Icons** tab in the Graphic Library.
2. Locate the **Icon Color** option.
3. Choose your preferred color using the available color selector.
4. Select the icon you want to add to your page.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083547051/original/_Bbq8hHwLI4bIaQ00aRc-4rpRdxTGwVj-g.png?1792173092)**

---

## **Emojis in the Graphic Library**

Emojis can make page content more expressive and help emphasize messages, headings, and other important information. With emojis available directly inside the Graphic Library, you can add familiar visual characters without switching to another application.

To add an emoji:

1. Open **Icons & Graphics** from the builder's left sidebar.
2. Select the **Emoji** tab.
3. Browse the available emojis or use the search field to find one.
4. Click or drag your chosen emoji onto the canvas.

Emojis can be useful for highlighting announcements, drawing attention to offers, and adding personality to page content.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083547148/original/jA1Xg57ksg-wPm2wpZcJbM7x49itM6Qpxg.png?1792173191)**

---

## **Illustrations in the Graphic Library**

Illustrations help communicate concepts, support your page's message, and add visual interest to your designs. The Graphic Library provides built-in illustrations while also allowing you to generate new artwork with AI or upload your own illustrations when you need something more specific.

### **Using Built-In Illustrations**

Built-in illustrations provide ready-to-use artwork that can be inserted into your page without creating a graphic from scratch.

1. Open the **Icons & Graphics** panel.
2. Select the **Illustrations** tab.
3. Browse the available illustrations.
4. Choose an illustration that matches your page's content.
5. Click or drag it onto the canvas.

### **Generating Illustrations with AI**

AI illustration generation provides another way to create visual content when the existing library does not contain the artwork you need. You can use the available AI generation functionality to create illustrations tailored to your design requirements.

**To get started:**

1. Open the Graphic Library.
2. Access the illustration generation option using **Generate**.
3. Follow the available AI generation prompts to create your illustration.
4. Review the generated artwork and select the illustration you want to use.
5. Add the illustration to your page.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083547249/original/zjoiSYQXmHHV0LqVVtUAu0trGaWQ7tgKqQ.png?1792173390)**

### **Uploading Your Own Illustrations**

Uploading custom illustrations allows you to use graphics created for your business, brand, or campaign. This is useful when you already have artwork that you want to incorporate into a page.

To upload an illustration:

1. Open **Icons & Graphics**.
2. Navigate to the appropriate illustration or custom graphic upload option.
3. Select the available **Upload** control.
4. Choose a graphic from your device.
5. Once the upload is available, select the graphic to use it in your page.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083547362/original/ENfCWutNnVQESCOOF5OPSpNvNC5iTNrOEg.png?1792173491)**

---

## **Using Icons in Buttons and Text Elements**

Icons are not limited to standalone graphics on the canvas. HighLevel also supports using icons within text and button content, allowing you to combine visual symbols with written information. This can help make calls to action easier to recognize and improve the visual presentation of headings and paragraphs.

### **Adding Icons to Buttons**

Icons can appear at the beginning or end of button text within the supported builder ecosystem.

For example, you can use an arrow icon after **Get Started** or a download icon before **Download Guide** to reinforce the action visitors should take.

### **Adding Icons Within Text**

Icons can also be used inline with supported text elements, including:

- H1 headings
- H2 headings
- Paragraphs
- Other supported text content

This allows you to place icons alongside words rather than using separate graphic elements for every visual symbol.

For example, a feature heading could include a checkmark icon before the text, while a paragraph could use an inline icon to emphasize a particular point.

### **Icons in the New Email Builder**

Inline icon functionality has also been added to the new Email Builder, extending icon usage beyond the original Funnel, Website, Store, and Webinar Builder launch scope.

This helps support more consistent visual content across different HighLevel design experiences.

For additional information about email editing, see [How to Use the Email Builder and Its In-line Editor](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000087).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to use an external website to find icons and emojis?**

No. The Graphic Library includes more than 11,000 icons and emojis that you can access directly within supported HighLevel builders.

**Q: Can I use the Graphic Library to create illustrations that aren't already available?**

Yes. The Graphic Library includes AI illustration generation, allowing you to create artwork when the built-in illustration collection does not meet your needs.

**Q: Can I add icons before or after text inside buttons?**

Yes. Icons can be placed at the beginning or end of button content within supported builders.

**Q: Can icons be added between words in a heading or paragraph?**

Yes. Inline icon functionality supports placing icons within headings, paragraphs, and other supported text content.

**Q: Is the Graphic Library available in the Email Builder?**

Inline icon functionality has been added to the new Email Builder. The availability of the complete Graphic Library, including all illustration and AI generation features, may differ from the original supported page builders.

**Q: Can I upload graphics that I created outside HighLevel?**

Yes. The Graphic Library supports uploading your own illustrations, allowing you to use custom artwork in your designs.

**Q: Is the Graphic Library the same as the Social Icons element?**

No. The Graphic Library provides general-purpose icons, emojis, and illustrations for page design. The Social Icons element is intended for displaying icons that link to social media profiles.

**Q: Are all Graphic Library features automatically available in every HighLevel account?**

Feature availability depends on the product rollout and account access. If the Icons & Graphics option is not visible, the Graphic Library may not yet be enabled for your account.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Social Media Icons](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001313-social-media-icons)
- [How to Use Rich Text Elements in Funnels & Websites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005817-how-to-use-rich-text-elements-in-funnels-websites)
- [How to Use Prebuilt Elements in Your Funnels and Websites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002908)
- [How to Use the Email Builder and Its In-line Editor](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000087)
- [Complete Guide to Media Storage](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002707)
- [Media Storage File Types, Limits & Advanced Features](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001216629-media-storage-file-types-limits-advanced-features)

title_en: Organized Nested Asset Selection for Snapshots
source_md:
The organized nested asset selector gives you a clearer way to review and select Snapshot assets in HighLevel. Instead of viewing assets in one flat list, folders and assets now appear in the same structure used in the source sub-account. This makes it easier to create, refresh, and load Snapshots while reducing the chance of missing related assets.

The updated selector applies to the **Create Snapshot**, **Refresh Snapshot**, and **Load Snapshot** workflows. HighLevel Snapshot documentation confirms that Snapshots help copy reusable account configurations between sub-accounts, create reusable Snapshot templates, refresh updated assets, and load selected assets into existing sub-accounts.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Organized Nested Asset Selection?](#What-is-Organized-Nested-Asset-Selection?)
- [Key Benefits of Organized Nested Asset Selection](#Key-Benefits-of-Organized-Nested-Asset-Selection)
- [Where the Nested Asset Selector Appears](#Where-the-Nested-Asset-Selector-Appears)
- [How Folder Hierarchy Works](#How-Folder-Hierarchy-Works)
- [Smart Folder Selection](#Smart-Folder-Selection)
- [Using the Search Bar with Nested Assets](#Using-the-Search-Bar-with-Nested-Assets)
- [Organized Asset Selection in Create Snapshot](#Organized-Asset-Selection-in-Create-Snapshot)
- [Organized Asset Selection in Refresh Snapshot](#Organized-Asset-Selection-in-Refresh-Snapshot)
- [Organized Asset Selection in Load Snapshot](#Organized-Asset-Selection-in-Load-Snapshot)
- [Linked Assets and Nested Folder Selection](#Linked-Assets-and-Nested-Folder-Selection)
- [How To Setup Organized Nested Asset Selection](#How-To-Setup-Organized-Nested-Asset-Selection)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Organized Nested Asset Selection?**

Organized Nested Asset Selection is the updated Snapshot asset selector that displays folders, sub-folders, and assets in an expandable hierarchy. This layout helps you understand where each asset belongs before including it in a Snapshot action. When folders are shown in their original structure, it becomes easier to keep related assets together and avoid selecting incomplete groups.

With this update, Snapshot assets are grouped under their parent folders instead of being scattered across a flat list. You can expand folders layer by layer, select an entire folder, or choose individual assets inside nested folders.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072594001/original/krFWfS6jXR0jgy2pQLK5f-yfC3hczZiscw.png?1780310133)**

---

## **Key Benefits of Organized Nested Asset Selection**

A folder-based selector gives you more control and visibility when working with Snapshot assets. This is especially helpful when managing large sub-accounts with many workflows, folders, templates, or other assets that need to stay grouped together.

- **Faster Selection:** Select an entire folder and its contents instead of selecting each asset one by one.
- **Cleaner Asset Review:** View assets in their parent folder structure so you can quickly understand how items are organized.
- **Higher Accuracy:** Reduce the risk of missing important assets during Snapshot creation, refresh, or load.
- **Better Folder Visibility:** Expand deeply nested folders to review assets layer by layer.
- **Improved Workflow Confidence:** Keep related assets and sub-folders together when preparing Snapshot actions.
- **Less Manual Tracking:** Avoid relying on external spreadsheets or notes to remember which assets belong to which folder.

---

## **Where the Nested Asset Selector Appears**

The nested asset selector appears during the main Snapshot workflows where users choose which assets should be included or loaded. This gives you a consistent selection experience whether you are creating a new Snapshot, updating an existing Snapshot, or loading Snapshot assets into a sub-account.

The updated asset selector applies to:

- **Create Snapshot:** Select assets from a source sub-account when building a new Snapshot.
- **Refresh Snapshot:** Select assets to update an existing Snapshot with the latest source sub-account changes.
- **Load Snapshot:** Select assets from a Snapshot before loading them into a target sub-account.

HighLevel’s Snapshot articles explain that creating a Snapshot allows reusable sub-account setups to be cloned, refreshing a Snapshot brings in the latest assets, and loading a Snapshot lets users select assets and resolve conflicts before applying them to an existing sub-account.

---

## **How Folder Hierarchy Works**

Folder hierarchy keeps assets grouped under their original folders, making it easier to understand asset relationships before taking action. This is useful when folders contain multiple assets or when folders are nested several levels deep.

The nested layout supports:

- Parent folders
- Sub-folders
- Multiple nested folder levels
- Individual assets inside folders
- Expand and collapse controls
- Asset search
- Product category labels where applicable

Selecting a parent folder selects the assets and sub-folders contained within it. Expanding a folder lets you review or select individual items without losing visibility into where those items belong.

---

## **Smart Folder Selection**

Smart folder selection helps keep related assets together when you select assets for a Snapshot action. This reduces the chance of selecting a folder without also selecting the assets inside it.

When you select a folder:

- Assets inside that folder are selected.
- Sub-folders inside that folder are selected.
- Assets inside nested sub-folders are included.
- You can still expand the folder to review the selected contents.

When you only need specific assets, expand the folder and select the individual items you want to include.

---

## **Using the Search Bar with Nested Assets**

Search helps you quickly locate assets or folders in large Snapshot lists. This is useful when a sub-account contains hundreds or thousands of assets and manually expanding each folder would take too much time.

Use the search bar at the top of the asset selector to find specific assets by name. After finding the asset, review its folder placement before selecting it. This helps confirm that you are choosing the correct asset from the correct folder path.

---

## **Organized Asset Selection in Create Snapshot**

Creating a Snapshot starts with choosing which assets from the source sub-account should be included. The nested selector makes this easier by showing folders and assets in a structured format instead of a flat list.

To use nested asset selection while creating a Snapshot:

1. Go to the Snapshot creation flow in HighLevel.
2. Choose the source sub-account.
3. Open the asset selector.
4. Expand folders to review the assets inside.
5. Select a full folder to include the folder, sub-folders, and assets inside it.
6. Select individual assets if you only need specific items.
7. Continue creating the Snapshot.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072595027/original/8MjTKP0fcdGMJxPRbEr9afcy7pnSguPo2w.png?1780310705)

---

## **Organized Asset Selection in Refresh Snapshot**

Refreshing a Snapshot updates it with changes from the source sub-account. The nested selector helps you choose updated assets more accurately by keeping related assets grouped under their folders.

To use nested asset selection while refreshing a Snapshot:

1. Go to the Snapshot refresh flow.
2. Open the asset selector for the Snapshot being refreshed.
3. Expand the relevant product category or folder.
4. Select the folder if all contained assets should be refreshed.
5. Select individual assets if only specific updates are needed.
6. Review selected assets before refreshing.
7. Click **Refresh**.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072595572/original/bvIr-haXYs1yoESmb8mHBNockXLczT3znQ.png?1780311022)*

---

## **Organized Asset Selection in Load Snapshot**

Loading a Snapshot lets you apply selected Snapshot assets to an existing sub-account. The nested selector helps you review folder structure before proceeding, which is especially useful before conflict checking.

To use nested asset selection while loading a Snapshot:

1. Open the Load Snapshot flow for the target sub-account.
2. Review the available Snapshot assets.
3. Expand folders to inspect nested assets.
4. Select the folder or individual assets you want to load.
5. Review any restricted or unavailable assets if they appear.
6. Proceed to conflict checking when applicable.
7. Continue with the Snapshot load process.

```
Note: Some assets may appear as restricted or unavailable depending on the Snapshot, account permissions, or asset behavior. Confirm restricted asset details before publishing a specific explanation.
```

---

## **Linked Assets and Nested Folder Selection**

Nested folder selection improves how assets are visually grouped and selected, but it does not replace linked asset management. Linked assets are still important when assets depend on other assets to work properly.

Use nested folder selection to choose assets based on folder structure. Use linked asset management to review dependencies or related assets that may need to be included for the selected asset to function correctly. HighLevel’s Snapshot documentation includes dedicated guidance for managing linked assets and selective Snapshot creation.

---

## **How To Setup Organized Nested Asset Selection**

Organized Nested Asset Selection is available directly inside supported Snapshot workflows. No additional setup is required. Accessing the asset selector from Create, Refresh, or Load Snapshot automatically displays the updated folder-based layout.

To use the updated selector:

1. Go to **Agency View** in HighLevel.
2. Open the relevant Snapshot workflow:

   - Create Snapshot
   - Refresh Snapshot
   - Load Snapshot
3. Open the asset selector.
4. Use the arrow beside a folder to expand it.
5. Review the assets and sub-folders inside.
6. Select a parent folder to include all contained assets.
7. Select individual assets when you only need specific items.
8. Continue with the Snapshot action.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does selecting a folder select everything inside it?**  
A: Yes. Selecting a folder selects the assets and sub-folders contained within that folder.

**Q: Can I still select individual assets?**  
A: Yes. Expand the folder and select only the specific assets you want to include.

**Q: Does this update change how Snapshots work?**  
A: No. This update improves the asset selection interface. The Create, Refresh, and Load Snapshot workflows still follow their normal processes.

**Q: Can I use the nested selector when refreshing a Snapshot?**  
A: Yes. The nested selector applies to Refresh Snapshot workflows.

**Q: Can I use the nested selector when loading a Snapshot?**  
A: Yes. The nested selector applies to Load Snapshot workflows and helps you review selected assets before

continuing.

**Q: What should I do if an asset appears restricted?**  
A: Review the asset and confirm whether it can be selected or loaded in the current workflow. Restricted asset behavior may depend on the asset type, account permissions, or Snapshot configuration.

**Q: Does folder selection replace linked asset review?**  
A: No. Folder selection helps you select assets by structure, while linked asset review helps confirm related dependencies.

**Q: Can deeply nested folders be expanded?**  
A: Yes. Multi-level folders can be expanded layer by layer so you can review assets inside each nested folder.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Snapshots Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982511)
- [Creating New Snapshots in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982512)
- [Refresh or Update Snapshots in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982583)
- [Load Snapshots Into Existing Sub-Account](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982582)
- [Snapshot Management: Selective Asset Snapshots and Force Snapshot Creation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005146)

title_en: Invoices - New revamped UI
source_md:
Payments • Invoices & Estimates • Billing

Create and Send Invoices in HighLevel

HighLevel invoices give you a centralized way to bill customers for products and services directly from a sub-account. You can add customers and products, configure invoice details and payment options, save your work, review the accurate customer-facing preview, and send the completed invoice by email or text. This guide explains how to create a one-time invoice and use the current invoice editor from start to finish.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to create a one-time invoice, add a customer and products, configure payment schedules and additional options, understand the invoice editor preview, review the accurate final preview, and send the invoice to your customer.

Important

The right-side preview inside the invoice editor is not a WYSIWYG customer preview and can contain placeholder sample data. Save the invoice, open the **three dots (⋮)** next to Save, and select **Preview** when you need to review the accurate invoice layout before sending.

# What Are Invoices in HighLevel?

Invoices let you bill customers for products or services directly from HighLevel while keeping customer information, products, pricing, payment options, invoice details, and delivery in one workflow.

A one-time invoice is intended for a single billing event. After adding the customer and invoice items, you can apply eligible discounts, taxes, payment schedules, fees, tips, terms, or attachments before saving and sending the invoice.

For billing that needs to repeat on a schedule, use a recurring invoice instead of repeatedly creating one-time invoices.

## Key Benefits of Invoices

The invoice editor brings invoice configuration, pricing controls, payment options, and document review into a single billing workflow so you can prepare an invoice before delivering it to the customer.

- **Centralized Billing:** Manage customer details, products, pricing, dates, and supported payment options from one invoice.
- **Flexible Product Entry:** Select existing products or create a product while building the invoice.
- **Payment Flexibility:** Configure supported discounts, taxes, payment schedules, late fees, processing fees, tips, terms, and attachments.
- **Save Before Sending:** Store invoice changes as a draft before delivering the invoice to the customer.
- **Accurate Final Preview:** Use the dedicated Preview action to review the complete invoice before sending it.

## Prerequisites and Limitations

Reviewing your invoice type and payment configuration before you begin helps you choose the correct billing workflow and understand which payment features will be available.

- Use a **one-time invoice** for a single billing event.
- Use **New Recurring Invoice** when invoices need to be generated repeatedly on a defined schedule.
- Configure invoice defaults when you plan to use features such as partial payments, late fees, tips, reminders, or other invoice settings.
- Electronic payment availability depends on the payment provider and payment methods configured for the sub-account.
- One-time invoices can also be used in documented manual-payment workflows, but the payment must be collected and recorded manually when no supported online payment provider is being used.
- Some invoice payment features depend on the connected provider and account configuration.

## How To Create and Send an Invoice

Creating a one-time invoice starts from the Payments area. Build the invoice by selecting a client, reviewing dates, adding products, configuring any required payment options, saving the draft, previewing the completed document, and then sending it.

### Step 1: Start a New Invoice

Start from the All Invoices view so you can choose between a one-time invoice, recurring invoice, or other available invoice actions.

1. From the **Sub-Account view**, select **Payments**.
2. Open **Invoices & Estimates**.
3. Select **All Invoices**.
4. Click **+ New**.
5. Select **New Invoice**.

![Invoices page showing the New menu with New Invoice and New Recurring Invoice options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081347736/original/WPMiZClQOiqVbkGuEyJqHMpgLTkWwhPipw.png?1789794202)

### Step 2: Add the Client and Invoice Details

Customer, business, and scheduling information identifies who receives the invoice and controls the primary dates displayed on the document.

1. Select the customer who should receive the invoice.
2. Review or edit the **Invoice Number**.
3. Review the **Issue Date**.
4. Review the **Due Date**.
5. Edit the business information when needed.
6. Save any business-information changes before continuing.

![Invoice editor showing business information, customer selection, invoice number, issue date, and due date](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081347791/original/YEV7OOCfGXXxg4Nm_v0W7NxE_cnqBlIlzA.png?1789794491)

### Step 3: Add Products or Services

Invoice items define what the customer is being billed for. You can select an existing product or create a product while building the invoice.

1. In the **Add Products** area, click **Add Product** or the item selector.
2. Choose an existing product from the list.
3. If the product does not exist, select **+ Create Product** and enter the required product information.
4. Add the item to the invoice.
5. Update the price or quantity on the invoice line when needed.

![Invoice editor product selector showing existing products and Create Product](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081347790/original/idk3U4aQEoIyz4hbEJV0nPW01FbXBYonTQ.png?1789794478)

Select an existing product or use + Create Product when the item is not already available.

### Step 4: Configure Invoice Options

Invoice options let you adjust the balance and apply supported billing rules before the invoice is delivered.

Depending on your account and payment configuration, available controls can include:

- **Add Discount:** Apply an eligible flat or percentage discount.
- **Add Tax:** Apply the applicable configured tax.
- **Add Payment Schedule:** Divide the amount into percentage-based or fixed-amount installments with due dates.
- **Additional Options:** Configure supported settings such as terms, late fees, processing fees, tipping, or attachments.

![Invoice editor showing Add Payment Schedule and Additional Options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081347770/original/S4bMq7nnCJaJNQyYM1a04mcmC2Bj78rJiw.png?1789794370)

### Step 5: Save and Preview the Invoice

Saving stores the current invoice configuration. The dedicated Preview action should be used when you want to review the accurate customer-facing layout.

1. Review the invoice details and click **Save**.
2. Click the **three dots (⋮)** next to Save.
3. Select **Preview**.
4. Review the accurate invoice in the browser tab that opens.
5. Return to the original invoice editor tab when you are ready to make changes or send the invoice.

![Invoice editor three-dot menu showing the Preview option](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081347766/original/TvCn1KK7cAeVFRVZtTqpGURoHFOCnPJyJw.png?1789794330)

### Step 6: Send the Invoice

Sending delivers the completed invoice through the delivery methods available for the selected customer and invoice configuration.

1. Return to the invoice editor after reviewing the final preview.
2. Click **Send**.
3. Review the invoice name.
4. Choose the available delivery option, such as **Email & Text**, **Email**, or **Text**.
5. Review the recipient information and message or email template.
6. Review the applicable **Additional Options**, including Test or Live mode when shown.
7. Complete the send action.

![Send Invoice window showing invoice name delivery options email template and additional options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081347785/original/-0a-wK_5vhbPBh3ImWZ6Y3JcBIgYK9atXw.png?1789794454)

## Invoice Options and Payment Features

Invoice options provide additional control over how much the customer pays, when payments are due, and what supporting information accompanies the invoice. Feature availability can depend on invoice settings and the connected payment provider.

| Option | What It Does |
| --- | --- |
| **Discount** | Reduces the invoice by the configured flat amount or percentage. |
| **Tax** | Applies the applicable configured tax to eligible invoice items. |
| **Payment Schedule** | Splits the invoice into percentage-based or fixed-amount installments with defined due dates. |
| **Terms & Conditions** | Adds invoice-specific terms or notes for the customer. |
| **Late Fees** | Applies the configured late-fee behavior when the feature is enabled and supported. |
| **Processing Fees** | Adds supported processing-fee behavior according to the payment configuration. |
| **Tipping** | Allows eligible customers to add a tip when paying the invoice. |
| **Attachments** | Adds supporting files to the invoice email sent to the customer. |

**Configuration matters:** Features such as partial payments, late fees, and tipping may need to be enabled in the invoice payment settings before they can be used on an individual invoice.

## Understand the Invoice Editor and Preview

The editor keeps invoice controls and a visual layout reference side by side, but the right-side editor preview and the dedicated Preview action have different purposes.

| View | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| **Invoice Editor** | Manage customer details, dates, products, prices, quantities, taxes, discounts, schedules, and other invoice options. |
| **Right-Side Preview** | Provides a structural layout reference while editing. It can contain placeholder sample data and is not the exact final invoice. |
| **Three Dots → Preview** | Opens the accurate invoice preview in a new browser tab so you can review the final formatting before sending. |

**Do not rely on the editor preview as the final customer view.** Save the invoice and use the dedicated Preview action when invoice formatting must be verified before sending.

## One-Time vs. Recurring Invoices

Choosing the correct invoice type is important because one-time and recurring invoices use different creation and billing flows.

| Invoice Type | Use It When | Creation Option |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **One-Time Invoice** | You need to bill the customer once for a product, service, setup fee, or other single charge. | **+ New → New Invoice** |
| **Recurring Invoice** | Invoices should be generated and sent repeatedly according to a configured billing schedule. | **+ New → New Recurring Invoice** |

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is the right-side invoice preview exactly what the customer will see?

No. The right-side editor preview can contain placeholder sample data and is intended to show the general document structure. Save the invoice and use **three dots (⋮) → Preview** to review the accurate invoice layout.

Q: Can I create a product while building the invoice?

Yes. Open the product selector in the Add Products area and use **+ Create Product** when the item does not already exist.

Q: Does clicking Save send the invoice?

No. **Save** stores the invoice changes. Sending the invoice is a separate action performed with the **Send** control.

Q: Can I use invoices when payments are collected manually?

Yes. HighLevel documents a manual-payment workflow for one-time invoices. When electronic payment processing is not being used, the payment must be collected and recorded manually.

Q: Can an invoice use a payment schedule?

Yes. Payment schedules can split an invoice into percentage-based or fixed-amount installments with their own due dates.

Q: How do I create a recurring invoice?

Go to **Payments → Invoices & Estimates → + New → New Recurring Invoice**, then configure the customer, products, frequency, and applicable start or end settings.

Q: Why might a payment feature be missing from my invoice?

Availability can depend on your invoice settings, connected payment provider, and the specific payment feature. Review the invoice payment settings and provider configuration before troubleshooting the invoice itself.

title_en: How to Create a Meta Engagement Ad with Messaging Apps
source_md:
Meta Engagement ads can direct people from an ad into supported messaging conversations. In HighLevel Ad Manager, you can configure an Engagement campaign with messaging destinations such as Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct, and WhatsApp when the required Meta assets are available.

You can also use a Conversation Form to guide the messaging experience after someone opens the ad. This guide explains how to configure the campaign, messaging destinations, Conversation Form, creative, audience, and publishing flow.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is a Meta Engagement Ad with Messaging Apps?](#What-is-a-Meta-Engagement-Ad-with-Messaging-Apps?)
- [Key Benefits of Meta Engagement Ads with Messaging Apps](#Key-Benefits-of-Meta-Engagement-Ads-with-Messaging-Apps)
- [How To Create a Meta Engagement Ad with Messaging Apps](#How-To-Create-a-Meta-Engagement-Ad-with-Messaging-Apps)
- [Tracking & Optimisation](#Tracking-&-Optimisation)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is a Meta Engagement Ad with Messaging Apps?**

A Meta Engagement ad with Messaging Apps is a campaign designed to start conversations through supported Meta messaging destinations.

HighLevel Ad Manager supports the Engagement objective and allows Conversation Forms at the Ad level. The messaging experience available to a person depends on the campaign configuration and the Meta assets connected to the selected Facebook Page.

Conversation Form previews update based on the messaging apps selected for the campaign.

---

## **Key Benefits of Meta Engagement Ads with Messaging Apps**

Messaging-app Engagement campaigns let businesses start conversations directly from a Meta ad while managing the campaign from HighLevel.

- **Direct conversation entry:**Let people move from the ad into a supported messaging destination.

- **Messaging destination options:**Use available Messenger, Instagram Direct, or WhatsApp destinations based on the connected Meta assets.

- **Conversation Forms:**Use a Conversation Form to provide greetings, quick replies, FAQs, and supported automated responses.

- **Centralized setup:** Configure the Campaign, Ad Set, Ad, and Conversation Form from HighLevel Ad Manager.

- **Performance reporting:**Review published campaign performance from Ad Manager Statistics.

---

## **How To Create a Meta Engagement Ad with Messaging Apps**

Start from the Sub-Account Ad Manager workspace, select the Engagement objective, then configure the Ad Set and Ad details before reviewing and publishing the campaign.

Meta Ads allow businesses to drive engagement and start conversations with potential customers through messaging apps like **Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct, and WhatsApp**. This guide will walk you through setting up an ad campaign with the following specifications:

- **Ad Objective:** Engagement
- **Conversion Location:** Messaging Apps
- **Performance Goal:** Maximise the number of conversations

Additionally, this guide highlights the **exceptions** where the ad or conversation form may work for one messaging app but not for others.

---

## **Step 1: Access Ad Manager**

1. Go to sub-account > Marketing >**Ad Manager** provided your onboarding is completed. (Refer [link](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004261-how-to-enable-and-resell-ad-manager) on how to enable and resell ad manager)
2. Click on **+ Create Campaign** to start a new campaign.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155042575129/original/tr7HhwDkrf5-B-rVSW1A41FuZA9DTiz-fQ.png?1741042486)
3. Select Facebook Campaign and Start from scratch.

---

## **Step 2: Choose the Facebook page and Instagram account**

1. Select the Facebook page you want your ad to associate with and reflect your business.
2. Either select an Instagram account that's connected to the selected FB page or use the Facebook page itself to showcase your ad on Instagram. Details on how to connect an Instagram account with the FB page and other important info is listed in the following [help article](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004550-instagram-ads-overview).  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155042575823/original/JGYXvETaEhBJ8kg41MufLTSNLA8QR5mwqg.png?1741045322)

```
Note: Instagram messaging app will not be eligible for Click to Direct ads if there is no Insta account connected to the selected page.
```

---

## **Step 3: Choose the Ad Objective**

1. Select **Engagement** as the objective.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155042578513/original/0MFGWoypNrtw2avl9ugF_aR4lpuJxzzt2A.png?1741055254)
2. The **Conversion Location**is defaulted to be **'****Messaging Apps'**.
3. The **Performance goal**is defaulted to be **'Maximise number of conversations'**.
   - This ensures Meta optimises ad delivery to encourage users to start chats with your business.

---

## **Step 4: Choose Messaging Apps for Conversations**

Under the **Messaging Apps** section, select one or more platforms where you want to receive messages:

- **Facebook Messenger**
- **Instagram Direct -**It will be active to be used only if the selected Facebook page has an Instagram account connected to it.
- **WhatsApp -**The WhatsApp can be used as a messaging app for a CTX ad only if you have WhatsApp numbers added to the Facebook page that's selected for the ad campaign.

### 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155042578706/original/KRJtQd6ODWP9vQnsNjEeqacbXwREdwBGew.png?1741055680)

### **What If a Messaging App is not selected?**

| Scenario | Impact |
| --- | --- |
| **All three apps are available (Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp)** | The ad is shown across all platforms, and Meta algorithm decides which is the best app to reach the user. |
| **Only Messenger and Instagram Direct are available** | WhatsApp is not an option. Users can message you via Messenger or Instagram Direct. |
| **Only WhatsApp is available** | Users will be directed only to WhatsApp for conversations. The ad won't run on Messenger or Instagram. |
| **Only one app is available** | The ad campaign will be shown across all platforms but user is limited to reach you only via that messaging platform. |
| **None of the messaging apps are available** | The ad cannot be created under this objective. You may need to choose another objective (e.g., Traffic or Leads). |

---

## **Step 5: Create or Use a Conversation form**

1. Click on the dropdown of create new or select a Conversation form
2. Click on 'Create Conversation Form'  
     

   [![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081897593/original/UD0OQLh_9WE3gBzv4n-KAy5r9_zhCmSMIw.png?1790360360)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004718-how-to-create-a-conversation-form-in-ad-manager)
3. A dialog opens up to key in the form definitions.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081897602/original/bKzauxkwCBzX0hv9yY9ddCgx-Wpa6eFUoQ.png?1790360386)  
     

   ### **Setting Up the Conversation Form**

   1. Add the **Name**of the Conversation form.
   2. **Welcome Message/Greeting:**
      - Write a friendly **greeting message** that appears when users click on the CTA button, say "Send Message."
      - Example: *"Hi! Thanks for reaching out. How can we assist you today?"*
   3. **Add FAQs or Quick Replies:**
      - Set up 3-5 common **questions or options** users can tap on.
      - Example:
        - *"Tell me about your services"*
        - *"Do you offer discounts?"*
        - *"How can I contact support?"*
   4. **Set Up Automated Responses:**
      - Provide answers to FAQs automatically.
      - Example: If a user clicks *"Tell me about your services"*, an automated response can say:  
        *"We offer a range of services, including XYZ. Would you like to speak with a representative?"*
   5. **Save and Apply the Form:**
      - Click **Create**to save the newly created conversation form.
      - Ensure it is linked to the ad.

```
Note: 1. Specific preview of how your conversation form will look like can be seen on the form preview screen for each messaging app.
2. The Preview section is dynamic and will show the preview of only those messaging apps that are selected for the engagement ad campaign.
```

---

## **Step 6: Select Placements**

Use the placement controls available for the Engagement campaign.

- Use the default placement option when you want Meta to use the eligible placements available for the campaign.
- Enable Manual Placements when you need to select eligible placements individually.

Available placements can depend on the campaign configuration and current Meta support.

---

## **Step 7: Create Your Ad**

1. **Select an Ad Format**:
   - **Single Image/Video** – A simple ad with one visual.
   - **Carousel** – Multiple images/videos users can scroll through.
2. **Write Engaging Ad Copy**:
   - Keep it short and compelling.
   - Highlight a strong **Call-to-Action (CTA)** like "Message Us Now!".
3. **Set Up the Call-to-Action (CTA)**:
   - Choose "Send Message".
   - If multiple messaging apps are selected, Meta will optimise the best platform to message you where you're most likely to respond.

---

## **Step 8: Budget & Schedule**

Select the budget controls available for the Ad Set.

1. Choose a Daily Budget or Lifetime Budget.

2. Enter the budget amount.

3. Configure the available start and end scheduling options when needed.

Meta ad spend is charged through the payment method associated with the connected Meta ads account.

---

## **Step 9: Set Up the Audience**

1. Choose your audience based on location, age, gender, and detailed targeting.
2. Use **Custom Audiences** to target existing customers or lookalike audiences to find new users.

---

## **Step 10: Review and Publish**

1. Double-check all settings.
2. Click **Publish** to launch your ad.
3. Monitor performance in**Ad Manager Statistics.**

---

# **Tracking & Optimisation**

- Use **Meta Pixel** to track user interactions.
- Create a CAPI action to send back details to Meta for effective tracking of conversations.

- Optimise by testing different creatives and audience segments.
- Adjust budget and placements based on performance metrics.

```
Optional: Send Supported Conversion Events to Meta

Meta Conversion API setup is separate from creating the messaging ad.

HighLevel currently supports an Instagram DM event type in the Meta Conversion API workflow for Click-to-Direct ads. Configure this only when your reporting or attribution workflow requires that supported event.

For exact triggers, event types, pixels, and workflow configuration, use the dedicated Meta Conversion API documentation rather than configuring CAPI from this campaign-creation guide.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Which campaign objective should I use for this messaging workflow?**

Use the Engagement objective for the Conversation Form workflow documented in this article.

**Q: Can I create a Conversation Form in Ad Manager?**

Yes. Engagement campaigns can select an existing Conversation Form or create a new one from the Ad-level setup.

**Q: Which messaging apps does the current article support?**

The existing HighLevel workflow documents Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct, and WhatsApp. Exact availability depends on the Meta assets and connections available for the campaign.

**Q: Where can I review campaign performance after publishing?**

Go to Sub-Account → Marketing → Ad Manager → Statistics.

**Q: Do I need Meta Pixel to receive messaging conversations?**

The current HighLevel documentation does not identify Meta Pixel as a requirement for receiving messaging conversations in this campaign setup.

**Q: Can I use Meta Conversion API with Click-to-Direct ads?**

Yes. Current HighLevel workflow documentation supports an Instagram DM CAPI event type for Click-to-Direct ads. Configure it separately through Workflows when your use case requires supported conversion-event reporting.

title_en: Guide to the Field Services Private Beta
source_md:
```
Fill out this form to register your interest for the private beta.
```

Welcome to the private beta of Field Services, HighLevel's new tool for home and field service businesses. Field Services connects requests, jobs, scheduling, dispatch and invoicing in one place, so your office and your field team work from the same picture of the day.

This guide explains what is included in the beta, what to expect, how to get started, and how to share feedback. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview](#overview)
- [Who is this Beta for?](#who)
- [What's Included in the Beta?](#included)
- [How to Get Started](#started)
- [Suggested Test Plan for Your First Week](#test-plan)
- [Upcoming Features](#upcoming)
- [Known Limitations](#limitations)
- [How to Provide Feedback](#feedback)
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related)

---

## Overview

Field Services helps businesses that send staff to the customer's location, such as plumbing, HVAC, electrical, cleaning and landscaping. With Field Services you can:

- **Capture** customer requests from your booking page, or create them in the app.
- **Quote and organize** by turning requests into estimates and jobs, with services, products and pricing.
- **Schedule** one or more visits per job, find open times and assign staff.
- **Dispatch** by seeing every visit on a calendar and map, and optimizing each staff member's route.
- **Deliver and bill** by sending reminders and updates, tracking visit progress, and invoicing the customer.

![The Field Services menu](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084162845/original/mlfS63rdyUHPe8uhD6TgPK_C95WAjddKfw.jpg?1792999536)

---

## Who is this Beta for?

This private beta is designed for agencies and businesses in field and home services. By taking part, you will be among the first to use Field Services and help shape what we build next.

You will get the most from the beta if:

- Your team travels to customers' addresses to do the work.
- You manage jobs that need more than one visit, or more than one technician.
- You want customers to book or request work online, with your coverage rules applied.
- You are willing to try the product with real scenarios and tell us what works and what does not.

---

## What's Included in the Beta?

| Area | What you can do | Learn more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Home** | See a daily overview of payments, scheduling and work that needs attention. | [Field Services Home Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009370) |
| **Requests** | Receive customer requests and convert them into estimates or jobs. | [Requests in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009375) |
| **Jobs and visits** | Hold the scope of work and pricing on a job, and schedule visits with assigned staff, statuses, checklists and notes. | [Jobs in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009376) [Visit Statuses in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009378) [Checklists, Notes and Forms in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009382) |
| **Schedule** | Use a list view of visits and a calendar view with a map, a jobs-to-schedule panel and route optimization. | [Schedule in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009379) [Route Optimization in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009380) |
| **Find availability** | Get suggested times based on staff working hours, assigned services, service areas, existing bookings and drive time. | [Scheduling Visits and Finding Availability in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009377) |
| **Mobile app** | Manage requests and jobs, schedule and reschedule visits, change visit statuses, and use checklists, notes and timers from the mobile app. Changes sync with the web. | [Jobs in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009376) |
| **Services and staff** | Set up services, add-ons, staff, working hours, service areas, travel fee and extra travel time. | [Staff in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009372) [Service Areas in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009371) [Services and Add-ons in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009373) |
| **Import** | Bring services over from a CSV file or from your existing Services setup. | [Importing Services into Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009374) |
| **Estimates and invoices** | Create estimates and invoices for your jobs and collect payments. | [Estimates and Invoices in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009381) |
| **Timesheets** | Let staff track time against visits. | [Timesheets in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009383) |
| **Online booking** | Give customers a branded booking page and request form, with settings for booking rules and payments. | [Field Services Settings: Online Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009385) [Booking Page Editor in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009387) |
| **Notifications** | Send email, SMS and WhatsApp messages to contacts, assigned staff and admins or dispatchers. | [Notifications in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009384) |
| **AI receptionist and Google organic booking** | Set up a chat AI agent that answers questions and takes requests, and connect your Google Business Profile. | [AI Receptionist and Google Organic Booking in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009388) |
| **Contact view** | See a contact's field service activity from their record. | [Field Services in Contacts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009389) |

Each area has its own help article. See the Related Articles section at the end of this guide.

---

## How to Get Started

1. **Fill out [this form](https://api.gohighlevel.com/widget/form/hUqdKVCSNu82zc9TFY3x)**to register your interest for the private beta.
2. Once added to the beta, you will see **Field Services** with a **Beta** tag in the left navigation of your enrolled sub-account.
3. **Start on Home.** New accounts open on a welcome page with a three-step checklist: add your staff, review your service area and add your services. See [Field Services Home Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009370).
4. **Set up your coverage.** Review the Default service area and add more if needed under **Services & staff > Service areas**. See [Service Areas in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009371).
5. **Add staff.** Set working hours, assigned services, service areas and route start and end for each person. See [Staff in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009372).
6. **Add services.** Create services or use **Services & staff > Import** to copy existing ones. See [Services and Add-ons in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009373) and [Importing Services into Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009374).
7. **Review settings.** Open **Field Services Settings** to choose how customers book, how they pay, and which notifications go out. See [Field Services Settings: Online Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009385).
8. **Create a test request or job** and schedule a visit to see the full flow.

```
Note: If you already use Services, your existing setup is not changed. You choose what to copy into Field Services with the importer.
```

---

## Suggested Test Plan for Your First Week

If you are not sure where to begin, this plan covers the full flow in about a week. Adjust it to fit your business.

| When | What to try | What to look for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Day 1** | Set up service areas, two or three staff and a handful of services. | Is it clear which staff can take which services and where? |
| **Day 2** | Open your booking page and test a booking with an address inside your service area and one outside it. | Does the address check and outside-area policy behave the way you expect? |
| **Day 3** | Create a request, convert it to an estimate, then create a job. | Does the job hold the right scope and pricing? |
| **Day 4** | Schedule visits with **Find availability**, including a job with two visits. | Are the suggested times sensible? Can you override staff when you need to? |
| **Day 5** | Review the day on the calendar and map, run **Route optimization** and turn on notifications. | Is the proposed route better? Do the messages go out at the right time? |

---

## Upcoming Features

Here is a preview of what we are working on:

- Reporting for jobs, visits and requests
- Workflow triggers and actions for jobs, visits and requests
- Opportunities integration
- Client portal
- Snapshots
- Resources and waitlists
- More AI support, including voice
- More importers

Priorities and timelines can change based on your feedback.

---

## Known Limitations

Field Services is in private beta, so keep the following in mind:

- Some features listed under Upcoming Features are not yet available.
- The AI receptionist supports chat. Voice options are not yet available.
- You may occasionally see minor performance or interface issues as we keep improving the product.

If you run into an issue, share it with us. Your feedback helps us fix things faster.

---

## How to Provide Feedback

Your feedback shapes Field Services. Here is how to reach us:

1. **Schedule a feedback call:** [speakwith.us/swadha](http://speakwith.us/swadha)
2. **Email us:** swadha.bhoj@gohighlevel.com

When you send feedback, it helps us to know what you were trying to do, what you expected to happen, and what happened instead. Screenshots are always welcome.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Who has access to the Field Services beta?**  
A: Field Services is a private beta for selected customers. This lets us gather feedback and make improvements before a wider release. You can fill out [this form](https://api.gohighlevel.com/widget/form/hUqdKVCSNu82zc9TFY3x) to register your interest for the beta.

**Q: How can I check if Field Services is active on my account?**  
A: Open your sub-account and look for Field Services in the left navigation. If you do not see it, contact us using one of the feedback options above.

**Q: When will Field Services be available to everyone?**  
A: We are planning a wider release after the private beta. Watch the Release Notes for updates.

**Q: Will Field Services change my existing calendars or Services?**  
A: No. Field Services is a separate module. Your existing calendars, Services and workflows keep working as they do today.

**Q: Can I move my existing services into Field Services?**  
A: Yes. Use **Services & staff > Import** and choose CSV or Services as the source. Services whose name already exists in Field Services are skipped, and existing services are not updated. See [Importing Services into Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009374).

**Q: Do I need a payment provider?**  
A: Only if you want customers to pay online at booking. You can use **Pay in-person** without one. See [Field Services Settings: Online Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009385).

**Q: Where can I learn the basics?**  
A: Start with [Field Services - Overview & How to Get Started](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009368), then follow the articles in the Related Articles list.
