title_en: Email AI - Smart Countdown Timer Creation
source_md:
Email Marketing

# Email AI Smart Countdown Timer Creation

Automatically detect time-sensitive campaigns and add live countdown timers to boost urgency and drive conversions.

What You'll Learn

Email AI recognizes when your email campaigns would benefit from a live countdown timer and guides you through adding one during template creation or layout updates. This intelligent feature helps you create time-sensitive promotions that drive action without manually configuring timer elements.

This article covers what Email AI countdown timer detection is, its key benefits, how the system identifies time-sensitive content, and step-by-step instructions for adding timers to your campaigns.

## What is Email AI Smart Countdown Timer Creation?

Email AI Smart Countdown Timer Creation is an intelligent feature that analyzes your email content during template creation or layout updates and identifies when a live countdown timer would enhance your campaign's effectiveness. When Email AI detects time-sensitive content such as flash sales, product launches, webinars, or expiring offers, it prompts you to add a countdown timer.

The feature integrates seamlessly into your email creation workflow, allowing you to select an existing countdown timer, create a new one with customized settings, or skip the suggestion entirely. When you create a new timer, Email AI collects the end date, visual style, and destination link, then embeds the configured timer directly into your email template.

Email AI only suggests countdown timers when contextually appropriate, avoiding interruptions for emails like welcome messages, receipts, newsletters without deadlines, or password resets. This intelligent filtering ensures you receive timer suggestions only when they add genuine value to your campaign.

## Key Benefits of Email AI Smart Countdown Timer Creation

**Simplified Time-Sensitive Campaign Creation** — Create urgency-driven emails faster by letting Email AI detect deadline-based content and guide you through adding countdown timers without manual configuration.

**Automatic Urgency Elements** — Add psychological triggers that drive action by incorporating live countdown timers into your promotions without technical setup or design work.

**Reuse Existing Timers** — Maintain consistency across campaigns by selecting previously created countdown timers, saving time and ensuring brand alignment.

**Context-Aware Suggestions** — Receive countdown timer prompts only when relevant to your email content, avoiding unnecessary interruptions for transactional or informational messages.

**Higher Conversion Rates** — Leverage proven urgency tactics to motivate recipients to take immediate action on time-limited offers and event registrations.

**Graceful Workflow Integration** — Continue your email creation process seamlessly whether you add a timer, skip the suggestion, or let the prompt time out without disrupting your workflow.

## How Email AI Detects Time-Sensitive Content

Email AI analyzes your email content, subject line, and campaign purpose to determine whether a countdown timer would enhance your message's effectiveness. The system uses intelligent pattern recognition to identify deadline-driven campaigns while filtering out emails where timers would be inappropriate.

Email Types That Trigger Countdown Timer Suggestions

Campaign Type 1

Flash Sales and Limited-Time Offers

Promotions with specific expiration dates, discount codes that expire, or inventory-limited deals benefit from countdown timers that create urgency and drive immediate purchases.

Campaign Type 2

Product Launches and Pre-Orders

New product releases, early access windows, and pre-order deadlines leverage countdown timers to build anticipation and encourage early commitment.

Campaign Type 3

Webinars and Live Events

Event registrations, webinar reminders, and conference invitations use countdown timers to highlight registration deadlines or event start times.

Campaign Type 4

Expiring Offers and Renewals

Subscription renewals, membership deadlines, and account-related expiration notices employ countdown timers to prompt timely action before benefits expire.

Email Types That Do Not Trigger Timer Suggestions

Email AI prevents countdown timer suggestions for email types where urgency elements would be inappropriate or detract from the message:

- Welcome emails and onboarding sequences
- Order confirmations and receipts
- Newsletters without specific deadlines
- Password reset and account security emails
- Informational updates and company announcements

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/MJW9XaH0wFAUr1BWC8mg+/Screenshot+2026-07-27+at+11.50.42%E2%80%AFAM.png)

## How to Add a Countdown Timer Using Email AI

When Email AI detects that your email content would benefit from a countdown timer, it presents you with three options during template creation or layout updates. Follow these steps to add a countdown timer to your time-sensitive campaign.

Step 1

Create or Edit Your Email Campaign

Navigate to **Marketing** > **Emails** and begin creating a new email template or editing an existing one. As you develop your email content with time-sensitive elements like sale end dates or event times, Email AI analyzes your content in the background.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/S6t8GE2htGPrXFr3PZLt+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-30+at+22.06.44.png)

Step 2

Review the Countdown Timer Suggestion

When Email AI identifies time-sensitive content, a countdown timer suggestion prompt appears. This prompt offers three choices: select an existing countdown timer from your account, create a new timer with custom settings, or skip the suggestion to continue without a timer. Review your campaign needs to determine which option best serves your goals.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/MJW9XaH0wFAUr1BWC8mg+/Screenshot+2026-07-27+at+11.50.42%E2%80%AFAM.png)

Step 3

Choose to Select an Existing Timer or Create a New One

If you have previously created countdown timers that match your current campaign, click the option to select an existing timer. Browse your saved timers and choose the one that matches your campaign's deadline and visual style. This option ensures consistency across multiple campaigns using the same offer expiration or event date.

If you need a new countdown timer with unique settings, click the option to create a new timer. This launches the countdown timer configuration interface where you'll specify the timer's end date, visual style, and destination link for when recipients click the timer.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/vfVll4BXgX4GRJsURcWf+/Screenshot+2026-07-27+at+11.50.42%E2%80%AFAM+%281%29.png)

Step 4

Configure Your New Countdown Timer Settings

In the countdown timer creation interface, enter the end date and time for your offer or event.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Diu63lI3LukVursTHSDw+/Screenshot+2026-07-27+at+11.50.51%E2%80%AFAM.png)

Select a visual style that matches your email design and brand aesthetic.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/pKsDRnMol257J6AvRZ6Z+/Screenshot+2026-07-27+at+11.51.02%E2%80%AFAM.png)

Specify the destination URL where recipients should be directed when they click the countdown timer. Review your settings to ensure accuracy, then save the timer configuration.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/TbsnRxt83Ohl4HzzZGCJ+/Screenshot+2026-07-27+at+11.51.21%E2%80%AFAM.png)

Step 5

Review the Embedded Timer in Your Email

Email AI automatically embeds your selected or newly created countdown timer into your email template. Review the timer placement within your email layout to ensure it appears in the optimal position for maximum visibility and impact. You can adjust the timer's position using the Email Builder's drag-and-drop interface if needed. Verify that the countdown displays correctly and aligns with your surrounding content.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/26wWYpu5MfOw0RuQevQW+/Screenshot+2026-07-27+at+11.52.45%E2%80%AFAM.png)

Tip

You can skip the countdown timer suggestion at any time by clicking the skip option. If you don't respond to the timer prompt, Email AI applies graceful fallback behavior and continues your email creation process without interruption. You can always manually add a countdown timer later using the Email Builder's element library.

Best Practice

Place countdown timers prominently near your call-to-action buttons or primary offer details. Test your timer's end date carefully to ensure it accurately reflects your campaign deadline. For recurring promotions, consider creating reusable timers that you can select in future campaigns to maintain consistency.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Will Email AI suggest countdown timers for every email I create?

No. Email AI only suggests countdown timers when it detects time-sensitive content such as flash sales, product launches, webinars, or expiring offers. The system avoids suggesting timers for emails where they would be inappropriate, including welcome emails, receipts, newsletters without deadlines, and password resets. You can also explicitly request a countdown timer even if Email AI doesn't automatically suggest one.

Q: Can I reuse countdown timers I've created in previous campaigns?

Yes. When Email AI suggests adding a countdown timer, you can select an existing timer from your account. This allows you to reuse timers across multiple campaigns that share the same deadline, ensuring consistency and saving setup time. All previously created timers are available for selection during the countdown timer suggestion process.

Q: What happens if I skip the countdown timer suggestion or don't respond to the prompt?

If you skip the countdown timer suggestion or the prompt times out without a response, Email AI applies graceful fallback behavior and continues your email creation process without interruption. You can always manually add a countdown timer later using the Email Builder's element library if you change your mind.

Q: Can I customize the appearance and behavior of countdown timers suggested by Email AI?

Yes. When creating a new countdown timer through Email AI's suggestion prompt, you can configure the end date, visual style, and destination link. After the timer is embedded in your email, you can further adjust its position and styling using the Email Builder's drag-and-drop interface to match your design preferences.

Q: Does the countdown timer work in all email clients?

Live countdown timers function in most modern email clients that support dynamic content. In email clients that don't support live timers, recipients typically see a static image showing the time remaining when the email was sent. The timer's destination link remains functional regardless of the email client, ensuring recipients can still click through to your offer or event.

Q: Can I manually add a countdown timer without waiting for Email AI to suggest one?

Yes. You can always add countdown timers manually using the Email Builder's element library, regardless of whether Email AI suggests one. The AI suggestion feature is designed to streamline the process for detected time-sensitive content, but you maintain full control over adding countdown timers to any email campaign at any time.

Q: How does Email AI determine the optimal placement for countdown timers in my email?

Email AI embeds countdown timers based on your email's layout and content structure. After embedding, you can adjust the timer's position using the Email Builder's drag-and-drop interface. For optimal results, place countdown timers prominently near your primary call-to-action or main offer details where they will create maximum urgency and visibility.

Q: Can I edit or update a countdown timer after it's been embedded in my email?

Yes. After Email AI embeds a countdown timer in your email, you can edit its settings, change its appearance, or replace it with a different timer using the Email Builder. Changes to countdown timer settings apply immediately to your email template. If you've already sent emails with the timer, those sent emails retain the timer configuration that was active at send time.

title_en: How to Customize Your Dashboard with Services & Rentals Widgets
source_md:
Dashboard Customization

# Customizing Your Dashboard with Services & Rentals Widgets

Learn how to add, configure, and use Services & Rentals reporting widgets to track revenue, bookings, staff performance, and inventory health directly in your HighLevel dashboard.

What You'll Learn

This guide walks you through customizing your dashboard with Services and Rentals reporting widgets. You'll learn how to access these widgets from your dashboard editor, configure them for your business needs, and use them to turn booking data into actionable insights.

Whether you run a service-based business tracking staff revenue or a rental operation managing inventory, these widgets help you monitor performance without exporting data or switching between multiple tools.

Before You Begin

Services & Rentals widgets are only available when the corresponding scheduling types are enabled in Calendar Settings. If you don't see these widgets in your dashboard editor, check that Services and/or Rentals are enabled for your sub-account. See [Section 4](#section-4) below for detailed steps.

## What is Customizing Dashboard with Widgets

Dashboard customization in HighLevel lets you build personalized reporting views by adding, arranging, and configuring widgets that display real-time data from your business operations. Widgets are individual data visualizations—charts, tables, numbers, or lists—that you can place on your dashboard to monitor key metrics without navigating through multiple screens or exporting reports.

When you customize your dashboard, you choose which widgets to display, how they're visualized (bar chart, donut chart, table, etc.), and what data they show by applying filters like date range, staff member, location, or service type. This gives you complete control over what information appears on your dashboard and how it's presented.

What Are Services & Rentals Widgets?

Services and Rentals widgets are specialized reporting components designed to track booking performance for two distinct scheduling types in HighLevel's Calendars module:

Services Widgets

Services widgets focus on service-based appointments—such as consultations, treatments, classes, or any bookable service delivered by your team. These widgets help you track revenue by service type, monitor staff performance, analyze discount usage, and identify your top-performing offerings. They're ideal for businesses like salons, clinics, consulting firms, fitness studios, and professional services.

Rentals Widgets

Rentals widgets are built for businesses that rent out assets, equipment, vehicles, properties, or spaces. These widgets provide visibility into booking volume, revenue, inventory status, and operational health. You can track active rentals, identify overdue returns, monitor unconfirmed bookings, and analyze which listings generate the most revenue. They're perfect for equipment rental companies, property managers, vehicle rental services, and event space providers.

Both widget types live under the Appointments category in your dashboard editor and are visually distinguished by their icons—Services widgets display a purple wrench icon, while Rentals widgets show a gold key icon.

## Key Benefits of Services and Rentals Widgets

Centralized Performance Monitoring

Instead of navigating between Calendars, Payments, and Contacts to piece together booking performance, Services and Rentals widgets consolidate all critical metrics in one view. Monitor revenue trends, staff productivity, inventory utilization, and customer booking patterns from a single dashboard, eliminating the need to export reports or switch between multiple tools.

Real-Time Operational Insights

These widgets update in real time, giving you immediate visibility into what's happening in your business right now. Track active rentals currently in progress, identify overdue returns before they become costly, spot unconfirmed bookings that need follow-up, and see which staff members are generating the most revenue today. This real-time visibility enables faster decision-making and proactive issue resolution.

Customizable for Different Roles

With flexible filtering by staff, location, service, listing, and date range, you can create role-specific dashboards tailored to different audiences. Build an executive dashboard showing total revenue across all locations, a manager view filtered to a single branch, or individual staff dashboards displaying only their personal bookings and earnings. Each team member sees exactly the metrics that matter to their role.

Data-Driven Revenue Optimization

Services and Rentals widgets help you identify revenue opportunities and operational inefficiencies. Discover which services or rental listings drive the most revenue, analyze the impact of coupon codes and discounts on bookings, track cancelled appointment revenue to refine your confirmation workflows, and benchmark performance across locations or staff members. These insights empower you to make informed pricing, staffing, and inventory decisions that directly impact profitability.

## How to Access Services & Rentals Widgets

Once Services and Rentals are enabled in Calendar Settings, you can add their widgets to any dashboard from the dashboard editor. These widgets live under the Appointments category and are designed to give you instant visibility into booking performance, revenue, and operations.

Step 1

Open Your Dashboard Editor

1. Switch to the sub-account you want to customize
2. Click **Dashboard** in the left navigation
3. Create a new dashboard or open an existing one
4. Click **Edit dashboard** to enter edit mode

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077339964/original/mBhz5PM7SPf0khQTDNgQQOpKzMl3ocqJGw.png?1785500605)

Step 2

Find the Widgets

1. Click **Add widget** in the dashboard editor
2. In the widget panel, open the **Appointments** category
3. Scroll through the widget list to find Services and Rentals widgets
4. Look for the icon to identify widget types:
   - **Purple wrench icon** = Services widgets
   - **Gold key icon** = Rentals widgets
   - **Blue calendar icon** = Meeting appointment widgets
5. (Optional) Use the **Chart Type filters** at the top (All, #, donut, line, bar, funnel, table) to narrow results by visualization style
6. Click any widget to add it to your dashboard

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077340318/original/UfRZ-EqQ-OOMPcEJgR-ZD6wW_Eyxz0pPsw.gif?1785500755)

Visual Tip

Services widgets display a **purple wrench icon**, while Rentals widgets show a **gold key icon**. This makes them easy to distinguish when scrolling through the Appointments widget list.

Step 3

Configure the Widget

Once added, you can resize, move, and configure the widget. Choose your chart type (number, bar, donut, table, etc.) and apply filters by date range, staff, location, service, or listing. The sections below explain what each widget does and when to use it.

Learn More

For a general overview of how dashboard widgets work, see [What Are Dashboard Widgets?](#) and [Customizing Dashboard Widgets](#).

## Customizing Service Appointment Widgets

Service Appointment widgets help you track revenue, staff performance, and discount usage for service-based bookings. These widgets draw from the Services scheduling type in Calendars, keeping them separate from traditional Meetings and Rentals.

When you add a Service widget to your dashboard, you can configure its chart type (number, bar, donut, table, etc.) and apply filters by date range, staff, location, service, or category. This lets you create focused views for different audiences—such as an owner's revenue overview or a staff member's individual performance.

Available Service Widgets & When to Use Them

Total Revenue from Service Booking

Shows total revenue from all service bookings in the selected date range.

Use this to monitor overall sales from services across all staff and locations.

Revenue by Service

Breaks down revenue by individual service offering.

Perfect for spotting which services are your top earners and which may need more promotion.

Revenue by Service Category

Groups revenue by service category.

Helpful when you organize offerings into categories like "Consultations," "Treatments," or "Packages."

Average Order Value (Services)

Displays average revenue per service booking.

Watch this metric when you introduce upsells, add-ons, or new pricing strategies.

Top Grossing Staff (Services)

Ranks staff members by revenue generated from service bookings.

Use this for performance reviews, incentive programs, and workload balancing.

Top Performing Service Locations

Shows service locations ranked by revenue.

Ideal for multi-location teams who need to benchmark branches against each other.

Cancelled Service Revenue

Tracks revenue lost from cancelled service bookings.

Helps you understand the financial impact of cancellations and refine confirmation and reminder workflows.

Coupon Redemptions (Services)

Counts total coupon codes redeemed across all service bookings.

Great for quick checks on how often discounts are used.

Revenue from Coupons (Services)

Shows revenue from service bookings where a coupon was applied.

Lets you compare the revenue impact of discounted vs. full-price bookings.

Top Coupon Codes (Services)

Lists most frequently used coupon codes for service bookings.

Use this to identify your best-performing offers and replicate their structure in new campaigns.

Tip

Combine multiple Service widgets on the same dashboard to build a complete performance view. For example, pair Total Revenue with Top Grossing Staff and Revenue by Service for a comprehensive executive overview.

## Customizing Rentals Widgets

Rentals widgets provide visibility into booking volume, revenue, and inventory status for rental listings such as vehicles, rooms, equipment, or properties. These widgets respect the Rentals scheduling type, which is designed for multi-day bookings and inventory tracking.

Just like Service widgets, Rentals widgets can be configured with different chart types and filters. You can filter by listing, category, booking status, and date range to create operational dashboards for logistics teams or revenue reports for managers.

Available Rentals Widgets & When to Use Them

Total Listings Booked

Shows total number of rental bookings created in the selected period.

A core volume metric to track how busy your rental operation is.

Total Listings Booked by Status

Displays distribution of bookings by status (confirmed, pending, cancelled, etc.).

Quickly reveals operational bottlenecks, such as too many pending approvals.

Total Rental Revenue (Excluding Security Deposits)

Shows rental revenue net of security deposits.

Displays "true" revenue from rentals, separated from refundable deposits.

Average Rental Value

Shows average revenue per rental booking.

Watch this during price tests, package changes, or new listing tiers.

Revenue by Listing

Breaks down revenue by individual rental listing.

Identifies which assets are most profitable.

Booking Count by Listing

Ranks listings by number of bookings.

Highlights popular assets that may warrant price adjustments or additional inventory.

Upcoming Rentals

Lists rentals scheduled for the upcoming week.

Helps operations teams prepare inventory and staffing for the near term.

Overdue Rentals

Shows rentals past their end date that are not yet completed.

Critical for minimizing loss, enforcing late fees, or triggering follow-up workflows.

Unconfirmed Rentals

Displays bookings pending confirmation.

Perfect for daily follow-up lists for your reservations team.

Active Rentals

Shows rentals currently in progress.

Provides a real-time snapshot of assets that are currently deployed.

Tip

Build an operations dashboard by combining Active Rentals, Overdue Rentals, Upcoming Rentals, and Unconfirmed Rentals. This gives your team a complete view of inventory status and pending tasks.

title_en: Social Planner - Recurring Social Posts
source_md:
Recurring posts provide a streamlined way to create evergreen content across various social platforms, scheduled daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Through a simple process, users can generate quality content using AI, schedule it with flexible time settings, and even edit parent and child posts. Take control of your content strategy by utilizing this feature, but be mindful of platforms like Twitter, which may flag repetitive content.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Recurring Social Posts?](#What-is-Recurring-Social-Posts?)
- [Use Cases](#Use-Cases)
- [How to Schedule Recurring Posts](#How-to-Schedule-Recurring-Posts%C2%A0)
- [Important Pointers](#Important-Pointers)
- [System sanctity practices](#System-sanctity-practices)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Recurring Social Posts?**

The recurring posts feature in the Social Planner is designed to help users maintain consistent and automated social media engagement by scheduling evergreen content regularly. Here's a detailed breakdown of how it works:

- **Flexible Scheduling:** Users can set the posts to repeat every day, week, month, or year. They can select specific days of the week, date ranges, and post times according to their preferences.
- **Content Creation:**Users can generate quality content using AI, allowing them to create posts that resonate with their audience quickly.
- **Editing Options:** The feature allows for edits to both parent and child posts. If changes are made to the parent post, they will be replicated in all child (scheduled) posts. Editing a child's post will not impact the parent's post.
- **Recurring Posts Tab:** The parent post is added to the Recurring Posts tab once scheduled. Users can access the edit function to change all recurring posts' time and date ranges.
- **Scheduled Posts:**Individual scheduled posts appear separately, and users can edit each as needed without affecting the others.
- **Platform Consideration:**It's important to be mindful of the policies of specific social platforms. For example, Twitter may flag content as repetitive if the recurring post feature is used excessively.
- **Long-term Strategy:** This feature allows for creating long-term content strategies, helping businesses stay in front of their audience without manually posting content regularly.
- **Images and Media:** Along with the text, users can add images or other media from their library or, through image AI, visually enrich the content.
- **Monitoring and Management:**Users can track and manage all their recurring posts through a simple interface, providing control over their social media content.

---

## **Use Cases**

- **Promoting Seasonal Offers:** A retail store can set recurring posts to promote seasonal sales, offers, or specific products at the beginning of each season. They can easily plan this for the entire year and forget the manual posting process.
- **Daily Inspirational Quotes:** A motivational speaker or life coach can schedule daily inspirational quotes to engage their audience and reinforce their brand messaging. This consistency helps in keeping the audience connected and engaged.
- **Weekly Tips or Tutorials:** A tech company or educational platform can set up weekly tutorials or tips to share with their followers. This regular content provides value and helps establish the company as an expert.
- **Celebrating Recurring Events:** A company can acknowledge and celebrate recurring events like employee birthdays, anniversaries, or national holidays, ensuring that these posts are never missed and adding a personal touch to the company's social media presence.
- **Monthly Product Showcases:** A manufacturer or distributor can showcase different products every month, providing information, features, and benefits to educate potential customers.
- **Content Repurposing**: For businesses with a rich content library (such as blogs or podcasts), recurring posts can periodically share or reshare this content to new followers or those who might have missed it the first time.
- **Reinforcing Brand Campaigns:** If a company has a year-long brand campaign or slogan, recurring posts can consistently remind followers of the brand's core message, ensuring that it stays fresh in their minds.
- **Reminder for Regular Events:** For organizations hosting regular events like webinars or community meet-ups, recurring posts can act as reminders, ensuring participants have the information they need to join.
- **Celebrating Historical Milestones:** Museums, historical societies, or educational institutions can use this feature to share historical facts or milestones on the corresponding dates, providing educational content to their followers.

---

## **How to Schedule Recurring Posts**

1. Go to **Marketing** > **Social** **Planner**.
2. Click on **New** **P****ost** > + **Create New post**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/vWUD7X1BNNPLK1lGTxql+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-01+at+21.18.11.png)
3. **Select** the **social account(s)** for your post. If you have not connected any social accounts yet, you can still set up the recurring schedule, and Social Planner prompts you to connect before you save or schedule.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/6AuoM6ndhEbWCkLwtM0g+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-01+at+21.19.55.png)
4. Create the post.
5. Click on **Posts** > **Schedule Recurring Posts.**  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Y9jkW0r3vurEGl80sANw+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-01+at+21.22.11.png)
6. **Day**: The user must choose the date and time of posting on repeat everyday.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/BxtKUv0FYWkybeZawwC5+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-01+at+21.24.48.png)
7. **Week:** Users will have to choose day of the week when they would like to repeat schedule between the date range and post time.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/QLmf03LU9EtaeUqiPox1+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-01+at+21.26.21.png)
8. **Month:** The user will have to choose the date and time of posting on repeat once in a month.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/HeOdIwtm4zTNqBs3NsGN+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-01+at+21.27.30.png)
9. **Year:** The user will have to choose the date and time of posting on repeat once in the year.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/r64vsRmnncMbIl3Er9Zd+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-01+at+21.28.51.png)
10. Once the recurring post is scheduled, the parent post will be added in **Content** > **Recurring** tab.
11. Click on **E****dit** to change the time and date range.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ygalDyvXJUC87Tr1lDAj+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-01+at+21.32.00.png)

---

## **Important Pointers**

**Inside the 'Content' tab view:**

- Parent post entry is visible and can be edited from here.
- **Edit:** It will update all entries of the iteration with the selected date and time range.
- **Delete:** Deletes all parent entries of recurring posts

**Inside the 'Calendar' view:**

- All individual posts are visible and can be edited from here.
- **Edit:** It will update all entries of the iteration with the selected date and time range.
- **Delete:** Deletes the individual recurring post

**Inside the 'List' view:**

- Immediate active scheduled post (to be published next) is visible and can be edited from here.
- **Edit:** It will update all entries of the iteration with the selected date and time range.
- **Delete:** Deletes the individual recurring post

---

## **System sanctity practices**

**Review Regularly:** Please review and update recurring posts regularly to ensure relevance, especially if there have been changes to products, offers, or brand messaging.

**Compliance with Platform Policies:** Different social media platforms have different policies regarding recurring and automated posts. Please be aware of and comply with each platform's guidelines to avoid potential issues.

**Time Zone Considerations:** If targeting a global audience, please consider scheduling posts according to the different time zones of your target demographics to maximize reach.

**Content Backup:** Please ensure a backup of all recurring content. Any technical issues could lead to loss of content, and having a backup will prevent unnecessary work in recreating it.

**Monitoring Performance:** Please note that analyzing the performance of recurring posts helps understand what resonates with the audience. Regularly monitoring insights can guide future content strategy.

**Sensitive Issues and Crisis Management:** Please be cautious with recurring posts during sensitive times or crises. Scheduled posts that may be inappropriate during unexpected events must be reviewed and managed accordingly.

**Integration with Other Campaigns:**If ongoing or planned marketing campaigns exist, please ensure that the recurring posts align with the overall marketing and branding strategies.

**Legal and Ethical Considerations:** Please be mindful of intellectual property rights, permissions, and other legal considerations when using images, quotes, or other content within recurring posts.

**Experiment and Iterate:** Recurring posts are a tool, and like any tool, they require experimentation to find the most effective way to use them. Please don't be afraid to try different strategies and iterate based on what you learn.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I set recurring posts for specific holidays or annual events?**

Yes, you can schedule recurring posts for specific dates, allowing you to automate posts for holidays or annual events like company anniversaries.

**Q: What happens if I edit the parent post of a recurring schedule?**

Editing the parent post will replicate the changes in child scheduled posts. However, changes made to individual child posts will not affect the parent post.

**Q: Can I mix media types, like images and videos, in my recurring posts?**

Yes, you can include various media types, such as images, videos, or GIFs, within the recurring posts to make them more engaging.

**Q: How does the recurring post feature interact with different time zones?**

You'll need to set the time for your recurring posts considering the time zone of your target audience. Be mindful of global audiences if applicable.

**Q: Is there a limit to how far in advance I can schedule recurring posts?**

Depending on the specific settings and platform guidelines, you may be able to schedule recurring posts for days, weeks, months, or even years in advance.

**Q: Can I pause or temporarily stop a recurring post series?**

You cannot pause or temporarily stop a recurring post series

**Q: What if I want different recurring posts for different social platforms?**

You can create unique recurring posts tailored to each social platform using the Customize Each Post functionality, allowing you to align the content with each network's specific character limits and guidelines.

**Q: Can recurring posts be part of a larger campaign with non-recurring content?**

Absolutely! You can integrate recurring posts with other marketing strategies and campaigns to create a cohesive and consistent brand message.

**Q: How can I ensure my recurring posts are accessible to all users, including those with disabilities?**

Incorporating accessibility features like captions, alt text, and other inclusive practices can make your recurring posts accessible to a broader audience.

**Q: How do I avoid making recurring posts feel too automated or impersonal?**

Mixing recurring posts with real-time, personalized content and engaging with your audience can help maintain a human touch in your social media presence.

---

title_en: Setting Up Reserve with Google for Local Services Ads
source_md:
Google has updated the Reserve with Google setup process for Local Services Ads. Businesses must now configure Google Organic Booking in HighLevel and link the correct Google Business Profile to their Local Services Ads account. This allows customers to discover services on Google and continue directly to the appropriate HighLevel booking experience.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is Reserve with Google for Local Services Ads?](#What-Is-Reserve-with-Google-for-Local-Services-Ads?)
- [Key Benefits of Reserve with Google](#Key-Benefits-of-Reserve-with-Google)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [Google Organic Booking Feeds](#Google-Organic-Booking-Feeds)
- [How to Set Up Reserve with Google for LSA](#How-to-Set-Up-Reserve-with-Google-for-LSA)
- [How Booking Activation Works](#How-Booking-Activation-Works)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions%E2%80%8B)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is Reserve with Google for Local Services Ads?**

Reserve with Google connects a business’s Google presence to its online booking experience. Google Organic Booking, also called Booking Redirect, provides the booking destinations that Google can display on a Google Business Profile.

The updated setup requires you to:

1. Configure Google Organic Booking feeds in HighLevel.
2. Link the Local Services Ads account to the correct Google Business Profile.
3. Wait for Google to review and publish the booking feeds.

After the required connections are approved, LSA booking is enabled automatically.

---

## **Key Benefits of Reserve with Google**

Reserve with Google gives customers a direct path from finding a business on Google to booking an appointment. Businesses can publish a main booking destination, individual services, or both.

- **Direct booking access:** Customers can begin booking from the business’s Google Business Profile.
- **Service-level booking:** Individual services can appear with their own Book buttons.
- **Centralized scheduling:** Appointments continue through the selected HighLevel calendars.
- **Fewer booking steps:** Customers can move from discovery to scheduling without searching for a separate booking page.
- **Flexible presentation:** Businesses can publish a Service Menu, Calendar Group, individual calendars, or a combination of these.
- **Automatic activation:** LSA booking is enabled after Google approves the feeds and the correct Google Business Profile is linked.

---

## **Before You Begin**

Accurate business and service information helps Google validate the submitted feeds. Complete the required calendar and Google account setup before uploading your booking information.

Confirm the following:

- You have access to the correct HighLevel subaccount.
- The required HighLevel calendars have been created.
- A Service Menu or Calendar Group is available for the Primary Action Feed.
- Each calendar selected as a service has a clear name and description.
- Calendar descriptions closely match the corresponding service names.
- The correct Google Business Profile is active and accessible.
- The Local Services Ads account can be linked to the correct Google Business Profile.
- Business and location details are consistent across HighLevel and Google.

**Important:** Inconsistent service names, descriptions, or location details may delay approval or prevent booking actions from appearing.

---

## **Google Organic Booking Feeds**

Google Organic Booking feeds determine which booking destinations appear on the Google Business Profile. HighLevel supports a main booking destination and individual service destinations.

### **Primary Action Feed**

The Primary Action Feed creates the main Book Online action on the Google Business Profile. It should direct customers to a page where they can review and select available services.

The Primary Action Feed uses one of the following:

- A Calendar Service Menu
- A Calendar Group

When customers select **Book Online**, they are redirected to the Service Menu or Group selected in HighLevel.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077537300/original/CIavyE9b6NYMPl-wHMuSLhy-KFFKu_K8nA.png?1785815647)**

### **Services Feed**

The Services Feed submits individual HighLevel calendars to Google as separate services. Approved services may appear on the Google Business Profile with their own Book buttons.

For each selected calendar:

- Use a clear, customer-facing service name.
- Add a description that accurately reflects the service.
- Keep the description consistent with the calendar or service name.
- Confirm that the calendar is configured for customer booking.
- Review staff, availability, duration, and scheduling settings.

Google controls whether and how each service appears on the Google Business Profile.

---

## **How to Set Up Reserve with Google for LSA**

The updated setup is completed from Calendar Settings in the HighLevel subaccount. Follow the steps in order to submit the correct booking feeds and connect them to the appropriate Google Business Profile.

### **Step 1:**Open Google Organic Booking Settings

Google Organic Booking is managed from the Connections area in Calendar Settings.

1. Open the appropriate HighLevel subaccount.
2. Go to **Calendars**.
3. Open **Calendar Settings**.
4. Select **Connections**.
5. Choose the appropriate user from the **My Staff** dropdown, if applicable.
6. Open the **Google Organic Booking** tab.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077537121/original/rJomGelhYabwK5g5nn4oR3Xz9ZAmWQBAdg.png?1785815004)**

### **Step 2:**Configure the Primary Action Feed

The Primary Action Feed controls the main booking destination displayed on the Google Business Profile.

1. Locate **Primary Action Feed (Service Menu/Group)**.
2. Open the dropdown.
3. Select the appropriate Service Menu or Calendar Group.
4. Confirm that the selected destination contains the correct services and booking links.

The Primary Action Feed is required in the current HighLevel interface.

### **Step 3:**Configure the Services Feed

The Services Feed allows Google to display individual calendars as separate bookable services.

1. Locate **Services Feed (Calendars)**.
2. Open the dropdown.
3. Select the calendars you want to publish.
4. Review the name and description of each selected calendar.
5. Confirm that each description clearly matches the service name.

### **Step 4:**Upload the Booking Feeds

Uploading sends the selected Primary Action Feed and Services Feed to Google for review.

1. Review the Primary Action Feed.
2. Review the calendars selected in the Services Feed.
3. Click **Upload**.
4. Allow Google time to review and publish the feeds.

Google typically takes **one to two weeks** to verify and publish booking feeds.

### **Step 5:**Link the LSA Account to the Google Business Profile

The Local Services Ads account must be associated with the correct Google Business Profile. This connection allows Google to match the advertiser, business location, and booking experience.

In Google Ads:

1. Sign in to the Google Ads account associated with the business.
2. Click the **Tools** icon.
3. Open **Data Manager**.
4. Find **Google Business Profile** under **Connected products**.
5. Select **Manage & link**.
6. Review linked profiles and pending invitations.
7. Link or confirm the correct Google Business Profile.
8. Verify that the correct business location is selected.

### When location assets are already in use, Google may display **View Location Assets** next to **Manage**. **Step 6:**Wait for Automatic Activation

LSA booking is enabled automatically after Google approves the feeds and the correct Google Business Profile is linked.

After setup:

1. Google reviews the uploaded booking feeds.
2. Google validates the business and service information.
3. Approved booking actions are published to the Google Business Profile.
4. Google associates the profile with the Local Services Ads account.
5. LSA booking becomes available automatically.

No separate Start Integration action is required in HighLevel.

---

## **How Booking Activation Works**

The updated process depends on both the HighLevel booking feeds and the Google account connection. Completing only one part of the setup will not activate LSA booking.

### **Google Organic Booking in HighLevel**

Google Organic Booking controls:

- The main Book Online destination
- Individual service booking destinations
- The calendars and service pages submitted to Google

### **Google Business Profile Link in Google**

The Google Business Profile link confirms:

- Which profile represents the advertiser
- Which business location should display booking actions
- Which LSA account should use the booking experience

### **Google Calendar Integration**

Google Calendar integration is used for event synchronization, availability, and conflict management.

Connecting Google Calendar does not publish booking actions to a Google Business Profile.

### **Google Business Profile Integration With HighLevel**

Connecting a Google Business Profile to HighLevel may support reputation management and other profile-related features.

This is separate from linking the Google Business Profile to the Local Services Ads or Google Ads account.

### **Disabling Google Organic Booking**

Disabling Google Organic Booking stops HighLevel from publishing the associated feeds.

Removal may take **24 to 48 hours** to appear on the Google Business Profile. This removal period is separate from the one-to-two-week review and publication timeline.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is Google Organic Booking required for LSA booking?**

Yes. Under the updated process, Google Organic Booking must be configured before Local Services Ads booking can activate.

**Q: What is the difference between the Primary Action Feed and the Services Feed?**

The Primary Action Feed creates the main Book Online destination using a Service Menu or Calendar Group. The Services Feed submits individual calendars so Google can display separate services with their own booking actions.

**Q: Why must the calendar description match the service name?**

Google uses the submitted name and description to validate the service. Missing, unclear, or unrelated descriptions may delay or prevent publication.

**Q: How long does it take for booking actions to appear?**

Google typically takes one to two weeks to verify and publish booking feeds.

**Q: Why is the Book Online button not appearing?**

Confirm that the feeds were uploaded, the correct Google Business Profile is linked, business and location details match, and the service names and descriptions are accurate.

**Q: Why does the main Book Online button appear while individual services do not?**

The Primary Action Feed and Services Feed may be reviewed separately. The main destination may be approved while individual services remain under review or are not approved.

**Q: Do I need to connect Google Calendar?**

Google Calendar synchronization is separate from Google Organic Booking. It may be useful for availability and conflict management, but it does not publish booking actions.

**Q: Should I upload the feeds again after changing a service?**

Yes. After changing a service name, description, calendar, Service Menu, or Calendar Group, return to Google Organic Booking and upload the updated feeds.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Google Organic Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001427)⁠
- [How to Create Service Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001159)⁠⁠
- [Integrating Google With HighLevel Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002369)⁠
- [How to Integrate Google Business Profile With HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001222899)⁠

title_en: Branded App Update: Live Sessions, Member Hub & More
source_md:
The Branded App has been redesigned to give members a faster, more connected mobile experience. Members can now join Live Sessions & Rooms directly from Communities, move more easily between their content and account areas, and manage important resources from the new Member Hub. The updated experience also introduces refreshed branding, simplified authentication, improved media performance, and a modern interface designed to support future improvements.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Updated Branded App?](#What-is-the-Updated-Branded-App?)
- [Key Benefits of the Updated Branded App](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Updated-Branded-App)
- [Live Sessions & Rooms](#Live-Sessions-&-Rooms)
- [Refreshed Sign-In and Welcome Experience](#Refreshed-Sign-In-and-Welcome-Experience)
- [Redesigned Home and Navigation](#Redesigned-Home-and-Navigation)
- [Member Hub](#Member-Hub)
- [Performance and Reliability Improvements](#Performance-and-Reliability-Improvements)
- [Automatic Migration to the Updated Branded App](#Automatic-Migration-to-the-Updated-Branded-App)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Updated Branded App?**

The updated Branded App brings HighLevel’s member-facing experiences together in a more modern mobile environment. Communities, Courses, account resources, live experiences, and other member tools are easier to discover and navigate without requiring members to move between disconnected experiences.

The Branded App continues to provide a native iOS and Android experience using your business branding. With the redesigned experience, members benefit from improved navigation, stronger performance, streamlined sign-in, and easier access to the resources connected to their account.

Existing members can continue accessing their resources using their current Client Portal login experience. HighLevel’s unified Client Portal architecture is designed to bring resources such as Courses, Communities, memberships, and billing together under one login.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Updated Branded App**

The redesigned Branded App reduces friction for members by making important content and account resources easier to access from one mobile experience. Performance and navigation improvements also help members spend less time finding content and more time engaging with your business.

- **Live Sessions & Rooms:** Members can join supported live audio and video experiences directly from their Communities.
- **Faster performance:** Improved app loading, navigation, and media performance create a smoother mobile experience.
- **Simplified member access:** A refreshed sign-in and sign-up experience makes it easier for members to access their resources.
- **Redesigned navigation:** Members can move more easily between Communities, Courses, Account, and other available areas.
- **Centralized Member Hub:** Billing, subscriptions, certificates, documents, contracts, and shared files are easier to locate from one member-focused area.
- **Consistent branding:** The refreshed welcome and member experience keeps your business branding visible throughout the app.
- **Improved reliability:** The updated app architecture supports greater stability and makes it easier to deliver future improvements.

---

## **Live Sessions & Rooms**

Live Sessions & Rooms make it easier for members to participate in real-time Community experiences without leaving the Branded App. Native live experiences can support video, audio, chat, reactions, screen sharing, and other interactive features depending on how the host configures the session.

Members can join supported Live Room events directly from the Community event experience. HighLevel’s Live Room functionality is built into Communities, allowing members to participate without needing a separate meeting application for native Live Room events.

HighLevel also supports Go Live sessions in Communities. Go Live can be used for interactive meeting rooms or broadcasts, and members can participate from supported web and mobile experiences.

To learn more about creating and hosting live experiences, see [Live Rooms in Communities Events](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007834-live-rooms-in-communities-events?utm_source=chatgpt.com) and [Communities - Use Go Live to Host Meetings & Broadcasts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006673?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

---

## **Refreshed Sign-In and Welcome Experience**

A simplified authentication experience helps members reach their content with fewer unnecessary steps. The redesigned welcome experience also provides a more consistent transition between your branding, member authentication, and the resources available after login.

HighLevel’s unified Client Portal experience consolidates access so members can use one login to view resources associated with their Client Portal identity, including Courses, Communities, memberships, and billing. Members do not need to be re-invited simply because the unified experience is enabled.

For members who previously had duplicate contacts using the same Client Portal identity, eligible resources can appear together under a single login. The underlying CRM contact records are not automatically merged.

---

## **Redesigned Home and Navigation**

The redesigned Home experience gives members a clearer starting point when opening the Branded App. Improved navigation reduces the need to search across separate experiences and helps members find relevant Courses, Communities, account resources, and other available content more quickly.

Depending on the resources available to the member, navigation can provide access to areas such as:

- Communities
- Courses
- Account
- Billing-related resources
- Shared files
- Additional member tools available through the app

HighLevel’s unified Client Portal architecture is designed to provide one navigation system across customer-facing resources while improving content discovery and mobile responsiveness.

---

## **Member Hub**

The Member Hub gives members a centralized place to find account-related resources without searching across multiple areas. The exact items available to each member depend on the resources and features associated with their account.

Members may use the Member Hub to access supported resources such as:

- Billing information
- Subscriptions
- Documents
- Documents & Contracts
- Certificates
- Shared files

Shared files and contact-record Documents are separate from HighLevel Documents & Contracts. Shared Documents are files associated with a contact record and made available through the Client Portal, while Documents & Contracts supports workflows such as proposals, contracts, estimates, signatures, and related document processes.

Members with access to shared document functionality can also upload supported files through the Client Portal experience. Uploaded files are associated with the member’s contact record in HighLevel.

Members with issued certificates can access supported certificate actions such as previewing, downloading, or sharing available certificates.

---

## **Performance and Reliability Improvements**

Faster loading and more responsive navigation help members interact with content without unnecessary delays. The updated architecture also creates a stronger foundation for delivering future improvements across HighLevel’s customer-facing experiences.

The updated Branded App includes improvements such as:

- Faster app launch
- Smoother navigation
- Improved image performance
- Improved audio performance
- Improved video performance
- Greater stability and reliability
- A modern foundation that supports faster delivery of future updates

HighLevel’s unified Client Portal is built on a shared modern architecture designed to improve performance across desktop and mobile experiences while supporting faster future development.

---

## **Automatic Migration to the Updated Branded App**

The Branded App update is designed to minimize disruption for existing members. Eligible Branded Apps are updated automatically, so members do not need to migrate their content manually or create a separate member experience solely because of the redesign.

For the Branded App release:

1. No manual app migration is required.
2. The updated Branded App is rolled out automatically to eligible apps.
3. Existing members continue using the member access provided through your Branded App.
4. You will receive an email when the applicable Branded App update is complete.

The Branded App rollout should not be confused with separate Client Portal activation or preview controls that may be available inside HighLevel. The Unified Client Portal can have its own enablement and migration process depending on the account experience.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do existing members need to create a new account?**

Existing members should continue using their established Client Portal access. HighLevel’s unified experience is designed to maintain member access without requiring members to be re-invited solely because of the interface upgrade.

**Q: Will duplicate CRM contacts be merged during the member migration?**

No. HighLevel’s Unified Client Portal can bring resources associated with the same Client Portal identity together under one member login, but duplicate CRM contact records are not automatically merged.

**Q: Can members participate in a live session instead of only watching it?**

Depending on the Live Room configuration and permissions set by the host, members can use supported interactive features such as audio, video, chat, reactions, and Raise Hand.

**Q: Are Shared Files and Documents & Contracts the same thing?**

No. Contact-record Documents and shared files are separate from HighLevel Documents & Contracts. Documents & Contracts supports workflows such as proposals, contracts, estimates, signatures, and related document processes.

**Q: Can members upload files through the updated member experience?**

Supported Client Portal experiences allow members to upload eligible document and image file types. Uploaded files are associated with the member’s contact record.

**Q: Will every member see the same options in the Member Hub?**

Not necessarily. Available resources depend on what has been configured or assigned to the member, such as billing information, certificates, documents, subscriptions, or shared files.

**Q: Does the Branded App update change existing workflows and automations?**

The redesigned unified Client Portal experience changes the member-facing experience without changing existing backend routing, workflows, automations, or integrations.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Unified Client Portal Experience](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008455-unified-client-portal-experience?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Live Rooms in Communities Events](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007834-live-rooms-in-communities-events?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Communities - Use Go Live to Host Meetings & Broadcasts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006673?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Client Portal Branded Mobile App: Setting up branding of your app](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004047-client-portal-branded-mobile-app-setting-up-branding-of-your-app?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [How to Share and Manage Documents via Client Portal and CRM](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005199-how-to-share-and-manage-documents-via-client-portal-and-crm-?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Upload Documents Through the Client Portal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008172-upload-documents-through-the-client-portal?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

#### **Deadline: 1 July 2026****Australia (+61) local numbers**

#### **Action required by 1 July 2026. Existing Australian local numbers not linked to an approved Regulatory Bundle will stop sending or receiving calls and messages after this date. There is no grace period.**

#### **Overview** To comply with updated Know Your Customer (KYC) rules in Australia, every Australian local number must be linked to an approved **Regulatory Compliance (RC) Bundle**. A bundle is a one-time set of identity and address documents that proves your business is a legitimate user of an AU local number. You only need to create the bundle once per sub-account. After approval, it can be linked to all Australian local numbers within that sub-account to maintain compliance with Australia's updated KYC requirements.

Troubleshooting & FAQs](#8.-Troubleshooting-&-FAQsQ%3A-My-bundle-was-rejected.-What-do-I-do?Open-the-rejected-bundle-to-see-the-reviewer's-note.-Common-causes%3A-blurry-document-scans,-mismatched-names-or-addresses-across-documents,-expired-ID,-or-business-name-not-matching-the-ASIC-record.-Fix-the-flagged-item-and-click-Resubmit.Q%3A-I-have-AU-mobile-or-toll-free-numbers-too.-Does-this-apply-to-them?Mobile-and-toll-free-numbers-also-require-bundles,-with-a-slightly-different-set-of-fields.-The-current-banner-only-flags-AU-local-numbers-%E2%80%94-additional-guidance-for-mobile-and-toll-free-will-be-published-separately-before-the-same-July-1,-2026-deadline.Q%3A-What-happens-if-I-miss-the-July-1,-2026-deadline?Any-AU-local-number-that-does-not-have-an-approved-bundle-linked-by-July-1,-2026-will-stop-receiving-calls-and-messages.-There-is-no-grace-period-and-no-partial-functionality.-The-number-may-also-be-reclaimed.Q%3A-Can-I-create-the-bundle-in-advance,-even-before-my-numbers-show-the-banner?Yes.-Bundles-can-be-created-and-approved-any-time-%E2%80%94-we-recommend-doing-this-as-early-as-possible-to-avoid-last-minute-rejections.Q%3A-I'm-an-agency.-Where-do-I-create-the-bundle?Create-the-bundle-inside-the-client's-sub-account,-using-the-client's-identity-or-business-details.-Bundles-are-sub-account-scoped-and-cannot-be-shared-across-sub-accounts.Q%3A-The-banner-won't-go-away.-What-do-I-do?The-banner-stays-visible-as-long-as-at-least-one-Australian-local-number-in-the-sub-account-is-missing-an-approved-bundle.-Refresh-the-page-after-linking.-If-it-still-shows-up,-go-to-Phone-Numbers-and-look-for-any-rows-that-still-display-the-Bundle-required-tag-%E2%80%94-those-are-the-numbers-that-haven't-been-linked-yet.Q%3A-Can-the-banner-be-dismissed-or-hidden?No.-The-banner-is-persistent-by-design-until-every-Australian-local-number-in-the-sub-account-has-an-approved-bundle-linked.-This-is-to-make-sure-the-deadline-isn't-missed.)

#### **1. Check which of your numbers need action**

1. #### In your sub-account, go to **Settings → Phone System → Phone Numbers**.

   ####
2. #### Look for the orange **"Action required"**banner at the top of the page. The banner shows how many Australian local numbers still require a Regulatory Bundle and includes a countdown to the July 1, 2026 compliance deadline. It also provides a quick shortcut to start the verification process.

   ####
3. #### In the number list, any AU local number that needs attention shows a **Bundle required** tag directly under the number.

   ####

#### **If you don't see the banner or the tag, your numbers are already compliant — no action needed.** **2. Decide which bundle type to create** Create a **Business** bundle in the client's sub-account using the client's company details — not your agency details.("Individual" bundles are not supported). **3. Gather the required documents** Have these ready before you start. Submissions are digitally verified, and incomplete business bundles get rejected — meaning you'll have to redo the flow.

- #### Registered business name
- #### Registered Australian business address (no PO Box)
- #### Business registration document (ASIC extract, ABN registration, or equivalent)
- #### Proof of physical AU street address (utility bill or lease agreement in the business name)
- #### Public-facing website **or** verified social media account for the business
- #### Authorised representative's Government-issued photo ID
- #### Proof that the authorised representative is allowed to act for the business (board resolution, letter of authorization, or director listing on the ASIC extract)

  ####

#### ****Tip:** Save all documents as PDF, JPG, or PNG under 5 MB each. Make sure text is sharp and the whole document is visible in frame — cropped or blurry uploads are the #1 reason for rejection.**

#### **4. Create the bundle**

1. #### In your sub-account, go to **Settings → Phone System → Regulatory Bundles**.
2. #### Click **Create Bundle**.
3. #### Select **Country: Australia** and **Number type: Local**.
4. #### Select **Bundle type:****Business**.(individual is not supported)
5. #### Fill in all required fields. Match each field exactly to what appears on your supporting documents (e.g., if your ID lists your middle name, include it).
6. #### Upload the supporting documents in the upload step.
7. #### Click **Save as draft** at any point if you need to come back later.

#### **5. Submit the bundle for review**

1. #### Review the summary screen — every field and every uploaded document.
2. #### Click **Submit for review**.
3. #### You'll see the bundle status change to **In review**.

#### Review typically takes **1–3 business days**. You can close the tab; you don't need to keep the page open. You'll get an in-app notification and an email when the bundle is either **Approved** or **Rejected**. If rejected, the message will tell you which field or document needs to be fixed — update those and resubmit. The bundle keeps the same record, so you don't start from scratch. **6. Link the approved bundle to your AU local numbers** Once your bundle status shows **Approved**, you can link it to your numbers.

1. #### Go to **Settings → Phone System → Phone Numbers**.
2. #### Find the AU number with the **Bundle required** tag.
3. #### Click the **⋯** menu on the right → **Select AU Regulatory Bundle to Link**.
4. #### Choose your approved bundle from the list.  You can repeat this process for any additional Australian local numbers in the same sub-account. The same approved bundle can be reused across all eligible AU local numbers.

#### 

#### One approved bundle can be linked to as many AU local numbers as you have in the sub-account. You do not need a separate bundle per number. **7. Confirm everything is compliant** After linking:

- #### The orange banner should disappear from the Phone Numbers page.
- #### Each AU local number should now show a green **KYC Linked** tag instead of **Bundle required**.
- If you still see the banner, refresh the page. If it persists, check whether you have additional AU local numbers in the sub-account that haven't been linked yet.

  ####

#### **8. Troubleshooting & FAQs** **Q: My bundle was rejected. What do I do?** Open the rejected bundle to see the reviewer's note. Common causes: blurry document scans, mismatched names or addresses across documents, expired ID, or business name not matching the ASIC record. Fix the flagged item and click **Resubmit**. **Q: I have AU mobile or toll-free numbers too. Does this apply to them?** Mobile and toll-free numbers also require bundles, with a slightly different set of fields. The current banner only flags AU **local** numbers — additional guidance for mobile and toll-free will be published separately before the same July 1, 2026 deadline. **Q: What happens if I miss the July 1, 2026 deadline?** Any AU local number that does not have an approved bundle linked by July 1, 2026 will stop receiving or sending calls and messages. There is no grace period and no partial functionality. **Q: Can I create the bundle in advance, even before my numbers show the banner?** Yes. Bundles can be created and approved any time — we recommend doing this as early as possible to avoid last-minute rejections. **Q: I'm an agency. Where do I create the bundle?** Create the bundle inside the client's sub-account, using the client's identity or business details. Bundles are sub-account-scoped and cannot be shared across sub-accounts. **Q: The banner won't go away. What do I do?** The banner stays visible as long as at least one Australian local number in the sub-account is missing an approved bundle. Refresh the page after linking. If it still shows up, go to **Phone Numbers** and look for any rows that still display the `Bundle required` tag — those are the numbers that haven't been linked yet. **Q: Can the banner be dismissed or hidden?** No. The banner is persistent by design until every Australian local number in the sub-account has an approved bundle linked. This is to make sure the deadline isn't missed.

#### Still stuck? Contact support with your bundle ID and a screenshot of the rejection message (if applicable) — that's the fastest path to a resolution.

title_en: How to Create & Add Dashboard Widgets
source_md:
Dashboard widgets help you track important business metrics in one place. HighLevel's Widget Gallery makes it easier to find the right widgets by showing chart previews and descriptions before you add them. Search by purpose, browse recommended widgets, filter by reporting module, or switch between Gallery and List views to discover the metrics you need. This guide explains how to find, add, customize, and organize dashboard widgets using the Widget Gallery.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is the Widget Gallery?](#what-is-widget-gallery)
- [Key Benefits of the Widget Gallery](#key-benefits)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#prerequisites)
- [How to Add Dashboard Widgets](#add-dashboard-widgets)
- [Using the Widget Gallery in Custom Reports](#custom-reports)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#frequently-asked-questions)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **What Is the Widget Gallery?**

The Widget Gallery is a visual library of built-in reporting widgets available when creating or editing HighLevel dashboards and Custom Reports.

Each widget includes a preview of its chart style and a description of what it measures, allowing you to review the available options before adding a widget.

You can browse recommended widgets, search by reporting purpose, filter by module, and switch between **Gallery** and **List** views.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Widget Gallery**

The Widget Gallery simplifies dashboard creation by helping you discover the right reporting widgets without relying on trial and error.

- **Visual previews:** See whether a widget uses a number, donut chart, bar chart, line chart, or another supported visualization.
- **Widget descriptions:** Use the information icon to understand what a widget measures.
- **Intent-based search:** Search using terms related to your reporting goal.
- **Recommended widgets:** Discover suggestions based on account activity, including starter widgets for newer accounts.
- **Flexible browsing:** Switch between Gallery and List views or browse reporting categories.
- **Module filters:** Narrow widget results across supported reporting modules.
- **Quick adding:** Select a widget from the gallery to add it to your dashboard.
- **New widget indicators:** Identify recently released widgets with the **New** tag.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

Before adding widgets, make sure you can access and edit the dashboard you want to customize.

- You must be working in a HighLevel **Sub-Account**.
- You need **Edit** or **Full** permission to modify a dashboard. **View** permission is read-only.
- You can add widgets to an existing dashboard or create a new dashboard.
- Available configuration options depend on the widget you select.
- The Widget Gallery is available in dashboards and Custom Reports.

---

## **How to Add Dashboard Widgets**

Use the following steps to open the Widget Gallery, find the reporting widgets you need, and add them to your dashboard.

### **Step 1:**Open Your Dashboard

1. From your HighLevel **Sub-Account**, select **Dashboard** from the left navigation menu.
2. Open the **Dashboard Selection** menu.
3. Select the dashboard you want to customize.
4. Click **Edit Dashboard** to enter Edit mode.
5. Open the Widget Gallery from the dashboard editor.

To create a new dashboard instead, open **Dashboard Selection**, select **+ Add Dashboard**, choose a blank dashboard, enter the dashboard information, configure its visibility, and confirm the new dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084152613/original/3c46eQvawKkHSTCfVTcPE820ZkGtiTfOJQ.png?1792975861)

### **Step 2:**Browse Recommended Widgets

The **Recommended for your business** section highlights widgets based on account activity. New accounts can also see popular starter widgets.

Examples of recommended widgets can include:

- **Contacts count:** View the total number of contacts.
- **Opened Opportunities:** View the number of currently open opportunities.
- **Contacts by source:** Compare contacts based on their source.
- **Won Opportunities:** View the number of opportunities marked as won.

Below the recommendations, **Browse by category** organizes widgets into expandable reporting categories.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084152515/original/6QDOQeYT1Cc1BxggMEh0S5GaF9Jl6XIazw.png?1792975420)**

### **Step 3:**Preview Widgets in Gallery View

Gallery view displays widgets as visual cards so you can compare their appearance before adding them to your dashboard.

1. In the Widget Gallery, select the **Gallery view** icon beside the search field.
2. Browse the available widget cards.
3. Review each widget's chart preview and name.
4. Use the **information icon** to review what the widget displays.
5. Look for the **New** tag to identify recently released widgets.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084152679/original/gVtSdneQDDgZxQGxKb9hnr9GRmxqs_2Zbw.png?1792976247)**

### **Step 4:**Search and Filter Widgets

Use search and module filters to narrow the Widget Gallery to the reporting metrics you need.

**Search for a widget**

1. Select **Search widgets**.
2. Enter a metric, keyword, or reporting goal.
3. Review the matching widgets.

For example, searching for **no show** can help you find appointment-related widgets for no-show counts and trends over time.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084152830/original/vBVkWlkq6TGdhs539jvA-ghU2TlFDgN_rg.png?1792976800)

**Filter by module**

1. Select the **filter** control beside the Gallery and List view options.
2. Use **Search modules** to locate a reporting category when needed.
3. Select the modules you want to include.
4. Use **Select all** or **Clear all** to quickly adjust the selection.

The Widget Gallery includes the following reporting modules:

| **Module** | **Module** | **Module** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| General | Contacts | Appointments |
| Opportunities | Visitor Data | Emails |
| SMS | Calls | Conversations |
| Payments | Meta Ads | Google Ads |
| Social Planner | Reputation | Google Analytics |

The module filter also displays the number of available widgets associated with each reporting area.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084152917/original/lx3rrDDWP3WV9yFGbCQ8l9BnvwWWJnYZKA.png?1792977066)**

### **Step 5:**Switch to List View

List view displays widgets in a more compact format with smaller previews and descriptions.

1. Select the **List view** icon beside the Gallery view icon.
2. Browse the widgets in the available reporting categories.
3. Expand or collapse categories to narrow the list.
4. Review the widget name and description before selecting it.

You can switch back to Gallery view whenever you prefer larger visual previews.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084152998/original/oOIr2DcmFafjSjef9rlWnHsMvnzvPtsaMA.png?1792977511)**

### **Step 6:**Add a Widget to Your Dashboard

Once you find the right widget, add it directly from the Widget Gallery.

1. Locate the widget in Gallery or List view.
2. Review its preview and description.
3. Hover over the widget card to view its available add control.
4. Select the widget to add it to the dashboard canvas.
5. Repeat the process to add additional widgets.

The widget appears on your dashboard, where you can arrange or customize it as needed.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084152971/original/CMCP9-cTUTMjAhEXUYocCmb0bSlaks7lPQ.png?1792977424)**

### **Step 7:**Customize and Save Your Dashboard

After adding widgets, customize their settings and organize the dashboard to create a useful reporting layout.

**Customize a widget**

1. While in **Edit Dashboard** mode, locate the widget you want to customize.
2. Open the widget's available editing controls.
3. Use the available configuration options to adjust the widget.
4. Depending on the widget, settings can include:  
     
   - **Title**
   - **Metrics**
   - **Chart settings**
   - **Date range**
   - **Conditions**
5. Save the widget configuration when finished.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084153090/original/9yZsnjVUIAEXyoCN9td6aLvADzqbX3OrOw.png?1792978169)

**Arrange your dashboard**

1. Drag widgets to reposition them.
2. Resize widgets as needed.
3. Save your dashboard changes when you finish arranging the layout.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084153149/original/XQpg8LGRaDqgMQkU2CHWq0GWKvzfBRN2jg.png?1792978467)

```
Note: Available widget configuration and saving controls can vary depending on the widget and dashboard editor.
```

---

## **Using the Widget Gallery in Custom Reports**

The Widget Gallery is also available when creating or editing Custom Reports. You can use the same search tools, widget previews, recommendations, and reporting categories to discover widgets.

1. From your HighLevel **Sub-Account**, select **Reporting**.
2. Open **Custom Reports**.
3. Create a new report or open an existing Custom Report.
4. Enter the **Report Builder**.
5. Open the **Widgets** area.
6. Browse recommended widgets, search by purpose, or filter by module.
7. Review the available widget previews and descriptions.
8. Add the selected widget using the available Report Builder controls.
9. Configure the widget if needed, then save the report.

The **Themes**, **Custom metrics**, and **Elements** tabs remain available alongside the widget library.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084153236/original/0a2Fw63i-Ts8oEjC1scciuOl3DvUX8K9WQ.png?1792978778)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I preview a widget before adding it?**

Yes. Gallery view displays a visual preview of each built-in widget. You can also use the information icon to learn what the widget displays.

**Q: Can I search for widgets without knowing their exact names?**

Yes. Search using a reporting goal or related keyword, such as **no show**, to find relevant widgets.

**Q: What is the difference between Gallery view and List view?**

Gallery view emphasizes larger visual widget previews. List view displays widgets in a more compact format with their names and descriptions.

**Q: Are recommended widgets the same for every account?**

No. Recommendations can be based on account activity. New accounts can also see popular starter widgets.
