title_en: Self-Service Whitelabelled Mobile App Customizer
source_md:
Launch a fully branded iOS and Android app—without developers or tickets. HighLevel’s Self‑Service Whitelabelled Mobile App Customizer guides you from branding to App Store/Google Play release with live build tracking, flexible release tracks, and priority updates. Own your brand, control your rollout, and ship on your schedule.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Self‑Service Whitelabelled Mobile App Customizer?](#What-is-the-Self%E2%80%91Service-Whitelabelled-Mobile-App-Customizer?)
- [Key Benefits of the Self‑Service Customizer](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Self%E2%80%91Service-Customizer)
- [Prerequisites](#Prerequisites)
- [Branding](#Branding)
- [Package & Bundle Identifiers](#Package-&-Bundle-Identifiers)
- [Store Listing Preparation](#Store-Listing-Preparation)
- [Migrating from an Existing Whitelabel App](#Migrating-from-an-Existing-Whitelabel-App)
- [How To Setup the Self‑Service Customizer](#How-To-Setup-the-Self%E2%80%91Service-Customizer)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is the Self‑Service Whitelabelled Mobile App Customizer?**

The Self‑Service Whitelabelled Mobile App Customizer is a guided workspace in HighLevel that lets agencies create, brand, build, and publish their own iOS & Android apps. It centralizes branding, module selection, store listing prep, connection to App Store Connect and Google Play Console, and one‑click build/release controls—so teams can go live quickly and update reliably.

High‑level capabilities include:

- End‑to‑end flow from branding to live publishing
- Interactive wizards for Apple/Google connections
- Automatic package/bundle identifier creation
- Module toggles and navigation layout control
- Live build status and release track options
- Priority access to new app versions

---

## **Key Benefits of the Self‑Service Customizer**

Understanding the value helps you plan implementation and team workflows. These benefits highlight how the customizer reduces time‑to‑market, improves brand consistency, and streamlines future updates across iOS and Android.

- **Speed to Market:**Go from idea to App Store/Google Play submission quickly using guided steps and pre‑checks.
- **No Dev Dependency:** Build and release without engineers or support tickets.
- **On‑Brand Experience:** Upload icons/logos, set colors & fonts, and choose modules/navigation for a consistent mobile presence.
- **Priority Updates:** Access new versions ahead of the free apps and choose when to roll them out.
- **Flexible Releases:**Ship to Internal for testing or Production when you’re ready.
- **Operational Control:** Trigger builds, track status live, and manage changelogs.
- **Consistency at Scale:**Standardized workflows reduce errors and accelerate recurring releases.

---

## **Prerequisites**

Meeting requirements up front avoids store rejections and build delays. Confirm organizational accounts, identifiers, and policy pages before you start.

- A valid D‑U‑N‑S number (Apple requirement)
- Apple Developer Program – Organization account with App Store Connect access
- Google Play Console – Organization account
- HighLevel subscription for Custom Agency App (Monthly or Quarterly) to enable builds & publishing
- Policy URLs hosted and accessible publicly: Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions
- Recommended roles/permissions:  
    
  - **Apple:**Admin or App Manager rights in App Store Connect
  - **Google:** Admin or Release Manager in Play Console

---

## **Branding**

Branding ensures your mobile app looks and feels like your business from the splash screen to the login screen and icons in both light and dark modes. Here you can configure,

- App icon (platform‑appropriate sizes)
- Splash screen & login logos (light and dark variants)
- Primary colors (HEX) and brand fonts

### **Best practices**

- Use high‑resolution, square source artwork for icons.
- Provide both light and dark logo variants to ensure readability.
- Aim for WCAG‑friendly contrast ratios for text over backgrounds.

---

## **Package & Bundle Identifiers**

Every app needs unique identifiers for Apple and Google. The customizer auto‑generates these to reduce store rejections and collisions.

### **Automatic logic**

- **Suggested Pattern:**com.domain.appname\_uniqueString
- Generated During Creation after you provide App Name and Domain Name

### **Guidelines**

- Avoid changing identifiers after your first production release.
- Keep your package/applicationId (Android) and bundle identifier (iOS) stable to preserve update continuity.

---

## **Store Listing Preparation**

A strong listing helps with compliance and discoverability. Prepare accurate content and compliant policy links to minimize reviewer questions.

### **Fields Commonly Included**

- App title, short and long descriptions
- Support email
- Privacy Policy URL and Terms & Conditions URL
- Category/keywords (platform‑specific)

---

## **Migrating from an Existing Whitelabel App**

If you already run a whitelabel app, you can adopt the self‑service flow for faster updates while preserving continuity for users and store listings.

**Recommendations**

- Keep existing bundle/application identifiers unchanged to maintain update paths.
- Sync store listing content in the customizer so future releases stay consistent.
- Start with Internal builds to validate upgrade behavior before Production.

---

## **How To Setup the Self‑Service Customizer**

These steps walk you from creation to live release with clear checkpoints. Completing them in order reduces review issues and speeds approval.

1. **Open the Customizer:**Navigate to the Agency view and Click on Mobile App.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060104847/original/NdxVcMiYG50zhyJCbxyy8YvBbAbh1X8iHw.png?1765191363)
2. **Choose Your App:**Click on the "Selected App icon" to learn about the app and to change other app versions.Enter App Name and Domain Name. The system auto‑generates a unique package/bundle identifier.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060105080/original/S393LOGtTVFw6TlBcxTW_MFgfaVyrKga2A.png?1765191433)![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060105505/original/pIVN6mC59AfjVfJrgc_e2nOSAoffhHGi2g.jpeg?1765191607)
3. **Brand Your App:**Click on **"Customisation > Branding".**Then, upload app icon, login & splash logos (light/dark) under Branding page.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062057933/original/a9EW9ziZAUUYNgHAM-v3F3TGeSWsk5gJ6w.png?1767727905)
4. **Customization:**Customization

   **A. Login Screen**

   Configure logo, brand colors, optional tagline.

   **B. Core Navigation**

   Choose Bottom Nav (4–5 items) or Left Drawer (many items).

   Add/reorder modules (e.g., Notifications, Conversations, POS, Calendar, Apps).

   If you hit the limit, move extras to the App Drawer.

   **C. App Drawer**

   Organize remaining modules into categories; reorder as needed.

   Tap to Pay note: Add POS (and/or Invoices/Estimates) here or in Core Nav to unlock payments features.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062058418/original/NDo0JHosyylEOQ7II1jFxNDsn_g-1pv3-Q.png?1767728717)
5. **Distribution → Profile (Store Listing)**

   Fill App Name, Descriptions, Support email/URL.

   Add Privacy Policy & Terms URLs.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062058716/original/51embLkW31rUunyVcaSvM0m6Wh5kCbsegw.png?1767729053)
6. **Distribution → Channels (Connect Stores)**

   Connect App Store Connect and Play Console via the wizards.

   Ensure both show Connected (green).  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062058759/original/d88VQkpIZjC0pezZhT8Oxfb-gNpGCr9Big.png?1767729141)
7. **Subscription**

   Choose Monthly or Quarterly to unlock building and publishing.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062058771/original/syieaYBIJ214MLsTjN8RhGk0UQyMdOq2_w.png?1767729174)
8. **Build & Release**

   Create App (first time only).

   Generate Build: choose Internal (testing) or Production, add changelog, Start App Build.

   Release: Submit in Applestore/Play Console; track in Live Build Status.

   If a build fails, click View Progress → Visit knowledge base to diagnose the issue and Retry Build

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062058819/original/GDscRAb114OO9Xy1UcJ9Rxos6dRIpAEAxQ.png?1767729298)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need an Apple Developer Organization account?**A: Yes. Apple Individual accounts are not supported for whitelabel publishing.

**Q: Can I change the package/bundle identifier later?**A: Avoid changing it after your first production release; doing so creates a new app and breaks update continuity.

**Q: What does Internal vs Production mean?**A: Internal is for testing with your team; Production is the public release in the stores.

**Q: How do priority updates work?**A: You receive new versions earlier than the free apps and can choose when to ship them via the customizer.

**Q: My build failed—what should I check first?**A: Review the error in Live Build Status, confirm store connections, validate asset sizes, and re‑trigger the build.

**Q: Where do I manage billing?**A: In Mobile App, open the subscription card to purchase, change, or cancel your plan.

**Q: Are all HighLevel mobile features available in whitelabel apps?**A: Feature availability generally matches the core app, but depends on your selected modules and platform policies.

**Q: How long does store review take?**A: Timelines vary by Apple/Google. Submitting complete metadata and compliant assets typically speeds approval.

**Q: Can I test on real devices before Production?**A: Yes. Use Internal builds (and platform‑specific test programs) to validate on devices prior to public release.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Setting up an Apple Developer Account for your Whitelabel Mobile App](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982208)
- [Setting up a Google Developer Account for your Whitelabel Mobile App](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982209)
- [Enable Tap to Pay on Your Whitelabelled Mobile App](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006767)
- [Linking Apple Appstore account to the Whitelabel Mobile App Customizer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000007232?portalId=48000045315)
- [Linking Google PlayStore account to the Whitelabel Mobile App Customizer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000007233?portalId=48000045315)

title_en: How to View Test Call Logs in the Voice AI Dashboard
source_md:
Voice AI test call logs help you review how an agent performed during testing without affecting live analytics. Test calls can be reviewed alongside live call activity in **Dashboard & Logs** using the **Live/Test** filter. This article explains how to find test calls, review recordings and transcripts, and understand why test calls are excluded from dashboard performance metrics.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Test Call Logs in Voice AI?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-are-Test-Call-Logs-in-Voice-AI?)
- [Key Benefits of Test Call Logs in the Voice AI Dashboard](#Key-Benefits-of-Test-Call-Logs-in-the-Voice-AI-Dashboard)
- [Test Calls vs. Live Calls](#Test-Calls-vs.-Live-Calls)
- [When to Review Test Call Logs](#When-to-Review-Test-Call-Logs)
- [How To View Test Call Logs in the Voice AI Dashboard](#How-To-View-Test-Call-Logs-in-the-Voice-AI-Dashboard)
- [What You Can Review in a Test Call Log](#What-You-Can-Review-in-a-Test-Call-Log)
- [Why Test Calls Are Excluded from Analytics](#Why-Test-Calls-Are-Excluded-from-Analytics)
- [All Agents vs. Agent-Specific Logs](#All-Agents-vs.-Agent-Specific-Logs)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Test Call Logs in Voice AI?**

Test call logs are records created when a Voice AI agent is tested before or after launch. These logs help you review the agent’s responses, confirm expected behavior, and identify improvements before sending live customer calls to the agent.

Test call logs can include details such as call recordings, transcripts, call timing, agent information, and other available call details. They are useful for quality assurance and troubleshooting, but they do not count toward dashboard analytics or performance metrics.

---

## **Key Benefits of Test Call Logs in the Voice AI Dashboard**

Test call logs make it easier to validate Voice AI behavior before relying on the agent for live calls. By reviewing test activity separately from live calls, teams can improve prompts, call settings, and actions without affecting production reporting.

- **Review test conversations:** Listen to recordings and read transcripts from test calls.

- **Validate agent behavior:** Confirm the agent responds correctly before going live.

- **Troubleshoot safely:** Investigate issues without impacting live call analytics.

- **Compare live and test activity:** Use the Live/Test filter to switch between call types.

- **Protect reporting accuracy:** Keep test activity out of dashboard performance metrics.

---

## **Test Calls vs. Live Calls**

Understanding the difference between test calls and live calls helps you use logs correctly. Test calls are designed for validation and troubleshooting, while live calls represent real customer interactions that contribute to production performance analysis.

- **Test Calls:** Calls made while testing a Voice AI agent.

- **Live Calls:** Real customer calls handled by the Voice AI agent.

Test calls appear in logs so you can review them, but they are excluded from dashboard analytics and performance metrics.

---

## **When to Review Test Call Logs**

Test call logs are most useful when making changes to an agent or validating behavior before live deployment. Reviewing logs after each major update helps catch issues early and gives teams a reliable way to confirm the agent is ready.

Use test call logs when:

- Testing a new Voice AI agent.

- Updating prompts, call settings, custom values, or actions.

- Checking Web Call or Phone Call test results.

- Reviewing recordings and transcripts for quality assurance.

- Confirming whether a test call was logged successfully.

- Validating behavior before assigning numbers or sending live calls to the agent.

---

## **How To View Test Call Logs in the Voice AI Dashboard**

Test call logs are available from the **Dashboard & Logs** area in Voice AI. Use the logs table and **Live/Test** filter to focus on test activity, live activity, or both.

### **Go to AI Agents > Voice AI**

Open **AI Agents**, then select **Voice AI**. This area contains Voice AI agents, dashboard analytics, and call logs.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073886535/original/NZdw8uEh4wUR1W8zXXVqFrJfArMjvs0j0Q.png?1781702781)

### **Open Dashboard & Logs**

Select **Dashboard & Logs** to view Voice AI performance information and call activity. The dashboard includes analytics cards, charts, filters, and the logs table.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073886742/original/wNjC72GYr-uOuGXQ6FXzunJvLuVTfcMHUg.png?1781702901)

### **Choose All Agents or a specific agent**

Use the agent filter to view call activity for all agents or narrow the logs to one specific Voice AI agent. This helps you find test calls faster when multiple agents are being tested.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073890497/original/ZGlJEiVMCq7B345sLrYSeVwh7-Ell3l-Xg.png?1781704409)

### **Check the date range**

Use the date range picker to make sure the expected test call date is included. If a test call is missing, the selected date range is one of the first settings to review.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073890692/original/F8BcCT_imEn2URpDHfZXl97JQtewemQNRQ.png?1781704468)

### **Locate the logs table**

Scroll to the logs table below the dashboard analytics area. Test calls are reviewed in the logs table, not in the dashboard metric cards.

Open the **Live/Test** filter in the logs table. Select the option that matches the type of calls you want to review.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073890886/original/SrPM6mmU-QNDIPD1bvAhGXL_CCnBEbOUGw.png?1781704591)

### **Open a test call entry**

Select a test call entry to review available call details. Depending on the call, you may be able to review the recording, transcript, contact or caller details, agent name, date and time, call outcome, and other logged activity.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073891260/original/KEASsf1YnfffsHo3rxg9PvuQk48WYqWWEA.png?1781704731)

### **Clear or change the filter**

When you are finished reviewing test calls, clear or change the **Live/Test** filter to return to live calls or the combined logs view.

---

## **What You Can Review in a Test Call Log**

Test call logs provide useful context for understanding how a Voice AI agent handled a test conversation. Reviewing these details can help you identify gaps in instructions, routing behavior, action triggers, or caller experience.

Depending on the call data available, a test call log may include:

- Call recording

- Call transcript

- Agent name

- Contact or caller details

- Date and time

- Call status or outcome

- Actions triggered during the call

- Conversation details useful for troubleshooting

Use the transcript and recording together when possible. The transcript helps you scan the conversation quickly, while the recording helps confirm tone, timing, silence, interruptions, and caller experience.

---

## **Why Test Calls Are Excluded from Analytics**

Test calls are meant for internal review, troubleshooting, and quality assurance. Excluding them from dashboard analytics keeps reporting focused on real customer interactions and prevents testing activity from changing production performance metrics.

Test calls can appear in logs with recordings and transcripts, but they do not affect metrics such as live call totals, call outcomes, sentiment, completed calls, actions triggered, or other dashboard performance reporting.

---

## **All Agents vs. Agent-Specific Logs**

Dashboard & Logs can be used to review activity across all Voice AI agents or for one selected agent. Choosing the right view helps you find the correct test call faster and prevents confusion when multiple agents are being tested.

Use **All Agents** when you want to review test activity across every Voice AI agent in the sub-account.

Use an **agent-specific view** when you only want to review calls for one selected Voice AI agent.

If the wrong calls are showing, check the selected agent filter, date range, and Live/Test filter.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Where can I see Voice AI test calls?**  
Go to **AI Agents > Voice AI > Dashboard & Logs**, then use the logs table and **Live/Test** filter to view test calls.

**Q: What is the Live/Test filter?**  
The **Live/Test** filter lets you control whether the logs table shows live calls, test calls, or both.

**Q: Are test calls counted in Voice AI dashboard metrics?**  
No. Test calls appear in logs for review, but they are excluded from dashboard analytics and performance metrics.

**Q: Can I view recordings and transcripts for test calls?**  
Yes, test call logs can include recordings and transcripts when those details are available and processing is complete.

**Q: What is the difference between test calls and live calls?**  
Test calls are used to validate or troubleshoot a Voice AI agent. Live calls are real customer calls handled by the agent.

**Q: Can I filter test calls for a specific agent?**

Yes. Select the specific agent in **Dashboard & Logs**, then use the **Live/Test** filter to view test call activity for that agent.

**Q: Why can’t I find my test call?**  
Check the selected date range, agent filter, and **Live/Test** filter. Also confirm the test call completed successfully.

**Q: Do Web Call tests appear in logs?**  
Web Call tests may appear in logs after completion. Use the **Live/Test** filter, correct agent selection, and date range to find them.

**Q: Should I review test call logs before deploying an agent live?**  
Yes. Reviewing test call logs helps confirm the agent responds correctly before live callers interact with it.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Testing Voice AI Agents in HighLevel: Calls and Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004108-testing-voice-ai-agents)⁠

- [Voice AI Agents Dashboard Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004693-voice-ai-agents-dashboard)⁠

- [Guide on How to Use Voice AI Agent Logs in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007687-voice-ai-agent-logs)⁠

- [Call Logs for Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005900-call-logs-for-voice-ai-agents)⁠

- [Use Web Call to Test Voice AI Agents Without Buying a Phone Number](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007566-use-web-call-to-test-voice-ai-agents-without-buying-a-phone-number)⁠

- [Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006680-voice-ai-outbound-calling-dashboard)⁠

title_en: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to LeadConnector MCP
source_md:
LeadConnector MCP lets compatible OpenAI clients securely work with supported CRM data and actions through the Model Context Protocol. ChatGPT and Codex can connect through a dedicated OpenAI endpoint using OAuth, so you do not need to manually create or rotate a Private Integration Token for this connection.

You choose which supported sub-account or sub-accounts the connection can access and approve the requested permissions. This guide explains how LeadConnector MCP works, how to connect ChatGPT or Codex, and how to verify that the available CRM tools are working.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is LeadConnector MCP for OpenAI Clients?](#what-is-leadconnector-mcp)
- [Key Benefits of LeadConnector MCP for OpenAI Clients](#key-benefits)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#prerequisites)
- [How LeadConnector MCP Works](#how-it-works)
- [How to Connect ChatGPT to LeadConnector MCP](#connect-chatgpt)
- [How to Connect Codex to LeadConnector MCP](#connect-codex)
- [How to Verify the Connection](#verify-connection)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **What Is LeadConnector MCP for OpenAI Clients?**

LeadConnector MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that lets compatible AI clients securely interact with supported CRM data and operations.

ChatGPT, Codex, and other compatible OpenAI clients connect through the dedicated OpenAI MCP endpoint:

```
https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/openai/v2/
```

The connection uses OAuth. During authorization, you sign in to LeadConnector, choose the supported sub-account or sub-accounts the connection can access, and approve the requested permissions.

After connecting, the AI client can discover and execute supported CRM operations allowed by your OAuth authorization.

---

## **Key Benefits of LeadConnector MCP for OpenAI Clients**

LeadConnector MCP gives compatible OpenAI clients broad CRM access through a small, controlled toolset instead of requiring hundreds of individual integrations.

- **OAuth authentication:** Connect through the LeadConnector sign-in and consent flow without manually creating or rotating a Private Integration Token.
- **Controlled CRM access:** Approve only the permissions included in your OAuth grant.
- **Sub-account control:** Choose which supported sub-account or sub-accounts the connection can access.
- **Broad CRM coverage:** Access more than 550 active operations across 38 CRM domains through the current LeadConnector MCP catalog.
- **Unified toolset:** Use four MCP tools to discover, inspect, and execute supported CRM operations.
- **Natural-language actions:** Ask ChatGPT or Codex to perform supported CRM tasks without manually calling individual API endpoints.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

A successful connection requires both a compatible OpenAI client and access to the LeadConnector account or sub-accounts you want to authorize.

Before connecting:

- Use an OpenAI client that supports remote Streamable HTTP MCP servers.
- Make sure you can sign in to the applicable LeadConnector account.
- You must have access to the CRM sub-account or sub-accounts you want to authorize.
- Your OAuth permissions determine which operations the OpenAI client can use.
- ChatGPT availability and MCP capabilities depend on your ChatGPT plan and workspace permissions.

Keep the following behaviors in mind:

- The dedicated OpenAI endpoint uses OAuth.
- Every MCP request operates against one sub-account at a time.
- Individual connections support a single sub-account.
- Agency multi-sub-account connections are rolling out and appear only when the multi-sub-account option is available for the installation.
- A connection cannot access a sub-account that was not authorized.
- Available operations can change as the active LeadConnector MCP catalog evolves.
- Sensitive or irreversible operations may require additional confirmation or safety checks.

---

## **How LeadConnector MCP Works**

LeadConnector MCP exposes a small set of unified tools that allows the OpenAI client to find and execute supported CRM operations without loading hundreds of separate tools at once.

The four unified MCP tools are:

- **list\_locations:** Lists the sub-accounts available to the connection or returns the single connected sub-account.
- **search\_operations:** Finds supported CRM operations based on the task you want to complete.
- **describe\_operation:** Retrieves an operation's inputs, example payload, required permissions, and safety  
   information.
- **execute\_operation:** Runs an approved operation against the authorized sub-account.

For example, if you ask the connected OpenAI client to find a contact and update an opportunity, it can discover the required operations, inspect their requirements, and execute them through this unified toolset.

The exact operations available depend on the permissions granted during OAuth.

---

## **How to Connect ChatGPT to LeadConnector MCP**

Connecting ChatGPT creates a custom MCP-powered app that can use the LeadConnector tools allowed by your OAuth authorization.

### **Step 1:**Confirm ChatGPT Access

Confirm that your ChatGPT account and workspace permissions allow you to create or use a custom MCP app.

If required, enable **Developer mode** from the applicable ChatGPT Apps settings before creating the connection.

### **Step 2:**Create the LeadConnector App

1. In ChatGPT on the web, open **Settings**.
2. Select **Apps**.
3. Select **Create**.
4. Enter a name such as **LeadConnector**.
5. Add a description that identifies the app as your LeadConnector CRM connection.
6. Enter the MCP server endpoint:

```
https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/openai/v2/
```

7. Continue with the MCP app configuration.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082968023/original/YV0whDmzKYS0pT8dtVXEvJ5AeSD5CdW_6g.png?1791558048)

### **Step 3:**Scan and Authorize the Connection

1. Select the option to scan or discover the MCP tools.
2. When prompted, begin the LeadConnector OAuth authorization.
3. Sign in to your LeadConnector account.
4. Select the available sub-account or supported sub-accounts you want the connection to access.
5. Review the requested permissions.
6. Approve the connection.
7. Return to ChatGPT after authorization completes.
8. Finish creating the app.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082968598/original/zjGjrd699W-w9EBfigG7x7LkMNGsC4H0fQ.png?1791558394)

### **Step 4:**Use LeadConnector in ChatGPT

1. Start a new ChatGPT conversation.
2. Open the available **Apps** or tools menu.
3. Select the LeadConnector app for the request.
4. Enter a CRM request that uses an authorized operation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082969065/original/G1u65icCZBXN2Pi6taOHEkaGWXC1JLTh0A.png?1791558579)

For example:

```
Find the five most recently created contacts in my connected sub-account.
```

---

## **How to Connect Codex to LeadConnector MCP**

Codex can connect to the same OpenAI MCP endpoint through the CLI or supported IDE configuration.

### **Method 1:**Codex CLI

Add the LeadConnector MCP server:

```
codex mcp add leadconnector --url https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/openai/v2/
```

Then start the LeadConnector OAuth flow:

```
codex mcp login leadconnector
```

Complete the LeadConnector sign-in, sub-account selection, and permission approval when prompted.

After authorization, use Codex with requests that require the connected LeadConnector CRM operations.

### **Method 2:**Codex IDE

1. Open the Codex IDE extension.
2. Open the **gear** menu.
3. Select **MCP servers**.
4. Select **Add server**.
5. Choose **Streamable HTTP**.

      6. Enter:

```
https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/openai/v2/
```

7. Select **Authenticate**.
8. Complete the LeadConnector OAuth flow.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082970645/original/GkP4uCDefITt9j8rb6m2vvhfFiYVP3tsEA.png?1791559430)    
9. Select the appropriate sub-account access.  
  
10. Approve the requested permissions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082970515/original/rFoKzWLJKXB9uJFiPCteHTL5lX5XXA5VOQ.png?1791559380)

---

## **How to Verify the Connection**

Testing the connection confirms that the OpenAI client can identify the authorized CRM context and use the LeadConnector MCP tools successfully.

After connecting, start with a simple read request before using write or delete actions.

For example:

```
Find the five most recently created contacts in my connected sub-account.
```

For an agency connection with multiple authorized sub-accounts, include the sub-account name in the request.

If the requested sub-account is ambiguous, the client can use **list\_locations** to identify the available locations before proceeding.

```
Note: The connection can only access operations and sub-accounts included in the OAuth authorization.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Which OpenAI clients can connect to the LeadConnector MCP OpenAI endpoint?**

The current LeadConnector documentation specifically supports ChatGPT, Codex, and other compatible OpenAI clients that can connect to a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server.

**Q: Do I need to create a Private Integration Token?**

No. The dedicated OpenAI endpoint uses the LeadConnector OAuth sign-in and consent flow.

**Q: Which endpoint should I use for ChatGPT or Codex?**

Use:

```
https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/openai/v2/
```

**Q: How many CRM operations are available?**

The current LeadConnector MCP documentation lists more than 550 active operations across 38 domains. The exact operations available to your connection depend on your OAuth permissions.

**Q: What are the four unified MCP tools?**

The OpenAI connection exposes **list\_locations**, **search\_operations**, **describe\_operation**, and **execute\_operation**.

**Q: Can one connection access multiple sub-accounts?**

Agency multi-sub-account support is rolling out. When the multi-sub-account installation option is available, you can authorize multiple sub-accounts. Every request still operates against one sub-account at a time.

**Q: Can the OpenAI client access a sub-account I did not approve?**

No. The connection is limited to the sub-accounts and permissions included in your authorization.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [HighLevel MCP for Anthropic — Increased Scopes](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008391)
- [HighLevel API Documentation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001060529)

title_en: How to Add Event Tickets to Apple Wallet and Google Wallet
source_md:
Event attendees can keep their in-person tickets close at hand by saving them to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet after registering. Each wallet pass contains the event and attendee details needed at the venue, including the QR code used for check-in. Organizers can also make wallet links available through ticket PDFs and supported confirmation communications. This guide explains how event ticket wallet passes work and where attendees can access them.

---

**Table of Contents**

- [What is Add Event Tickets to Apple Wallet and Google Wallet?](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-6a90cfd8d9a481919356a2811bb36973-highlevel-t1-t2-article-bot/c/6aaa838a-3098-8324-a2bb-4bbadfbeb212#what-is-add-event-tickets-to-apple-wallet-and-google-wallet)
- [Key Benefits of Event Ticket Wallet Passes](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-6a90cfd8d9a481919356a2811bb36973-highlevel-t1-t2-article-bot/c/6aaa838a-3098-8324-a2bb-4bbadfbeb212#key-benefits-of-event-ticket-wallet-passes)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-6a90cfd8d9a481919356a2811bb36973-highlevel-t1-t2-article-bot/c/6aaa838a-3098-8324-a2bb-4bbadfbeb212#prerequisites-and-limitations)
- [How To Setup Event Ticket Wallet Links](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-6a90cfd8d9a481919356a2811bb36973-highlevel-t1-t2-article-bot/c/6aaa838a-3098-8324-a2bb-4bbadfbeb212#how-to-setup-event-ticket-wallet-links)
- [What Information Appears on the Wallet Pass?](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-6a90cfd8d9a481919356a2811bb36973-highlevel-t1-t2-article-bot/c/6aaa838a-3098-8324-a2bb-4bbadfbeb212#what-information-appears-on-the-wallet-pass)
- [How Wallet Passes Work for Multi-Ticket Orders](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-6a90cfd8d9a481919356a2811bb36973-highlevel-t1-t2-article-bot/c/6aaa838a-3098-8324-a2bb-4bbadfbeb212#how-wallet-passes-work-for-multi-ticket-orders)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-6a90cfd8d9a481919356a2811bb36973-highlevel-t1-t2-article-bot/c/6aaa838a-3098-8324-a2bb-4bbadfbeb212#frequently-asked-questions)
- [Related Articles](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-6a90cfd8d9a481919356a2811bb36973-highlevel-t1-t2-article-bot/c/6aaa838a-3098-8324-a2bb-4bbadfbeb212#related-articles)

---

# **What is Add Event Tickets to Apple Wallet and Google Wallet?**

Event ticket wallet passes let attendees save tickets for in-person events to a supported digital wallet after completing their registration or purchase.

Attendees can save a ticket to Apple Wallet on iPhone or Google Wallet on Android. The wallet pass contains the same QR code used for event check-in.

Each ticket receives its own wallet link and pass. This keeps the attendee name and ticket type connected to the correct ticket when attendees arrive at the venue.

---

## **Key Benefits of Event Ticket Wallet Passes**

Wallet passes give attendees a convenient way to keep their event ticket available while preserving the existing HighLevel check-in experience.

- **Convenient ticket access**: Attendees can save their in-person event ticket to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet after registration.

- **Clear attendee details**: Each pass displays the attendee name and ticket type, helping identify the correct ticket at the venue.

- **Consistent QR check-in**: The wallet pass uses the same QR code that staff scan for event check-in.

- **Individual passes for groups**: Each ticket in a guest or multi-ticket order receives its own wallet link.

- **Multiple delivery options**: Wallet links can appear on the ticket PDF and in supported confirmation communications.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

Wallet passes are designed specifically for attendees who need a ticket for arrival and check-in at a physical venue.

Before using event ticket wallet passes, confirm the following:

- The event is an **in-person event**.
- The attendee completes a ticket purchase or registration for the event.
- Apple Wallet is used on iPhone when that wallet option is selected.
- Google Wallet is used on Android when that wallet option is selected.

Current limitations and scope include:

- **Online events do not use wallet passes or QR check-in.** Attendees continue to the online attendee or join experience instead.
- The release does not specify minimum supported iOS or Android versions.
- The release does not document additional device or wallet-app requirements.

HighLevel currently distinguishes **In-person** and **Online** locations when configuring an Event. QR check-in is also documented as an in-person event experience.

---

## **How To Setup Event Ticket Wallet Links**

Wallet links become available as part of the attendee ticket experience for eligible in-person events. Organizers can also place wallet links in supported event confirmation communications.

### 

### **Attendee wallet flow**

1. ### Register for or purchase a ticket to an **in-person event**.
2. Complete the required registration or checkout steps.
3. On the post-registration experience, select the available wallet option for the device.
4. On iPhone, save the ticket to **Apple Wallet**.
5. On Android, save the ticket to **Google Wallet**.
6. On other supported devices, use the available **Add to Wallet** option.
7. Open the saved pass when arriving at the venue.
8. Present the QR code on the pass for event check-in.

The QR code on the wallet pass is the same event check-in QR used by staff. HighLevel's existing check-in experience lets staff scan attendee QR codes for in-person Events.

### **Access wallet links from the ticket PDF**

Apple Wallet and Google Wallet badges are included on the event ticket PDF.

1. Open the event ticket PDF received with the registration.
2. Locate the Apple Wallet or Google Wallet badge.
3. Use the appropriate wallet option for the attendee's device.
4. Follow the device prompts to save the pass.

### **Add wallet links to registration confirmation notifications**

Organizers can include wallet links in registration confirmations so attendees can save their in-person event tickets after registering.

From the Sub-Account view, select Memberships in the left sidebar. Select Events from the top navigation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081172579/original/wGoKEqsoBXjhpqRVg2tIuIF-XwTbOKHdyA.jpeg?1789643464)

Open the applicable in-person event.  Select Settings from the event navigation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081172631/original/-DgE08ZC97B9zKHgMLH3aL1kOxYkXru-AA.jpeg?1789643488)

Select **Notifications** from the Settings menu. Under Attendee journey, locate **Registration confirmation** beneath WHEN THEY REGISTER. Click the **pencil icon** on the right side of Registration confirmation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081172926/original/eDaLmogy7v3zzD_Ol4mZ9lZnO1GYBSVn1Q.png?1789643743)

Select the Email, SMS, or WhatsApp tab for the notification you want to update.  Add the Wallet Links merge field to the message content: {{event.ticket.wallet\_links}}.  Click Save in the top-right corner.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081173341/original/uwx5cdL_AH3GQYvx2C_kzNXmpXZNj0lwyg.gif?1789644085)

```
If you want the attendee to receive the ticket PDF, keep Include PDF ticket in the email selected. The release confirms that Apple Wallet and Google Wallet badges appear on the ticket PDF.
```

---

## **What Information Appears on the Wallet Pass?**

The wallet pass keeps the information an attendee needs for arrival and check-in together in one place.

Each pass displays:

- Event name.
- Event date and time in the event timezone.
- Venue.
- Ticket type.
- Attendee name.
- Event check-in QR code.

The wallet pass is more than a separate QR image. It combines the attendee's ticket information with the QR code staff already use at the door.

---

## **How Wallet Passes Work for Multi-Ticket Orders**

Individual wallet passes help organizers and attendees keep tickets correctly assigned when one registration contains multiple seats or ticket types.

Each ticket receives its own wallet link. As a result, each wallet pass can display the correct attendee name and ticket type.

For example, if one buyer registers two attendees, the tickets do not share one generic wallet pass. Each ticket receives its own wallet link.

HighLevel's existing multi-attendee registration experience also creates individual attendee records for tickets within a multi-ticket registration.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does saving the ticket to a wallet create a different QR code?**  
A: No. The wallet pass uses the same event check-in QR code that staff scan at the venue.

**Q: Can attendees save tickets for online events to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet?**  
A: No. Wallet passes and QR check-in are limited to in-person events. Online attendees continue to the attendee or join experience.

**Q: Does each ticket in a multi-ticket order get its own wallet pass?**  
A: Yes. Each ticket receives its own wallet link so the correct attendee name and ticket type can appear on the pass.

**Q: Where can attendees receive wallet links?**  
A: Wallet badges appear on the ticket PDF. Wallet links can also be included in supported confirmation email, SMS, and WhatsApp messages.

**Q: What merge field adds wallet links to an event notification?**  
A: Use the Wallet Links merge field: `{{event.ticket.wallet_links}}`.

**Q: What happens on devices other than iPhone or Android?**  
A: The release states that attendees can use an **Add to Wallet** option on other devices. Exact device-specific behavior is not documented.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Create and Manage Events in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008071-how-to-create-and-manage-events-in-highlevel?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Check-in Experience for In Person Events](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008294-check-in-experience-for-in-person-events?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Multi-Attendee Registration with Individual Details and Data Copying](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008429-multi-attendee-registration-with-individual-details-and-data-copying?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Events - How to Manually Add Attendees](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008421-events-how-to-manually-add-attendees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Events and Workflows Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008431-events-and-workflows-integration?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [How to Use Merge Fields and Email Fallback Values](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008467-how-to-use-merge-fields-and-email-fallback-values?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

title_en: Upgrade to Premium Customer Support at HighLevel
source_md:
Get faster, priority assistance and expert guidance with HighLevel’s new Premium Support feature—designed for agencies, power users, and growing businesses that need reliable, around-the-clock support.

```
Important: Premium Support is available once you’ve completed 90 days with HighLevel.

Note: Cancelling Premium Customer Support does not cancel your HighLevel subscription.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Premium Support?](#What-is-Premium-Support?)
  - [Accept the Terms Before Subscribing](#Accept-the-Terms-Before-Subscribing)
  - [Key Benefits of Premium Support](#Key-Benefits-of-Premium-Support)

    - [Step 1: Go to the Billing Page](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Go-to-the-Billing-Page)

    - [Step 3: Setup Slack Channel](#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Setup-Slack-Channel)

    - [Quarterly Business Reviews](#Quarterly-Business-Reviews)
  - [Managing and Cancelling Premium Support](#Managing-and-Cancelling-Premium-Support)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Premium Support?**

Premium Support is a subscription-based add-on for HighLevel users that provides priority access to technical help, expert advice, and dedicated support channels. By subscribing, agencies and businesses can resolve issues faster, minimize downtime, and receive personalized assistance from HighLevel’s expert team.

```
Note: Learn more about Premium Customer Support Upgrade.
```

---

## **Accept the Terms Before Subscribing**

Before you can complete a Premium Support subscription, you must accept the Premium Support terms and conditions in the checkout window. This confirmation step helps ensure the subscription is completed with clear agreement to the service terms.

To complete your subscription:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Billing**.

2. Find **Premium Support** under **Addons**.

3. Select **Subscribe Now**.

4. Choose your billing plan and payment method.

5. Select the **I agree to the premium support terms and conditions** checkbox.

6. Click **Pay & Subscribe** to complete the purchase.

**Important:**

- The terms checkbox is required before the subscription can be completed.
- The checkout design remains the same aside from this added confirmation step.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072450040/original/czu24TleATbTcS97STrfSFUscMqt6mXUWg.png?1780047673)

---

## **Key Benefits of Premium Support**

Premium Support offers significant advantages for users who need more than standard support, helping you keep your business running smoothly and efficiently.

✅ **Dedicated Technical Account Manager (TAM):** For personalized support and optimization.

✅ **Priority Ticket Handling:** Get your support requests addressed ahead of standard tickets for faster resolutions.

✅ **Dedicated Support Portal:** Submit and track tickets through a specialized portal for premium users.

✅ **Exclusive Contact Channels:** Access the Premium Support team directly via Slack for real-time communication.

✅ **24/7 Availability:** Receive help any time of day, reducing the risk of extended downtime.

✅ **Tailored Solutions:** Benefit from proactive, customized support and expert guidance for your unique business needs.

✅ **Proactive Guidance:** Get ahead of potential issues with advice and best practices from experienced support staff.

---

## **How To Setup Premium Support**

Subscribing to Premium Support is simple and ensures you’re always prepared for urgent or complex support needs.

 

### **Step 1:**Go to the Billing Page

- From your agency dashboard, click **Add-Ons**
- Locate the “**Premium Support**” section under **Add-ons**.
- Click on the **Subscribe Now** button.
- or visit [Premium Support Page](https://app.gohighlevel.com/offers/premium-support)  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066357129/original/yxkjfjTvIE-FiPW72KckmfOwgMCZEFtWVw.png?1772793405)

### **Step 2:**Choose Your Plan

- Select either **Monthly ($500/month)** or **Annual billing (save $1000/year)**.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047442789/original/1NpjzZAxC2LSImJlbb-h2OAguPWXueOMrg.jpeg?1748531998)
- Input your card details and click **Pay & Subscribe**.  
    
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047442787/original/pnKydMpyCGQazT1jAsBFBhCnfu0av8r3rA.jpeg?1748531998)

### **Step 3:**Setup Slack Channel

Once subscribed, you’ll now see a slack button in the support panel. Click on it and fill the in-app setup form.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052087919/original/xx-oyfZi1i-olrPFdfUpCyrmbj4JIvR16Q.png?1755781575)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052087997/original/r2HzZbWTMY2l24cJF-AB1ETwNsVBAgVx0g.png?1755781615)

- Choose a **custom name** for your dedicated Slack channel.
- Share **your preferred time** to connect and the time zone.
- Add general **comments**on what you'd like help with.

Your Slack channel is created automatically, instantly **bringing you together with our Technical Account Managers (TAM)**so **you can get help faster, easier, and more personally** than ever before!

### **Step 4:**Access Premium Support Features

- A **dedicated Slack channel** for urgent needs.
- **24/7 expert support** via private communication channels.
- Your assigned **Technical Account Manager** (TAM).

---

## **Additional Premium Support Topics**

Explore more about Premium Support’s unique features and management options to maximize your support experience.

1. ### **Dedicated Technical Account Manager (TAM)**

     
   Your TAM serves as a strategic partner who understands your business, tools, and goals. From optimizing HighLevel usage to guiding you through scaling operations, your TAM ensures consistent success and reduced friction.  
     
   - Helps with feature optimization.
   - Suggests performance improvements.
   - Assists with escalated support cases.
2. ### **Exclusive Slack Access**

     
   Direct Slack access connects you with the Premium Support team for real-time troubleshooting and advice, ensuring urgent issues are handled promptly.  
     
   - Receive an invitation to join the Premium Support Slack channel after subscribing.
   - Chat with support experts and get immediate responses.
   - Share screenshots, files, or details for more efficient troubleshooting.
3. ### **Quarterly Business Reviews**

     
   Quarterly Business Reviews provide data-driven feedback and recommendations to help optimize performance and drive agency growth. These include tailored suggestions and detailed usage analysis.  
     
   - Strategic insight sessions every quarter.
   - Review of ticket history, performance benchmarks, and growth opportunities.
   - Actionable plans from support specialists.

---

## **Managing and Cancelling Premium Support**

### 

You can cancel your Premium Customer Support subscription directly from **Billing settings** at any time.

After cancellation, your Premium Support benefits will remain active until the end of your current billing cycle. Once the billing cycle ends, access to Premium Support benefits will be removed.

> **Note:** Cancelling Premium Support does not cancel your HighLevel subscription.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What is the difference between Standard and Premium Support?**  
Standard Support offers 24/7 assistance with standard wait times, while Premium Support provides faster response times, a dedicated Technical Account Manager, a private Slack channel for real-time communication, and proactive Quarterly Business Reviews.

**Q: How do I access my Technical Account Manager (TAM)?**  
Customers with Premium Support are assigned a dedicated TAM who can be contacted directly through the provided communication channels and who offers tailored guidance based on your support history.

**Q: Can I invite my entire team to the Slack channel?**  
Yes, you can invite your team to the dedicated Slack channel to ensure seamless collaboration and visibility across your organization.

**Q: How do I submit a ticket in Slack?**  
Support tickets can be submitted directly within the dedicated Slack channel, where they are routed to your TAM for immediate attention and resolution.

**Q: What benefits can I expect from Quarterly Business Reviews?**  
QBRs provide a structured review of past issues, analyze trends, and offer proactive recommendations to improve support efficiency and align with your business goals.

**Q: How do I access the Premium Support Slack channel?**

After subscribing, you’ll receive instructions and an invitation to join the exclusive Slack channel for real-time support.

**Q: Can I cancel Premium Support at any time?**

Yes, you can manage or cancel your subscription directly from your billing settings.

**Q: Are there any additional costs for Premium Support?**

Yes. You can cancel Premium Support directly from your Billing settings at any time. Your Premium Support benefits will remain available until the end of your current billing cycle.

I would also remove any sentence that says in-app cancellation is planned for a future update, because that directly conflicts with the current cancellation flow.

**Note:** Cancelling Premium Customer Support does not cancel your HighLevel subscription.
