**Growing Ecosystem** — New MCP connectors are added regularly, expanding the range of third-party services your agents can integrate with.

## Supported MCP Apps

HighLevel supports a growing list of MCP app connectors. Each connector provides a set of tools that agents can use to interact with the connected application.

| MCP App | Description |
| --- | --- |
| HubSpot | Manage contacts, deals, and CRM activities in HubSpot. |
| Notion | Create pages, search content, and organize knowledge in Notion workspaces. |
| Apify | Run web scraping and automation tasks using Apify actors. |
| Make | Trigger Make scenarios and automate multi-app workflows. |
| Fathom | Access analytics and visitor data from Fathom. |
| Calendly | Schedule meetings and manage calendar availability via Calendly. |
| Canva | Generate and manage design assets using Canva's tools. |
| OpenArt | Create AI-generated artwork and visual content through OpenArt. |
| Monday.com | Manage work in boards, create and update items, and move tasks through statuses. |
| Cal.com | Book, reschedule, and manage meetings on connected calendars automatically. |
| Higgsfield | Generate cinematic AI videos and images from text or reference inputs. |
| GitHub | Read code, manage issues and pull requests, and trigger actions across development workflows. |
| Shippo | Compare carrier rates, purchase and print shipping labels, and track shipments. |
| Windsor.ai | Pull unified marketing and advertising data from 350+ sources and take actions on connected platforms, such as adjusting campaign budgets or pausing ads. |
| Vapi | Trigger and manage AI voice calls, route calls to voice assistants, and retrieve call details. |
| Google Drive | Find, organize, and manage files and folders across Google Drive. |
| Google Docs | Create, read, and edit documents in Google Docs. |
| Google Sheets | Read and update spreadsheets, pull data, write rows, and keep sheets in sync. |
| Google Slides | Create and update presentations and slide content in Google Slides. |
| Google Calendar | Create, update, and look up events across connected calendars. |
| Atlassian | Manage Jira issues, track work, and read or update pages in Jira and Confluence. |
| Apollo | Search Apollo's B2B contact database, retrieve verified emails and company data, and manage outreach sequences. |
| Fal | Generate image, video, and audio media using hosted AI models. |
| Zapier | Trigger actions and automations across 8,000+ apps through a single connector. |
| Magnific | Upscale and enhance low-resolution images into high-resolution, detail-rich visuals. |
| DataForSEO | Retrieve SERP results, keyword metrics, and backlink data for research and reporting. |
| Trello | Manage boards, create and move cards, update lists, and keep projects moving. |
| Asana | Manage projects, create and update tasks, move work across projects, and keep teams in sync. |
| ClickUp | Manage work by creating and updating tasks, docs, and lists across your workspace. |
| Fireflies | Access meeting transcripts, summaries, and action items from recorded calls. |
| Kling | Turn text prompts or reference images into short cinematic AI video clips. |
| Stripe | Create payment links and invoices, look up customers, and check transaction data. |
| Firecrawl | Crawl and scrape websites into clean, LLM-ready data for research and enrichment. |
| Nekt | Connect 200+ sources through Nekt's data layer and serve unified data to agents on demand. |

## How to Connect an MCP App to Your Managed Agents

Follow these steps to add an MCP app connector to a Managed Agent in HighLevel Agent Studio:

Step 1

Open Agent Studio

Navigate to Agent Studio in your HighLevel account.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077351998/original/PmwPnqyDU8s4O4H14iDIzc29dFr7HAHI9A.png?1785506605)

Step 2

Create or Select a Managed Agent

Create a new Managed Agent or open an existing one. You can also instruct the agent builder to add an MCP app during agent creation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082678840/original/jEEzwqFFZq7oMujIknuPkkxuIbO3gldJIA.png?1791308714)

Step 3

Add an MCP App

In the Apps section of the agent configuration, click "+ Add app" and select the MCP connector you want to integrate (e.g., Notion, HubSpot, Make).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077352212/original/X7W8p_kjwiN3ItIJ_9IFHcJuZAI-1BuIVg.png?1785506759)

Step 4

Authenticate Your Account

Click "+ Connect" next to the MCP app. You will be prompted to sign in using OAuth or a secure login flow. Grant the necessary permissions for the agent to access the app.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077156026/original/_sia11EHfqV04YB9T-asTfn86VNZpPqdMA.png?1785336258)

Step 5

Select Tools

Once authenticated, a list of available tools for the MCP app appears. Check the boxes next to the tools you want the agent to use (e.g., "notion-create-pages", "notion-search", "get\_board\_items\_page" for Monday.com).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077352359/original/ESa-D6ymUTPpEB4uFLN4kNXKi8G75ovBEA.png?1785506878)

Step 6

Save the Configuration

Click "Save" to apply the MCP app connection and selected tools to your Managed Agent.

Step 7

Trigger the Agent

Activate the agent using the configured trigger (e.g., "Lead Gen Form Submitted"). The agent will execute actions in the connected MCP app as part of its workflow.

Tip

You can connect multiple MCP apps to a single Managed Agent. Agents will use the appropriate tools based on the context and instructions you provide.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

MCP is a standard protocol that allows AI agents to securely connect to and interact with external applications. It defines how agents authenticate, access tools, and execute actions across different platforms.

Q: Can I connect multiple MCP apps to one Managed Agent?

Yes. A single Managed Agent can connect to multiple MCP apps. The agent uses the appropriate tools based on its instructions and the context of the task.

Q: Are my credentials secure when connecting MCP apps?

Yes. MCP connectors use OAuth or secure login flows. Your credentials are not stored by HighLevel, and agents receive only the permissions you explicitly grant during authentication.

Q: Which HighLevel products support MCP connectors?

MCP connectors are currently available for Managed Agents in Agent Studio and in Ask AI. Support for Voice AI and Conversations AI is planned for a future release.

Q: Can I create custom MCP connectors?

Yes. Managed Agents support custom MCP connectors in Agent Studio. You can connect compatible third-party MCP servers or your own internal MCP server, configure authentication when required, and choose which tools the Managed Agent can use.

Q: How do I choose which tools an agent can access?

After connecting an MCP app, you will see a list of available tools. Check the boxes next to the tools you want the agent to use. You can modify these selections at any time by editing the agent configuration.

Q: What happens if an MCP app connection fails?

Yes. HighLevel is actively adding new MCP connectors. You can track upcoming integrations and request new connectors through the MCP app tracker in the HighLevel community.

title_en: Managed Agents File Support
source_md:
File attachments let Managed Agents work directly with business documents and PNG images instead of relying only on text entered into chat. You can attach supported files, analyze their contents, edit PNG images when Image generation is enabled, and continue with follow-up requests in the same conversation. This guide covers supported file types, direct chat usage, image editing, attachment limits, and practical limitations.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is File Support for Managed Agents?](#What-is-File-Support-for-Managed-Agents?)
- [Key Benefits of File Support for Managed Agents](#Key-Benefits-of-File-Support-for-Managed-Agents)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#Prerequisites-and-Limitations)
- [Supported File Types](#Supported-File-Types)
- [How To Attach and Analyze Files with a Managed Agent](#How-To-Attach-and-Analyze-Files-with-a-Managed-Agent)
- [Analyze Multiple Files in One Conversation](#Analyze-Multiple-Files-in-One-Conversation)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is File Support for Managed Agents?**

File Support for Managed Agents lets you attach supported documents and PNG images directly to a Managed Agent conversation. The agent can read the attachment, use its contents as context, and answer questions about the information it finds.

When **Image generation** is enabled, you can also ask the Managed Agent to edit an attached PNG image. Describe the change you want, then continue refining the result with follow-up instructions in the same conversation.

You can also attach multiple documents and ask the agent to work across them. For long documents, Managed Agents can retrieve relevant sections instead of requiring you to manually copy the document into the conversation.

---

## **Key Benefits of File Support for Managed Agents**

File attachments give Managed Agents direct access to the source material behind a request. This can reduce manual copying and make document-based tasks easier to complete inside the same conversation.

- **Work from original source files:** Attach business documents and images instead of copying their contents into the message field.
- **Ask follow-up questions:** Continue asking about attached files throughout the conversation.
- **Analyze multiple documents together:** Attach several supported documents and ask questions that require information from more than one file.
- **Work with long documents:** Managed Agents can retrieve relevant sections from longer files when responding.
- **Use common business file formats:** Supported document formats include PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV, and JSON.
- **Correct the agent when needed:** If the agent interprets something incorrectly, provide a correction or clarification in a follow-up message.
- **Edit PNG images conversationally:** Attach a PNG image and describe the change you want without switching to a separate image-editing tool. Continue refining the result with follow-up instructions in the same conversation.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

Knowing the supported formats and current limits helps you prepare files for analysis. Results can vary based on document readability, file structure, and the instructions configured for the Managed Agent.

- Each document can be up to **5 MB**.
- Attachments remain available throughout the conversation.
- Supported document formats include **PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV, and JSON**.
- **PNG images** are supported.
- Image generation must be enabled on the Managed Agent to edit an attached PNG image.
- Some technically valid PDFs may be rejected depending on how their cross-reference data is encoded.
- Prior attachments can influence later responses in the same conversation. Start a fresh conversation when analyzing unrelated documents.
- Agent privacy or safety instructions can prevent the agent from returning some extracted values.
- Text extraction does not guarantee preservation of Word-specific formatting, comments, tracked changes, headers, or embedded objects.
- Minor model mistakes can still occur. Review important extracted values before relying on them for downstream work.

> **Results can vary based on document readability and the agent’s instructions.**

---

## **Supported File Types**

Managed Agents support several common document formats and PNG images. Use the table below as the current compatibility reference for direct file attachments.

| File Type | Extension | Support |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PDF | `.pdf` | Supported |
| Microsoft Word | `.docx` | Supported |
| Plain text | `.txt` | Supported |
| Markdown | `.md` | Supported |
| CSV | `.csv` | Supported |
| JSON | `.json` | Supported |
| Image | `.png` | Supported |

PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV, and JSON are explicitly listed in the release material. PNG support was also confirmed by the product team and verified during testing.

Formats such as XLS, XLSX, DOC, RTF, and PPTX are not documented as supported in the supplied release material and should not be assumed to work.

---

## **How To Attach and Work With Files Using a Managed Agent**

After publishing a Managed Agent, return to its main page to use the direct chat interface. From there, you can attach a supported file or PNG image and ask the agent to analyze it.

1. From the **Sub-Account** view, select **AI Agents**.
2. Select **Agent Studio**.
3. Select **Managed Agents**.
4. Select the Managed Agent you want to use.
5. Make any required changes to the agent.
6. Click **Publish**.
7. Click **Back** to return to the agent’s main page.
8. In the chat interface, click the **+** attachment control beside the message field.
9. Select the supported document or PNG image you want to use.
10. Enter a question or instruction about the attachment.
11. To edit a PNG image, describe the specific change you want the Managed Agent to make. Image generation must be enabled on the agent.
12. Send the message and review the response or edited image.
13. Continue with follow-up questions, corrections, or image-editing instructions as needed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082422012/original/rYGT-Le5zKPj2qFPq-7Pa5NXiSMOdVLQ2Q.png?1790971905)

1. Select the supported file or PNG image you want to analyze.
2. Enter a question or instruction about the attachment.
3. Send the message.
4. Review the response and continue with follow-up questions or corrections as needed.

For example, you could ask:

- “Summarize the key obligations in this contract.”
- “List every invoice number, customer, and total in this file.”
- “What information appears in this image?”
- “Which rows in this CSV have a status of Pending?”

If the agent misinterprets a value or misses important context, clarify the information in a follow-up message and ask it to reconsider the file.

---

## **Analyze Multiple Files in One Conversation**

Multi-file analysis lets the Managed Agent compare or combine information from several documents without requiring you to process each file separately. This is useful when a task depends on related information stored across different files.

For example:

> “Compare these documents and identify any customer names, dates, amounts, or terms that appear in more than one file.”

Attachments remain available throughout the conversation, so you can continue asking follow-up questions without reattaching the same files.

When working with a PNG image, you can also continue refining an edited result in the same conversation. Follow-up editing instructions can build on the latest image without requiring you to reattach the original PNG.

For unrelated document analyses, start a fresh conversation. Earlier attachments can influence later responses when they remain part of the conversation context.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Which document types can I attach to a Managed Agent?**  
A: The documented supported document formats are PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV, and JSON. PNG images are also supported.

**Q: How large can each document be?**  
A: Each document can be up to 5 MB.

**Q: Can a Managed Agent answer questions using more than one file?**  
A: Yes. Managed Agents can use information from multiple attached documents in the same request.

**Q: Do I need to reattach a file for every follow-up question?**  
A: No. Attachments remain available throughout the conversation.

**Q: What should I do if the agent gets information from a file wrong?**  
A: Correct or clarify the information in a follow-up message and ask the agent to reassess the file. Review important extracted values before relying on them.

**Q: Why might a supported file fail or produce incomplete results?**  
A: Results can vary based on file readability, document encoding, structure, and the agent’s instructions. Some technically valid PDFs may also be rejected because of how their cross-reference data is encoded.

**Q: Does DOCX support preserve all Microsoft Word content and formatting?**  
A: Not necessarily. Text extraction does not guarantee Word formatting, comments, tracked changes, headers, or embedded objects.

**Q: Can I edit a PNG image attached to a Managed Agent?**  
**A:** Yes. When Image generation is enabled, attach a PNG image and describe the change you want the Managed Agent to make. You can continue refining the edited result through follow-up instructions in the same conversation.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Setup and Use Managed Agents in Agent Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007931-important-update-agent-studio-is-evolving?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Document Support in Knowledge Base for HighLevel AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006671?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

title_en: Workflow Trigger - Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign
source_md:
The **Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign** workflow trigger starts a workflow when an affiliate is added to an affiliate campaign in HighLevel. You can use it to send onboarding messages, notify your team, apply tags, and use affiliate-related custom values in later workflow steps.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign Workflow Trigger?](#What-is-Affiliate-Enrolled-In-Campaign-Workflow-Trigger?)
- [Key Benefits of Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign Workflow Trigger](#Key-Benefits-of-Affiliate-Enrolled-In-Campaign-Workflow-Trigger)
- [How to configure Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign Trigger](#How-to-configure-Affiliate-Enrolled-In-Campaign-Trigger)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/iXUCABl7QAo?&wmode=opaque)

---

# **What is Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign Workflow Trigger?**

The **Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign** trigger starts a workflow when an affiliate is added to an affiliate campaign. The enrollment can happen manually or through an automation such as the **Add To Affiliate Campaign** workflow action, and the trigger is especially useful for streamlining affiliate onboarding and internal team communication. When activated, it unlocks access to detailed affiliate data,The trigger provides affiliate-related custom values that can be used in later workflow steps, including affiliate contact information, campaign details, referral and portal links, and other available affiliate data.. These custom values can then be used in emails, SMS messages, internal notifications, or CRM updates—making it easy to personalize outreach, track affiliate performance, and improve the overall onboarding experience. This trigger only appears if the Affiliate Manager is enabled and at least one affiliate campaign exists in the sub-account.

---

## **Key Benefits of Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign Workflow Trigger**

This trigger unlocks automation opportunities that enhance affiliate onboarding, internal tracking, and campaign engagement. Below are five core benefits of using this workflow trigger effectively.

- **Seamless Affiliate Onboarding:**Automatically welcome new affiliates with personalized emails or SMS messages that include login links, campaign details, and expectations—eliminating manual setup and confusion.

- **Access to Dynamic Affiliate Data:** Gain instant access to custom values such as affiliate name, contact info, revenue earned, and portal links. These dynamic fields can be inserted directly into your automated messages.

- **Improved Internal Communication:**Use internal notifications to alert your team whenever a new affiliate joins a campaign. This ensures your staff can follow up or support new partners without delay.

- **Campaign-Level Segmentation:**Apply tags to affiliates based on the campaign they’re enrolled in. This allows for more targeted messaging, better reporting, and tailored follow-up sequences across campaigns.

- **Scalable Affiliate Program Management:**Automating these onboarding and notification steps makes it easier to manage affiliate growth at scale—without sacrificing quality or personalization.

---

## **How to configure Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign Trigger**

### **Open the Workflow Builder**

Navigate to **Automation > Workflows** in the left-hand menu of your HighLevel dashboard. Once inside the Workflow List, click the blue **+ Create Workflow** button in the top right and select **Start from Scratch** from the dropdown menu to begin creating a new custom workflow.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050122714/original/rQylRHJ1b_2k3EjHY9H4MZyLYWjYDbN83g.png?1753031219)

### **Add the Affiliate Campaign Trigger**

Click **+ Add New Trigger** inside your workflow builder. From the trigger list, scroll to the **Affiliate** section and select **Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign**. This trigger activates the workflow when an affiliate joins a specific campaign.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050122729/original/Bcrr0WKwL0f-ntuscOCGNv9FyJSqaSfsiQ.png?1753031272)

### **Name the Trigger**

Give your trigger a clear and relevant name such as “Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign.” Naming helps keep your workflow organized and makes it easier to identify its purpose later.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050122735/original/cnIk8HirSZv7z9ENKkDfzoBKc6iriofvjw.png?1753031319)

### **Add Filters**

Click **Add filters** to narrow the trigger to a specific affiliate campaign. Select the campaign condition and choose the campaign you want the workflow to monitor.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050122742/original/NxHd82ysrhOxv8ZGp054G_PcDHcKxMDQng.png?1753031365)

### **Choose a Filter Type**

Use the dropdown to select a filter type. You can choose from **Standard Fields**, like campaign or custom attributes, to define when the trigger should activate. This ensures your workflow responds only to the specific affiliate enrollments you care about.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050122748/original/AHNmD0VFigF0s7K-9sHG3WaxygbGgKdVQQ.png?1753031407)

### **Save the Trigger Settings**

Once you’ve selected the campaign and defined your filter conditions, click **Save Trigger** to activate the configuration. This finalizes the setup and ensures the workflow is triggered only when affiliates are enrolled in the specific campaign you selected.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050122756/original/LDqqXEWe1PoF_jINqEmyxIOYJThICi6SDg.png?1753031463)

---

## **How to Use Custom Values in the Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign Trigger**

Custom values allow you to personalize communication and streamline internal processes using affiliate-specific data. Once the workflow trigger is configured, you can pull in key data fields automatically—making your onboarding process more dynamic and informative for both affiliates and your team.

After setting the **Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign** trigger and applying the necessary filters (such as campaign name), you can begin using **custom values** in your workflow steps, such as emails, SMS, or internal notifications. These values include details like the affiliate’s name, contact information, revenue, commissions, and login links—enabling you to deliver context-rich, personalized content.

- **Add an Internal Notification Step:** Create an internal notification to alert your team when an affiliate joins a specific campaign. Use custom values like Affiliate Name, Affiliate Email, Affiliate Phone, and Campaign Name to provide full context for the enrollment event.

- **Send a Personalized SMS to the Affiliate:**Add a step to send a welcome SMS using the affiliate’s name and campaign details. Include the Magic Login Link so the affiliate can access their portal instantly. This ensures they’re ready to promote your offer without delays.

- **Send a Welcome Email:**Create a welcome email using values such as the affiliate’s name, campaign name, referral link, portal link, or magic login link. You can also hyperlink the Client Portal Link and attach Terms & Conditions or Program Guidelines for clarity.

- **Use Tags for Campaign Segmentation:**Apply a unique tag during the workflow (e.g., “Luggage Campaign Affiliate”) using the campaign name. This allows you to segment affiliates for future workflows or promotional content based on the campaign they belong to.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050127966/original/Jpvn-gAUMDMa5yUX3oRXgqNlFTeagDKrCg.gif?1753068328)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why is the “Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign” trigger not showing up in my workflow options?**

The trigger will only appear if Affiliate Manager is enabled and at least one affiliate campaign has been created in the sub-account. Make sure Affiliate Manager is available in the sub-account and that at least one affiliate campaign has been created. Then, create a campaign under the Affiliate Manager tab. Once both are active, you’ll be able to see the trigger inside the workflow builder under the “Affiliate” category.

**Q: Can I use this trigger to onboard affiliates differently depending on which campaign they joined?**

Yes! You can apply **filters by campaign** when setting up the trigger. This allows you to run different workflows or branches of logic depending on which campaign the affiliate joined. For example, you might send one welcome email for your “Course Affiliate Program” and a different one for a “Product Launch Campaign.” You can also add conditional steps or use tags for segment-based actions.

**Q: Why do my affiliate custom values (e.g., referral link or magic login link) appear empty in the email/SMS step?**

Affiliate custom values tied to this trigger populate only when the workflow runs from a real **Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign** event. If values such as referral or portal links are blank, confirm that:

- the workflow uses the **Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign** trigger,
- the trigger is saved correctly, and
- the test affiliate was actually enrolled in the campaign.

**Q: What happens if I enroll an affiliate manually—will the trigger still fire?**

Absolutely. The trigger is activated whether the affiliate is enrolled **automatically** (via forms, funnels, or sign-up links) or **manually** (added directly by your team inside the Affiliate Manager). As long as the enrollment happens and matches the filter criteria (if set), the workflow will trigger and execute the steps you’ve configured.

- [Configuring the Order Form Submission Workflow Trigger](#Configuring-the-Order-Form-Submission-Workflow-Trigger)
  - [Name Your Trigger](#Name-Your-Trigger)
  - [Set Filters (Optional):](#Set-Filters-(Optional)%3A)
    - [In Funnel/Website](#In-Funnel/Website)
    - [Submission Type](#Submission-Type)
- [Use Cases](#Use-Cases)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is Order Form Submission Workflow Trigger**

The Order Form Submission workflow trigger activates whenever a customer completes and submits an order form through a funnel or website. This trigger helps businesses automate essential tasks like sending order confirmations, updating CRM records, notifying team members, and even triggering post-purchase upsells. By automating these processes, businesses can improve efficiency, enhance the customer experience, and ensure timely follow-ups.

---

## **Key Benefits of Order Form Submission Trigger**

Check out why this trigger is a game changer :

- **Automated Order Management:**Streamlines order processing by automating tasks such as confirmation emails, record updates, and internal notifications.
- **Improved Customer Experience:**Ensures customers receive immediate confirmation and relevant follow-ups, enhancing trust and satisfaction.
- **Flexible Configuration:**Allows businesses to customize workflows using filters like funnel, page, product, and submission type for precise automation.
- **Increased Sales Opportunities:**Facilitates upsell and cross-sell campaigns by triggering follow-up actions based on the products purchased.
- **Accurate Data Capture:**Automatically updates CRM records, ensuring that customer information is always up-to-date and accurate.

---

## **Configuring the Order Form Submission Workflow Trigger**

Follow these steps to set up the Order Form Submission trigger in your workflow :

### **Access Workflow Builder**

Go to the **"Automation"** section in your CRM platform. Create a workflow from scratch or select the existing workflow where you would like to set up the Order Form Submission trigger.

### **Add a New Trigger**

Click **“Add New Trigger”** and select **"Order Form Submission"** from the list.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039635087/original/FGH3gbcRkgEf_9jcST7ZPZSusyC6G0m1bg.png?1736519992)

### **Name Your Trigger**

Enter a clear, descriptive name, such as “Order Form Submitted for John's Live Workshop"

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039635120/original/gYUbpEM67ibi2DDKdBLI_NkLEBiCLGKUuw.png?1736520013)

### **Set Filters (Optional):**

Use filters to refine the conditions under which the workflow will activate:

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039635219/original/i4tuzQ031voiLj3vbQJSx39In70V915Nrg.png?1736520049)

#### **In Funnel/Website**

Select the specific funnel or website where the order form is located. You can also add an additional filter to select the specific page and also the specific product where you want to apply this trigger.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039701838/original/UK9M7vZu_X3UeefEuNkDrElqorNRcR-tew.png?1736751534)  
**Page Is**

Choose a specific page in the funnel or website where the order form is hosted.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039701849/original/q9BYYs4LCZgpMtkiKhZVyZIT9PNo6VG9cw.png?1736751563)

**Product Is**

Specify the product(s) linked to the order form to trigger the workflow only for those products.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039701872/original/MY8ie7S8NOwxyoDrkouedSs39uJfJvI8GA.png?1736751601)

---

#### **Submission Type**

The Submission Type filter is designed to activate the workflow trigger based on the specific type of order form submission a customer completes. This allows businesses to create highly tailored automations depending on how far a customer goes in the purchase process or what type of additional offer they accept during checkout.

Here’s a detailed explanation of the different submission types:

- **Bump**  
    
  **What it means:**Triggered when a customer purchases a bump offer, which is an add-on product shown during the initial checkout process.  
    
  **Why it’s useful:**Great for tracking and automating workflows around add-on products, such as sending personalized follow-up messages or cross-selling related products.
- **Opt-In**  
    
  **What it means****:** This type is triggered when a customer fills out their contact information (like name and email) but doesn’t complete the order.  
    
  **Why it’s useful****:** Ideal for abandoned cart workflows, this helps businesses follow up with potential customers who showed interest but didn’t finish their purchase, encouraging them to come back and complete the order.
- **Sale**  
    
  **What it means****:** This is triggered when a customer successfully completes a purchase by making a payment.  
    
  **Why it’s useful****:** Perfect for automating order confirmations, sending thank you emails, and initiating post-purchase follow-ups, such as upsell or feedback requests.
- **Upsell**  
    
  **What it means****:**Triggered when a customer accepts an upsell offer presented after the initial purchase.  
    
  **Why it’s useful****:**Helps businesses track and manage upsell campaigns, send upsell-specific order details, or notify internal teams about high-value customers who made additional purchases.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039701903/original/0tv0TE6AhermbCx-t5jo5E3r3FPVdVO6nQ.png?1736751638)

---

### **Finalizing and Activating the Workflow**

Once the filters are configured, click the **"Save"** button to finalize the trigger setup. Set the funnel to test mode and use dummy details to simulate an order submission, ensuring everything in the workflow works as expected. After successful testing, enable the **"Publish"** toggle to activate the workflow.

---

## **Use Cases**

Lets look at some examples where you can use this trigger:

### **Use Case #1 Order Confirmation and CRM Update**

**Scenario:**A business wants to automatically send an order confirmation email and update the customer’s CRM record upon purchase.

**Outcome:**The workflow sends a confirmation email to the customer, updates their CRM record with order details, and tags them for future marketing campaigns.

---

### **Use Case #2 Abandoned Cart Recovery**

**Scenario:**A business wants to follow up with customers who filled out their contact information but didn’t complete the order.

**Outcome:**The workflow sends a reminder email to the customer, offering an incentive (like a discount) to complete the purchase.

---

### **Use Case #3 Post-Purchase Upsell Campaign**

**Scenario:** A business wants to offer an upsell immediately after a purchase to maximize

sales.

**Outcome:**The workflow sends an email offering an upsell product, with a limited-time discount to encourage immediate action.

---

### **Use Case #4 Internal Notification for High-Value Purchases**

**Scenario:** A sales team needs to be notified when a customer purchases a high-ticket

product to ensure timely follow-up.

**Outcome:** The workflow sends an internal notification to the sales team, prompting them to reach out to the customer.

---

### **Use Case #5 Upsell and Bump Offer Tracking**

**Scenario:**A business wants to track the effectiveness of its upsells and bump offers during the checkout process.

**Outcome:** The workflow logs the upsell or bump offer acceptance in the CRM and sends a follow-up email to the customer.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. Can I trigger multiple workflows for different submission types within the same funnel?**

Yes, you can set up separate workflows for each submission type (Optin, Sale, Upsell, Bump) by using specific filters to activate them accordingly.

**Q. How can I handle abandoned carts using this trigger?**

Use the **“Opt-in”** submission type filter to target customers who didn’t complete their purchase. You can then create a workflow that sends reminder emails or offers discounts to encourage them to complete the order.

**Q. Is it possible to track upsell conversions separately from main sales?**

Yes, by using the**“Upsell”** submission type filter, you can create a dedicated workflow to track and analyze upsell conversions.

**Q. How do I test the workflow before publishing it?**

You can set the funnel to test mode and use dummy card details to simulate an order form submission. This allows you to verify that the workflow is functioning correctly before making it live.

**Q. Can I send different confirmation emails based on the product purchased?**

Absolutely. You can use the **“Product Is”** filter to create separate workflows for different products and customize the confirmation emails accordingly.

title_en: Calendar Setup Assistant in HighLevel
source_md:
Calendar Management

# Calendar Setup Assistant

Create a booking calendar through a guided, conversational setup flow—no complex forms or calendar-type decisions required.

What You'll Learn

This guide explains how Calendar Setup Assistant helps you build a working booking calendar by describing your scheduling needs in natural language or selecting guided options.

You'll learn how to start the setup conversation, answer contextual questions, preview your booking page during setup, book test appointments, and refine calendars after creation.

## What is Calendar Setup Assistant?

Calendar Setup Assistant is an AI-powered setup experience inside HighLevel Calendars that helps you create a booking calendar by answering simple questions. Instead of choosing a calendar type and configuring settings manually, you describe your scheduling needs in natural language or select suggested options, and the assistant builds the calendar for you.

The assistant guides you through key setup details such as calendar purpose, calendar name, team members, assignment logic, meeting location, availability, and related booking settings. This conversational approach reduces setup confusion and helps you reach a working calendar faster.

Once the calendar is created, you can review the generated booking link, preview the booking page, book a test appointment, or open calendar settings for additional changes. Calendar Setup Assistant may only be available to eligible users or accounts during rollout.

## Key Benefits

Calendar Setup Assistant helps you move from setup to booking faster by removing rigid upfront decisions and guiding you through the right configuration questions. This is especially useful when creating your first calendar or setting up a common booking use case.

**Faster Calendar Creation:** Create a working calendar through a guided conversation instead of configuring every setting manually.

**Simpler Setup Experience:** Describe your use case in plain language or select suggested options to get started.

**Contextual Guidance:** Answer only the questions needed for your calendar setup.

**Booking Page Preview:** Review how the booking page looks while the calendar is being configured.

**Test Booking Option:** Book a test appointment after setup to confirm the customer experience.

**Easy Manual Editing:** Open calendar settings after creation to fine-tune availability, team members, locations, and other settings.

## Where to Find Calendar Setup Assistant

Calendar Setup Assistant appears inside the Calendars area for eligible users. It opens as a side panel so you can create or learn about calendars while staying in the Calendar workspace.

To find Calendar Setup Assistant:

Step 1

Go to **Calendars** in HighLevel.

Step 2

Open the calendar workspace.

Step 3

Look for the **Calendar Setup Assistant** panel and choose one of the available options:

- **Create a new calendar**
- **Discover what calendars can do**

Note

If the assistant is not visible, the account may not be eligible during the current rollout, or you may not have the required calendar permissions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078108826/original/S_5IYPl_A2nKeRovqLHxN-x6b4Ytek4sAA.png?1786442190)

## Starting a Calendar Setup Conversation

Calendar Setup Assistant lets you begin with either a guided option or a natural language request. This makes setup more flexible for users who know exactly what they want and users who need help choosing the right calendar structure.

You can start by:

Clicking **Create a new calendar**

Clicking **Discover what calendars can do**

Selecting a suggested use case chip

Typing a request in your own words

Example requests:

- "Set up a calendar for onboarding calls."
- "Create a calendar for me and my colleague."
- "I need a class booking calendar."
- "Help me create a 1:1 appointment calendar."

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078109298/original/bln2RpR6qQrXwvBC6qL11e0A9ScI_gh4Tw.png?1786442398)

## Guided Calendar Setup Questions

The assistant asks contextual questions based on the calendar use case. This helps gather only the information needed to create a usable calendar instead of requiring you to understand every calendar setting upfront.

The assistant may ask for details such as:

Calendar purpose

Calendar name

Team members

Booking assignment logic

Meeting location

Available days and hours

Booking duration

Buffer settings

Date range

Other related calendar settings

For team calendars, the assistant may ask how bookings should be assigned, such as auto-assigning to available team members or allowing clients to choose their host.

## Booking Page Preview

The preview helps you understand how the booking page will appear to clients. As setup details are gathered, the preview shows booking details such as calendar name, appointment duration, date, timezone, and available time slots.

Use the preview to check:

Calendar name

Appointment duration

Selected date

Timezone

Available time slots

Booking page layout

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078109436/original/fFB03_ckcZAEEQWBm26ID4LV1CEocv66Rg.png?1786442476)

## Creating the Calendar

Once the assistant has enough information, it summarizes the suggested calendar setup for review. This gives you a chance to confirm key details before creating the calendar.

The summary may include:

Calendar name

Appointment duration

Meeting location

Team members

Availability

Assignment logic

After reviewing the suggested setup, you can create the calendar or request changes if the details need adjustment.

## Booking a Test Appointment

After the calendar is created, you can book a test appointment to confirm that the booking flow works as expected. This helps you experience the calendar the same way a customer or client would.

Use the test booking option to confirm:

The booking page opens correctly

Available time slots appear as expected

The booking can be completed

The appointment appears in the calendar

Any connected calendar or meeting location behaves as expected

## Editing the Calendar After Setup

Calendars created through Calendar Setup Assistant can be reviewed and adjusted in calendar settings. This is useful when you want to fine-tune settings after the assistant creates the initial calendar.

After creation, you can open calendar settings to adjust:

Calendar name

Description

Availability

Team members

Meeting location

Booking duration

Buffers

Date range

Notifications

Custom booking page settings

Use **Go to calendar settings** when available, or open the calendar manually from the Calendars settings area.

## Permissions and Access

Calendar Setup Assistant respects existing HighLevel calendar permissions. You must have the required permissions to create or manage calendars.

If you cannot create a calendar through the assistant, check:

The user's calendar permissions

The user's role and access level

Whether the account is eligible for Calendar Setup Assistant

Whether the user has access to the Calendars area

## How to Create a Calendar with Calendar Setup Assistant

A guided setup helps create a working calendar faster while still giving you control over key details. Start by describing what the calendar is for, then answer the assistant's follow-up questions.

Step 1

Go to **Calendars** in HighLevel.

Step 2

Open **Calendar Setup Assistant**.

Step 3

Click **Create a new calendar**.

Step 4

Select a suggested use case or type what you need.

Step 5

Answer the assistant's setup questions.

Step 6

Add team members when prompted, if needed.

Step 7

Choose booking assignment logic, if applicable.

Step 8

Select a meeting location.

Step 9

Set available days and hours.

Step 10

Review the suggested calendar setup.

Step 11

Click **Create it** when the setup looks correct.

Step 12

Review the generated booking link.

Step 13

Click **Book a test appointment** to validate the booking flow.

Step 14

Click **Go to calendar settings** if you need to make additional changes.

Success

Your calendar is now fully functional and appears in Calendar Settings with all standard configuration options available for manual adjustment.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is Calendar Setup Assistant?

Calendar Setup Assistant is a guided setup experience that helps eligible users create a booking calendar through conversation.

Q: Where do I find Calendar Setup Assistant?

Calendar Setup Assistant appears inside the Calendars area for eligible users. If you do not see it, your account may not currently have access or your user role may not have the required calendar permissions.

Q: Can I type my own request instead of using suggested options?

Yes. You can describe your calendar use case in your own words or select one of the suggested options.

Q: Can I edit a calendar after the assistant creates it?

Yes. Calendars created with Calendar Setup Assistant can be edited from Calendar Settings like any other calendar.

Q: Can I book a test appointment after setup?

Yes, when available, use the test booking option to confirm the booking flow from the customer’s perspective.

Q: Does Calendar Setup Assistant replace manual calendar setup?

No. Calendar Setup Assistant provides a guided setup option, but you can still create and edit calendars manually.

Q: Why do I not see Calendar Setup Assistant?

Calendar Setup Assistant may only be available to eligible users or accounts during rollout. You may also need the correct calendar permissions.
