- [How to Add a Note](#How-to-Add-a-Note)
- [How to Search for Notes](#How-to-Search-for-Notes)
- [How to Sort Notes by Date Created](#How-to-Sort-Notes-by-Date-Created)
- [How to Add Appointment Notes Across Related Records](#How-to-Add-Appointment-Notes-Across-Related-Records)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Relevant Articles](#Relevant-Articles-)

---

# **What are Notes in HighLevel?**

Notes in HighLevel are an internal tool for documenting and tracking important information related to contacts, opportunities, and companies. They provide a centralized place for team members to log updates, reminders, or context that may be useful for future reference. Notes are strictly for internal use—clients cannot view them in their portal or through external communication.

Key Benefits of Notes

Using Notes effectively helps businesses maintain context and improve collaboration. Here are the main benefits:

- **Centralized Record keeping:** Keep important details in one place for easy reference.
- **Internal Collaboration:**Share context among team members without exposing it to clients.
- **Improved Tracking:** Document key updates like calls, payments, or follow-ups.
- **Flexible Organization:**Add, search, filter, and view notes across contacts, opportunities, and companies.
- **Faster Prioritization:**Pin critical notes to keep key context at the top of the timeline.
- **Better Organization:**Add note titles and color labels to structure notes and scan updates faster.
- **Centralized Documentation:** Attach files to notes to keep supporting documents with the related record.

---

## **Notes in Contacts Module**

Each contact in HighLevel has its own Notes section where internal users can document updates specific to that contact.

- Notes are tied directly to the selected contact.
- You can add, search, and filter notes within the contact’s profile.
- Useful for logging call summaries, payment confirmations, or client preferences.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067210252/original/IGBiCIC-fganA111ZChGt2WziqAbdvBPnA.gif?1773835777)

---

## **Access the Notes Section from Contacts**

From within the Contacts module, click the Notes icon (pen and paper symbol) at the top of the contact’s record. This opens the Notes panel, where you can create, view, and manage notes related to that specific contact.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067246479/original/Ogk0iIUfJGtPDrlsH7PhDzJ293PNSsQsdw.png?1773851064)

---

## **Notes in Opportunities Module**

Opportunities provide a consolidated view of notes connected to the primary contact and related contacts.

- By default, you will see notes associated with the primary contact of the opportunity.
- Filters allow you to include additional contacts’ notes linked to the same opportunity.
- Useful for sales teams who need visibility into all interactions tied to a deal.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052913102/original/qMhM3CETBiEKhL051fi89AkjKTsIQeSj6g.gif?1756815857)

---

## **Notes in Companies Module**

The Companies module aggregates notes across all contacts associated with a company.

- The Notes section shows discussions and updates across multiple linked contacts.
- This provides a company-wide perspective rather than being tied to one individual.
- Ideal for account managers handling multiple stakeholders within one business.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052913601/original/77yOHqjllrHYwsqGEP_Hc9t38ZIPqxPqaQ.gif?1756816063)

---

## **How to Add a Note**

1. Navigate to the Notes tab within a Contact, Opportunity, or Company record.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067242704/original/hbeae8FjoLS-22OBibvhjpOuVq6x69htdw.png?1773849881)

2. Click on the Contact created and navigate to the Note icon available at the right pane. Click + Add Note.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067243332/original/2wsekOVBZXEVJ9Ohv8Z7Zb0seuEoq4v0dw.png?1773850114)

3. Enter a Title and Description.

4. Select a Color label to visually categorize the note.

5. Add Attachments to store supporting documents with the note.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078239643/original/rzr-WvfVDfMIAEZDgZRFz2B0lEnUdpT1xQ.png?1786538559)

```
Note: New documents uploaded as Notes attachments are private by default and are stored in the "Notes attachments" folder under Documents. Documents uploaded through Notes before this update retain their existing public status.
```

6. Click Save once you include your notes and other related details.

---

## **How to Search for Notes**

Use the Search bar in the Notes section to find entries by keywords.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067243723/original/Cv0yXsi28ziPfEp842NHYinCGKxG7gWJkw.png?1773850255)

---

## **How to Sort Notes by Date Created**

Click the Sort icon in the Notes section to arrange notes based on when they were created. You can choose:

- **Ascending (Oldest First):** Displays notes starting from the earliest created, useful for reviewing the full history in sequence.
- **Descending (Newest First):** Displays the most recent notes at the top, making it easier to see the latest updates quickly.

### 

---

## **How to Add Appointment Notes Across Related Records**

Some notes in HighLevel originate from appointments instead of being created directly inside a contact or opportunity record. Internal appointment notes can appear on the associated Contact, Opportunity, and Conversation records, giving teams access to the same appointment context across modules.

This behavior is different from a contact note created directly in the contact record. A contact-created note stays on the contact side and does not sync back into the appointment record.

For setup steps, note-source filters, and sync details, see [How to Create & Manage Appointment Notes & Sync them Across Records.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003444)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can contacts see the notes added to their record?**No. Notes are for internal use only. Clients cannot view notes in their portal, emails, or any external communications.

**Q: Who on my team can view notes?**Any team member with access to the record (contact, opportunity, or company) can view notes. Visibility may depend on user roles and permissions.

**Q: Can I export or download notes for reporting?**Notes cannot be directly exported as a standalone report. However, they can be included when exporting records (such as contacts) via the Smart Lists feature.

**Q: Are notes included in automations or workflows?**Notes themselves cannot trigger automations. However, actions related to the contact or opportunity (such as status updates) can be used in workflows alongside manually created notes for context.

---

## **Relevant Articles**

- [Adding Opportunity Notes in goHighlevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001999)
- [CRM Notes Association – Link Notes Across Contacts & Opportunities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005006)
- [Rich Text for Notes & Task Descriptions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006459)
- [Workflow Action: Add to Notes](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003143)

title_en: Template Library - Marketplace Integration
source_md:
Template Library Marketplace Integration brings template discovery, preview, installation, and selling into one connected experience inside HighLevel. Agencies can browse free and paid templates, install them without leaving the platform, and use Marketplace tools to sell their own templates. This helps users find ready-made assets faster while giving creators a simple path to monetize their work.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Template Library Marketplace Integration?](#What-is-Template-Library-Marketplace-Integration?)
- [Key Benefits of Template Library Marketplace Integration](#Key-Benefits-of-Template-Library-Marketplace-Integration)
- [How to Preview & Install Templates](#How-to-Preview-&-Install-Templates)
- [How to Sell Templates Through the Marketplace](#How-to-Sell-Templates-Through-the-Marketplace%C2%A0)
- [Marketplace Seller Portal Configuration](#Marketplace-Seller-Portal-Configuration)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Template Library Marketplace Integration?**

Template Library Marketplace Integration connects the Template Library with the HighLevel Marketplace so users can discover, preview, install, and sell templates from one place. Instead of relying on separate workflows, users can access Marketplace templates directly inside Template Library and move from browsing to installation more efficiently. This makes it easier to find the right template, evaluate it before use, and manage template selling from within HighLevel.

---

## **Key Benefits of Template Library Marketplace Integration**

- **Centralized discovery**: Browse Marketplace templates directly from Template Library.
- **Faster setup**: Install templates without leaving HighLevel.
- **More template options**: Access both free and paid templates in one place.
- **Creator monetization**: List your own templates on the Marketplace for sale.
- **Simplified workflows**: Preview, purchase, install, and manage templates from connected experiences.

---

## **How to Preview & Install Templates**

1. Go to **Template Library** in **Agency View**.
2. Click **Marketplace**.
3. Browse templates or use search and filters.
4. Open a template **preview**.
5. **Review** the template **details** and support information.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/HxEsF5CSUvnwPlvHP3cb+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-20+at+20.25.20.gif)
6. **Select** a **pricing** plan if the template is paid.
7. Click **Confirm** and complete the flow.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/cKWDgRYTHtBq1kxlFS06+/IeC8b42uyfphaaxZ_mYq07Pc2sCdlXS_CA.jpeg)

---

## **How to Sell Templates Through the Marketplace**

Selling templates through the Marketplace gives creators a direct way to distribute and monetize their work. The built-in selling flow reduces manual setup by sending template details into the Marketplace Seller Portal, where the remaining listing information can be completed.

1. Login to your Agency Account and **click** on **Template Library**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/uqo4KLlwqx8uE58chBwC+/Screen+Shot+2026-06-29+at+19.54.09.png)
2. Click **+ Create Template** to create a template.
3. **Select** the **sub**-**account** to create from.
4. Select a **product** **type**.
5. Choose the **template**and click **C****ontinue**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/EIzOn2qOypMHTZt5qOpc+/GIF+Recording+2026-06-29+at+20.07.15.gif)
6. **Rename** your **template** and **click** on **create**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/H5EhN9CsaWoH2Zp5ihAE+/Screen+Shot+2026-06-29+at+20.13.38.png)
7. **Edit** **Template** **Info** and click on **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/bZOOYMiGa4CzUYnThGHo+/Screen+Shot+2026-06-29+at+20.16.58.png)
8. Click the **three-dot menu** in the template preview.
9. Select **Sell Template On The Marketplace**.
10. In the confirmation modal, click **Go to Seller Portal**.
11. Complete the required Marketplace listing details.
12. **Submit** the template for review.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/VukgOIVXvreP7gk4gMK1+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-20+at+20.19.23.gif)

---

## **Marketplace Seller Portal Configuration**

Completing the Seller Portal setup ensures your template listing includes the information buyers need before purchasing or installing. Accurate listing details, support details, and pricing help reduce confusion and improve the buyer experience.

### **Template Listing Details**

Template listing details help buyers understand what the template includes and how it should be used. Well-prepared listing information also improves discoverability inside the Marketplace.

Add or review the following information in the Seller Portal:

- Template link
- Template name
- About information
- Prerequisites
- Template description
- Product type
- Template category
- Tags
- Template types
- Customization details
- Cover image

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074516930/original/X0q3posEYtBcMZ6OxCTExs3oX9P8plai7g.png?1782403675)**

### **Support Details**

Support information helps buyers understand how to contact the seller and what kind of assistance is available after installation or purchase. Clear support details build trust and reduce post-purchase friction.

Add or review the following support information:

- Support email
- Documentation URL
- Support website URL
- Support phone number
- Terms and Conditions URL
- Privacy Policy URL

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074517243/original/k6aRR4SinrLfXKWC1WDfgrTXxTvZMG87rA.png?1782403791)**

Buyers may also be able to view support information from the template details panel before installing the template.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074517586/original/vo5MixFW7CMfbxTYVZOKi9fJctpYtxw0OA.png?1782403914)**

### **Pricing Details**

Pricing setup defines how a paid template is presented to buyers during installation. Clear plan names and pricing details help users understand what they are purchasing before they continue.

When configuring pricing, add:

- Pricing type
- Amount
- Plan name
- Optional plan features

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074517692/original/VNPoAHujscP8Fuvj1labJJyC7bdgMF_I2g.png?1782403997)**

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is the payment for templates one-time or recurring?**  
Templates are available on a one-time payment basis. Once purchased, you can use the template without any recurring charges.

**Q: What happens after I install a template?**The template will be available under My Templates and can be edited and used in builders.

**Q: Can I update a template after listing it?**  
Yes, you can refresh your template and share updates with users via the What’s New section.

**Q: Can I install both free and paid templates from Template Library?**  
Yes. Users can browse free and paid templates from the **Marketplace**and complete the required install or purchase flow.

**Q: Can I filter Marketplace templates before installing them?**

Yes. Available filters can help narrow templates by items such as pricing and install status.

**Q: Where do installed templates appear after installation?**  
Installed templates can be accessed from **My Templates** in the relevant builder.

**Q: What information do I need before submitting a template for review?**

You should complete the required listing details, support details, and pricing details if the template is paid.

**Q: Can buyers view seller support information before installing a template?**  
Yes. Support details may be visible from the template details experience.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Template Library Overview & Setup](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001236650-template-library-overview-setup)
- [Add Custom Templates to Template Library](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001304-add-custom-templates-to-template-library)
- [Template Library for Workflows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005613-template-library-for-workflows)
- [How to manage categories, types and tags?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003112)
- [Template Library Visibility Control for Sub-Accounts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005230)

title_en: How to Use Post Approvals in Social Planner
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/zOjqIYzuMcY?&wmode=opaque)

Social Planner's post approval feature allows team members to review social media content before it is published. Users can create and schedule posts, assign an approver, and receive feedback before the content is added to the publishing schedule.

Approvers can review posts, make edits, approve or reject content, and adjust the scheduled publication date and time. This helps teams maintain content quality and collaborate more effectively.

This article explains how to submit posts for internal approval, review approval requests, manage rejected posts, configure approval notifications, and submit bulk posts for approval.

```
Note: If you need approval from a client or external stakeholder who does not have access to HighLevel, see External Link Approval Flow in Social Planner.
```

#### **Covered in this Article:**

#### [Steps to get started with post approval flow -](#Steps-to-get-started-with-post-approval-flow--%C2%A0)

#### [Editing and applying an Email Template as the Post Approval Email:](#Editing-and-applying-an-Email-Template-as-the-Post-Approval-Email%3A)

#### [How to schedule the CSV for Approving bulk posts?](#How-to-schedule-the-CSV-for-Approving-bulk-posts?)

---

## **How to Submit a Post for Approval**

Follow these steps to create a social media post and submit it for review.

1. Navigate to **Marketing > Social Planner** in your HighLevel account.
2. Click **New Post** and create your social media post.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084928844/original/5Hmc6Joinojvt3WiLjDj0yHFCzNocpsJPw.png?1793790809)
3. Add the post content, media, hashtags, and other details as needed.
4. Select the option to schedule the post for approval.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084928910/original/DtFDfU-YjNzGUgOpyopOAL6C70ExN6m9Og.png?1793790831)
5. Choose the date and time when the post should be published.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084929032/original/qLVQ0uN4E_GsKapFV1yCKhrmpRZesg0Gzg.png?1793790884)
6. Select the team member responsible for approving the post.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084929085/original/D64s9qxnrpEuO0WoXMoOxrtF1-JLdTgQiw.png?1793790919)
7. Add an internal note to provide context or instructions for the reviewer, if needed.
8. Submit the post for approval.

The post is then available for the selected approver to review.

---

### **Approval Request Notifications**

When a post is submitted for approval, Social Planner can send an email notification to the selected approver.

The email is sent when the **Request for Post Approval** notification is enabled in Social Planner's notification settings.

Approvers can also access posts awaiting review from the **Content > Approval** tab in Social Planner.

For instructions on managing approval notifications, see [How to Manage Social Planner Email Notifications](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002407).

---

## **Editing and applying an Email Template as the Post Approval Email:**

Users can set the email for approval from Social Planner Settings. The email template can be branded by visiting **Marketing > Emails> Templates > New > Email Marketing Templates**  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48275003974/original/JbZqtJEP21bG7zSQEBIcw8lBCo-EpKoAbQ.png?1673541277)

You will then be taken to the Template Library where you will need to head to **System Templates> Social Planner : Post Approval** and use the template. You can edit it as you see fit.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48275004276/original/H3HxcY2vYP0ctLVJWNR34FHNE9Jpp6A3Bg.png?1673541333)

That template can then be applied to the Post Approval email flow in Social Planner **Settings> Notifications:**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48275003279/original/tZg4MDksmtgmJqElCq8JhKJN18Ih6MRr3Q.png?1673541093)**

**Choose the email template**under **Setup Email template for Social Post Approval**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48275003362/original/SuRrc78gn4HDJcewt5urj4Z61F4UAjOZzQ.png?1673541115)**

---

## **How to schedule the CSV for Approving bulk posts?**

1. Create a new CSV when you click "**New Post**" button
2. Once the user adds the CSV file and Select the Socials, there will be option to **Select an Approver**.  
    **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48274895622/original/llrQ2L893aD17J19tI91bIQ277mjhZXgUA.png?1673523102)**
3. Once the posts are imported, they go for review from the chosen approver. Once approved, they are scheduled on the social calendar.

---

## **How to Submit Bulk Posts for Approval**

Social Planner allows users to submit multiple posts for approval as part of the bulk scheduling workflow.

You can use a CSV or XLSX file to prepare and upload multiple social media posts.

### 

### **Submit Bulk Posts for Approval**

1. Navigate to **Marketing > Social Planner**.
2. Click **New Post** and select **Upload from CSV**.
3. Select the appropriate CSV format and upload your completed CSV or XLSX file.
4. Click **Next**.
5. Select the social media accounts where the posts will be published.
6. Enable **Send for approval**.
7. Select the team member who should approve the posts.
8. Click **Create**.
9. Review the imported post information and correct any errors identified by the system.
10. Follow the remaining scheduling and import steps to complete the bulk upload.

For detailed instructions on preparing your file, validating posts, and completing the import, see [Social Planner – Advanced CSV for Bulk Scheduling](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005542-social-planner-advanced-csv-for-bulk-scheduling).

```
Note: Posts submitted for approval require review before they proceed through the approved publishing workflow.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### 

**Where can I find posts awaiting approval?**

Navigate to **Marketing > Social Planner > Content > Approval** to view posts awaiting review.

**Can an approver edit a post before approving it?**

Yes. Approvers can open a post and select **Edit** to make changes before approval.

**Can an approver change the scheduled publication time?**

Yes. The approver can update the date and time from the approval review screen before selecting **Approve**.

**Why didn't the approver receive an approval request email?**

Check whether the **Request for Post Approval** notification is enabled under **Social Planner > Settings > Notifications**.

Also verify that the intended approver was selected when submitting the post.

For notification configuration instructions, see [How to Manage Social Planner Email Notifications](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002407).

**Can external clients approve social media posts?**

Yes. Social Planner supports a separate external approval process using secure approval links.

See [External Link Approval Flow in Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007623-external-link-approval-flow-in-social-planner).

**Can I submit multiple posts for approval at once?**

Yes. Use the bulk CSV scheduling workflow and enable **Send for approval** when configuring the upload.

See [Social Planner – Advanced CSV for Bulk Scheduling](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005542-social-planner-advanced-csv-for-bulk-scheduling).

---

## **Related Articles**

- [External Link Approval Flow in Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007623-external-link-approval-flow-in-social-planner)
- [How to Manage Social Planner Email Notifications](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002407)
- [Social Planner – Advanced CSV for Bulk Scheduling](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005542-social-planner-advanced-csv-for-bulk-scheduling)
- [Create Workflows with Social Planner Posts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009545-create-workflows-with-social-planner-posts)

title_en: WhatsApp User Permissions in HighLevel
source_md:
Granular WhatsApp user permissions let admins control which WhatsApp configuration actions each user can perform. Instead of granting broad access, admins can separately allow or restrict template management, Flows, phone numbers, business profile updates, and WhatsApp disconnection.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are WhatsApp User Permissions?](#what-are-whatsapp-permissions)
- [Available WhatsApp Permissions](#available-permissions)
- [How WhatsApp Permissions Work](#how-permissions-work)
- [Agency and Sub-Account Permissions](#agency-subaccount)
- [Audit Logs](#audit-logs)
- [WhatsApp Permissions and Reselling](#reselling)
- [Set Up WhatsApp User Permissions](#setup-permissions)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **What Are WhatsApp User Permissions?**

WhatsApp user permissions are granular access controls that determine which WhatsApp configuration actions an individual user can perform.

They allow admins to restrict sensitive configuration changes without necessarily removing a user's broader access to WhatsApp.

---

## **Available WhatsApp Permissions**

Seven individual permissions are available:

- **Create/edit WhatsApp templates:** Create new templates and make supported changes to existing templates.
- **Delete WhatsApp templates:** Delete templates where deletion is supported.
- **Create/edit WhatsApp Flows:** Create new Flows and make supported changes to existing Flows.
- **Delete/deprecate WhatsApp Flows:** Perform supported delete or deprecate actions on Flows.
- **Update WhatsApp business profile:** Update supported WhatsApp Business Profile information.
- **Add/manage WhatsApp phone numbers:** Add and manage supported phone numbers connected to WhatsApp.
- **Disconnect WhatsApp integration:** Disconnect the WhatsApp integration.

```
Note: Disconnecting the WhatsApp integration and canceling a WhatsApp subscription are separate actions.
```

---

## **How WhatsApp Permissions Work**

The granular permissions apply to configuration actions such as creating, editing, deleting, managing, or disconnecting supported WhatsApp resources.

Read and preview behavior continues to use the existing broader WhatsApp access controls. Disabling a create or edit permission does not automatically remove all visibility into that resource.

### **Default Permission Behavior**

The granular permissions use an opt-out rollout. Supported existing users retain their current WhatsApp management access by default until an administrator disables individual permissions.

### **What Happens When Permission Is Disabled?**

When a required WhatsApp permission is disabled:

- The corresponding action is unavailable in the HighLevel interface.
- The user can receive contextual permission messaging for the restricted action.
- Supported direct API requests for unauthorized actions return a **403 Forbidden** response.

For example, a user may still be able to open WhatsApp Templates but be unable to create or edit a template if **Create/edit WhatsApp templates** is disabled.

---

## **Agency and Sub-Account Permissions**

WhatsApp permissions can be managed from the Users area that matches the user's access scope.

- **Agency admins:** Manage applicable user permissions from **Agency View → Settings → Users**.
- **Sub-Account admins:** Manage applicable user permissions from **Sub-Account → Settings → Users**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082703130/original/x5RZ4xgdZ4PUKmapWlWRZFDhUd8oxhmJfQ.png?1791356587)

WhatsApp permissions are user-scoped. When a permission is granted or revoked, it applies to that user's applicable access rather than creating a separate WhatsApp permission profile for every individual Sub-Account.

---

## **Audit Logs**

Applicable WhatsApp permission changes are recorded as user-related audit activity at the Agency level.

To review changes, go to **Agency View → Settings → Audit Logs** and use the available filters to locate the relevant user or activity.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082703216/original/AZuFR7JinS1tbcYA3W0K4PDTFV2JvOeCjA.png?1791356668)

---

## **WhatsApp Permissions and Reselling**

WhatsApp user permissions and WhatsApp reselling are separate controls.

The WhatsApp permission toggles remain available in user management even when WhatsApp reselling is turned off. Disabling reselling does not remove the WhatsApp controls from **Roles & Permissions**.

---

## **Set Up WhatsApp User Permissions**

### **Agency Users**

1. From **Agency View**, go to **Settings → Users**.
2. Open the user you want to update.
3. Open **Roles & Permissions**.
4. Locate the **WhatsApp** permissions section.
5. Turn each permission on or off based on the user's responsibilities.
6. Review the user's remaining module and granular permissions.
7. Save the changes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082703579/original/7TNkeccZjL4PGZTTi-2iGayRfW5u7QoYpw.png?1791356957)

### **Sub-Account Users**

1. Open the applicable Sub-Account.
2. Go to **Settings → Users**.
3. Open the user you want to update.
4. Open **Roles & Permissions**.
5. Locate the **WhatsApp** permissions section.
6. Enable or disable each permission based on the actions the user should be allowed to perform.
7. Save the changes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082703495/original/1zJx_8IKLWPgEcFu_yzK71g7w0fVT7tiTQ.png?1791356931)

```
Tip: If a user suddenly cannot perform a specific WhatsApp configuration action, compare that action with the seven WhatsApp permission toggles before changing broader module access.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why can a user open WhatsApp Settings but not create a template?**

The user may have WhatsApp access but not the **Create/edit WhatsApp templates** permission. Review the user's **Roles & Permissions** settings and confirm that the required WhatsApp permission is enabled.

**Q: Can I allow someone to edit templates without letting them delete templates?**

Yes. Template creation/editing and template deletion are separate permissions.

**Q: Can I let a user create WhatsApp Flows without allowing them to delete or deprecate existing Flows?**

Yes. **Create/edit WhatsApp Flows** and **Delete/deprecate WhatsApp Flows** are controlled separately.

**Q: Does removing a create or edit permission prevent the user from viewing the resource?**

Not necessarily. Granular permissions govern supported configuration changes, while read and preview behavior continues to use broader WhatsApp access controls.

**Q: What happens if an integration performs a WhatsApp action the user is not permitted to perform?**

Supported unauthorized API mutation requests return a **403 Forbidden** response.

**Q: Why is the WhatsApp permissions section still visible when WhatsApp reselling is turned off?**

User permissions and reselling are separate controls. Turning off WhatsApp reselling does not remove the WhatsApp permission controls from user management.

**Q: Where can I see who changed a user's WhatsApp permissions?**

Applicable permission changes are recorded as user-related audit activity. Agency admins can review them from **Agency View → Settings → Audit Logs**.

**Q: Does the Disconnect WhatsApp permission also allow a user to cancel the WhatsApp subscription?**

No. Disconnecting the integration and canceling a subscription are separate actions. Follow the documented subscription-cancellation process when canceling service.

---

title_en: WhatsApp Conversation: Call Recording
source_md:
# WhatsApp Call Recording and Transcription

Record WhatsApp calls and automatically generate written transcripts in HighLevel to keep important customer conversations accessible.

 Call recordings and transcripts appear directly in Conversations, alongside the contact's messages. Teams can replay calls, review speaker-separated transcripts, and reference important details without relying on manual notes.

Configurable consent announcements also help inform customers before recording begins.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [WhatsApp Call Recording and Transcription](#WhatsApp-Call-Recording-and-Transcription)
  - [Key Benefits of WhatsApp Call Recording and Transcription](#Key-Benefits-of-WhatsApp-Call-Recording-and-Transcription)
  - [WhatsApp Call Recordings and Playback](#WhatsApp-Call-Recordings-and-Playback)
  - [How to Enable Call Recording](#How-to-Enable-Call-Recording)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

What Is Call Recording and Transcription?

WhatsApp Call Recording and Transcription allows businesses to automatically capture voice conversations and convert them into written transcripts.

Once enabled for a WhatsApp number, completed call recordings and transcripts are saved in the contact's conversation history, making them easy to review alongside previous messages.

Transcripts distinguish between team members and customers, helping users understand who said what. The feature also automatically detects the language spoken during a call and includes a configurable recording consent announcement that plays before recording begins.

```
Note: This feature is currently available free of charge. However, Meta may introduce charges for its usage in the future.
```

---

## 

## [동영상](https://watchclueso.com/embed/m78srer1593qsskb)

## 

## **Key Benefits of WhatsApp Call Recording and Transcription**

Keeping a record of customer calls helps teams maintain accurate information, improve collaboration, and deliver more consistent service. With recordings and transcripts accessible in Conversations, users can focus on the customer during the call and review important details afterward.

- **Centralized Conversation History:** Access WhatsApp call recordings, transcripts, and customer messages in one conversation thread.
- **Accurate Call Records:** Review what was discussed, including customer requests, commitments, and agreed next steps.
- **Faster Call Reviews:** Use playback controls and written transcripts to locate important information without listening to an entire call.
- **Reduced Manual Note-Taking:** Stay focused on the conversation while recording and transcription capture the details.
- **Improved Team Collaboration:** Help managers review customer interactions and provide feedback based on actual conversations.
- **Smoother Customer Handovers:** Give team members access to previous call details without requiring customers to repeat information.
- **Multilingual Support:** Automatically detect spoken languages for transcription and configure consent announcements in supported languages.

---

## **WhatsApp Call Recordings and Playback**

Call recordings preserve the audio from completed WhatsApp conversations so teams can revisit important details when needed. Recordings appear directly in the contact's Conversations thread, keeping them connected to the customer's communication history.

Once a recorded call is available, users can:

- **Play the recording:** Listen to the conversation directly from Conversations.
- **Navigate through the audio:** Scrub through the recording to locate specific moments.
- **Adjust playback speed:** Speed up playback to review longer conversations more efficiently.
- **Review conversation context:** Reference the customer's existing WhatsApp messages while listening to the recording.

These controls are particularly useful when reviewing customer requests, verifying details, or preparing follow-up communication.

---

## **How to Enable Call Recording**

Go to Settings > WhatsApp > Calling > Click on the Phone Number

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083398190/original/YnD6W8Y-h9a6T_NvSzdE94r-OuSOM6YZDg.png?1792061900)

Enable Call Recording and Call Transcript

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083398311/original/ga6YzFvvE_jPuwICwm2L8jiYBxKMRhC2BA.png?1792061946)

Click Save

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083398453/original/k4GpMN4_p217GBdXGI2OH8xIxL-B3tHXjg.png?1792061986)

---

How to Change the Recording Language

```
Multiple Languages Supported: Call recording supports multiple languages. You can select the language to enable transcription in a different language.
```

Click on the Pencil Icon

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083398664/original/FzzMUudOj7V88C30OmK3uV0GJW3rJVQsqw.png?1792062024)

Select the Language You Want to Use

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083396383/original/e-anH-YoAf4amvSYX-Aqf75m636hAVKXpA.png?1792061158)

---

How a Recorded Call Appears

Once a call is recorded and the transcript is processed, it will appear in the contact's conversation view as shown below.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083396556/original/jUjUpxzPxbjTg0tAn_xoCS0iI5GcM_mhkA.png?1792061248)

---

How Your Team Can Use Recordings and Transcripts

Revisit Property Enquiries

A real estate agent can return to the recording and clarify the details of what was discussed during a property enquiry before following up — no need to rely on memory.

Sales Manager Review

Sales managers can scan transcripts for questions, objections, and agreed next steps, then listen to the relevant audio when tone or context matters. Coaching can begin with an actual customer interaction rather than a hypothetical scenario.

Smoother Handovers

When another team member takes over, they have the original conversation to refer to — not just a brief note saying "customer interested."

Notes and Follow-Ups

Transcripts serve as a reference when preparing notes, summaries, and follow-up messages. Important details no longer need to be reconstructed from memory.

```
The value is not simply having a recording. It is being able to return to the conversation when a decision, commitment, or detail matters.
```

---

Recording and Transcription Pricing

According to the release details, **recording and transcription are currently free**. When pricing is introduced, the two features will be priced separately.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I configure call recording and transcription for a specific WhatsApp number?**

Yes. Recording and transcription settings are configured at the WhatsApp number level. Select the number you want to configure under WhatsApp Calling settings.

**Q: Does the consent announcement language need to match the language spoken during the call?**

No. The consent announcement language determines how the recording notice is delivered. Transcription automatically detects the language spoken during the conversation.

**Q: Why can't I find the WhatsApp Calling settings?**

WhatsApp Calling must be available for your sub-account, and the connected number must meet the applicable eligibility requirements. Review the [WhatsApp Calling in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007253-whatsapp-calling-in-highlevel) guide for setup requirements and availability.

**Q: Can I review a call without listening to the complete recording?**

Yes. When a transcript is available, you can read the conversation to find relevant details. You can also use the recording's playback controls to move through the audio and adjust playback speed.

**Q: Why is a transcript not immediately available after a call ends?**

Transcripts are generated after call processing. The transcript may not appear immediately when a call finishes. Check the contact's conversation again after processing has completed.

**Q: Does enabling WhatsApp call recording also enable recording for standard phone calls?**

No. The configuration described here applies to WhatsApp Calling. Standard phone-system recording and transcription use separate configurations.

title_en: Live Rooms in Communities Events
source_md:
Hosting events in HighLevel Communities now includes a built-in **Live Room** option, making it easier to schedule and run live sessions directly from Community Events. Admins and owners can use Live Room for a native HighLevel experience or continue using Zoom, Google Meet, or another custom meeting link. This article explains how Live Room works in Community Events, when to use each location type, and how to set up your next workshop, Q&A, coaching call, or launch event.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Live Room for Community Events?](#What-is-Live-Room-for-Community-Events?)
- [Key Benefits of Live Room for Community Events](#Key-Benefits-of-Live-Room-for-Community-Events)
- [Live Room Experience](#Live-Room-Experience)
- [Attendee Join and Registration Experience](#Attendee-Join-and-Registration-Experience)
- [How To Setup Live Room for Community Events](#How-To-Setup-Live-Room-for-Community-Events)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Live Room for Community Events?**

Live Room for Community Events is a built-in event location option that lets you host a live session directly inside a HighLevel Community. Instead of adding an external meeting link, you can select **Live Room** while creating the event so members can join from the event page.

Live Room uses HighLevel’s Go Live experience to support interactive sessions with video, audio, chat, reactions, screen sharing, and host controls. Community Events already centralize event details, registration, calendar actions, visibility, pricing, and reminders, and Live Room adds a native meeting option to that same event workflow.

```
If you want to go live instantly without creating a scheduled Community Event, refer to Communities - Use Go Live to Host Meetings & Broadcasts.
```

  

---

## **Key Benefits of Live Room for Community Events**

- **Native event hosting:** Host live sessions directly inside Communities without requiring members to install another meeting tool.
- **Flexible meeting options:** Choose Live Room, Zoom, Google Meet, or another custom link depending on how you want to run the event.
- **Simpler attendee experience:** Give members one clear event page where they can view details, register, add the event to their calendar, and join.
- **Built-in engagement:** Use Go Live features such as chat, reactions, raise hand, screen sharing, and host controls to keep members involved during the session.
- **Community-based reminders:** Use Community Event reminder emails and calendar options to help members remember upcoming sessions.
- **Web and mobile access:** Members can discover and register for Community Events on web and mobile, and Live Room events can be joined from supported browsers or the HighLevel mobile app when signed in.

---

## **Live Room Experience**

Live Room gives hosts and members an interactive meeting space connected to the Community Event. This helps keep the live conversation, event context, and follow-up activity close to the Community where members are already engaging.

Live Room uses the Go Live meeting experience, which includes:

- Video and audio participation
- Speaker and Gallery-style layouts
- Screen sharing
- Real-time chat
- Emoji reactions
- Raise hand
- Host and attendee roles
- Host permissions to manage participant access and session controls

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070746570/original/K13JQ_napxId3MuQQq76rc2Vi3annogILg.png?1778099152)

---

## **Attendee Join and Registration Experience**

A clear attendee flow reduces confusion before the event starts. Community Events help members find upcoming events, register, add events to their calendar, receive reminders, and join from the same Community experience.

Members can:

- Discover events from the group’s **Events** tab.
- Register for events they want to attend.
- Add events to Google Calendar or iCal.
- Receive in-app notifications and email reminders for upcoming events.
- Join Live Room events directly from the event page.
- Open the configured external link for Zoom, Meet, or Other events.

---

## **How To Setup Live Room for Community Events**

A proper setup helps members quickly understand the event, register, and join from the correct location when the session starts. Live Room uses the standard Community Event creation flow, while Zoom, Google Meet, and custom links remain available for events that need an external meeting platform.

1. Go to **Memberships → Communities → Groups**. Click **Login** on the group where you want to create the event.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070745686/original/eAGqDqmw9shMdUEzB1Mc8H0jbJxLD8irtA.png?1778097689)
2. Open the **Events** tab. Click **Create Event**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070746126/original/eoBjJlfKUAehD7biTbae-KA2aOffNUI1og.png?1778098302)
3. Enter the event title, description, date, time, duration, and timezone.  
   Add an event image or banner if needed.  
   Find the **Location type** field and select **Live Room** to host the event directly inside HighLevel Communities.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070746155/original/d1irQNlJdDVdIG9gpHtQ9MoYipYrBgGujQ.png?1778098361)
4. Choose who can view or attend the event. Configure any course, group, private channel, or membership-level restrictions where available. Click **Next** to proceed.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070746186/original/fa5kLf1vdn7iNX2TnY88ahgXwbYGhyw6tA.png?1778098462)
5. Select whether the event is free or paid. If the event is paid, add the price and currency. Click **Create Event.**  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070746298/original/ZWBWCQZ87C2GOt5mv4iT7DZAWU8jeFcnBg.png?1778098610)**
6. Share the event with members through a Community post, announcement, email, SMS, or other communication channel.
7. At the scheduled time, open the event from the **Events** tab and click**Live Room**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070746398/original/SKQ4zO26VyffSLOsVT1AA4SLsFzdqa71sQ.png?1778098815)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do attendees need to install anything to join a Live Room event?**  
No. Members can join from supported browsers or the HighLevel mobile app when they are signed in.

**Q: Can I still use Zoom or Google Meet for Community Events?**  
Yes. Live Room is an additional location option. You can still choose Zoom, Meet, or Other and add the external meeting link.

**Q: Can I charge for a Community Event that uses Live Room?**  
Yes. Community Events can be free or paid, and pricing is configured during event creation.

**Q: Can I restrict who can attend a Live Room event?**  
Yes. Community Events can be restricted by options such as course, group, private channel, or membership level where available.

**Q: Does Live Room replace Go Live posts in Communities?**  
No. Live Room adds a scheduled event-based way to use a native live experience. Go Live can still be used directly in Communities for meetings or broadcasts outside of a scheduled Community Event.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Community Events](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004111-community-events?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Communities - Use Go Live to Host Meetings & Broadcasts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006673-communities-use-go-live-to-host-meetings-broadcasts?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [How to Setup, Customize, and Manage Your Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000280-how-to-setup-customize-and-manage-your-communities?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## **GPT-4 Turbo: Smarter AI with High-Level**

With the rise of conversational AI, businesses need tools that are smart, scalable, and deeply integrated. HighLevel now brings this power to your automation engine through **GPT-powered AI Workflow steps**. From writing personalized follow-ups and summarizing conversations to generating dynamic email content and social captions, you’ll learn how to make your automations more intelligent, contextual, and human-like with minimal setup.

Whether you're a marketing agency, service provider, or sales team, this guide will help you unlock powerful new capabilities using AI in your existing HighLevel workflows.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047428762/original/8DsBrLzRJdAOqWnogdun4TyCpDkJahlf5w.png?1748521305)

## **What’s New**

- **GPT-4 Turbo**: Now available in AI steps with faster response times and lower cost-per-call compared to previous GPT-4 models.
- **Model Switcher UI**: Select between GPT-3.5, GPT-4, or GPT-4 Turbo directly in your workflow step.
- **Improved Prompt Handling**: Enhanced merge field support and better handling of complex instructions.
- **System Prompt (optional)**: Add tone or behavior guidance to shape the AI’s personality and output style.

---

## **Pricing of GPT-4**

HighLevel’s GPT Action is now billed at **Z****ero Markup**, meaning you pay exactly what OpenAI charges with no added fees. Pricing is token-based, calculated from the number of input tokens (your prompts) and output tokens (AI responses), and varies depending on the model selected (e.g., GPT-4o or GPT-4o Mini). This shift ensures full transparency and cost efficiency, replacing the old flat execution fee model with one that scales directly with usage.

```
IMPORTANT: Pricing has shifted from a fixed execution fee to a token-based, zero-markup model. Your costs now depend on:  
  
1. The input tokens used in your prompts  
2. The output tokens generated in the response  
3. The AI model you choose

This means you pay OpenAI's exact rates with nothing more, nothing less.
```

### **External AI Models - Based on Tokens utilized**

- **GPT-4o (per million tokens)**

  **Input** - $2.5

  **Output** - $10.00
- **GPT-4o-mini (per million tokens)**  
  **Input** - $0.15  
  **Output** - $0.60

**For example,**

With just **$10 in usage**, **GPT-4o** can process around **3 million input words** or generate about **750,000 output words**, while **GPT-4o Mini** offers far greater volume—handling roughly **50 million input words** or producing about **12.5 million output words**. This makes it easy to balance cost and performance, choosing the model that best matches your workflow’s needs.

### **What $10 Gets You**

**GPT-4o:**

- Process approximately 3 million input words OR
- Generate approximately 750,000 output words

**GPT-4o Mini:**

- Process approximately 50 million input words OR
- Generate approximately 12.5 million output words

---

## **Use Cases and Example Prompts**

| Use Cases | Prompts |
| --- | --- |
| Lead Follow-Up | “Draft a friendly message to {{contact.name}} thanking them for their interest in {{contact.custom\_value.service}}.” |
| Conversation Summary | “Summarize this conversation in 2-3 bullet points.” |
| Email Draft | “Write a persuasive email promoting our {{contact.custom\_value.offer}} to a potential client.” |

---

## **GPT Models Compared**

| **GPT 3.5 Turbo** | **GPT-4 Turbo** | **GPT-4o** | **GPT-4o Mini** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Not as good as 4 turbo | More advanced and powerful | Optimized for specific tasks | Lightweight version of GPT-4o |
| Good responses | Consistent and accurate responses | Consistent with slight trade-offs | Efficient but less comprehensive |
| Not that consistent | Can handle highly complex queries | Handles most queries effectively | Best for less complex queries |
| May struggle to connect the dots | A bit slower than GPT-4o Mini | Balanced speed and performance | Fastest in response time |
| Faster responses | Superior contextual understanding | Good contextual understanding | Adequate for basic needs |
| as per tokens utilized | as per tokens utilized | as per tokens utilized | $0.015 per execution |

---

## **The GPT-Generated Output**

After selecting and configuring the desired AI model, incorporate a 'GPT powered by OpenAI' action into your workflow to generate dynamic output aligned with your configured prompts."

1. Select the Action Type:  
     
   - Pick from predefined options:
     - Analyze Text Sentiment
     - Summarize Text
     - Translate
     - Custom (for your own prompt)
   - If using Custom, enter your own prompt (e.g., "Write a follow-up email based on this message: {{contact.message}}").
2. Use Dynamic Variables (Optional):  
     
   - Insert dynamic fields like {{contact.first\_name}} or {{event.notes}} into your prompt to personalize the output.
3. Test or Run the Workflow:  
     
   - Once the action is added, you can test the workflow using a contact to see the GPT output in action.
   - The AI output can be used in subsequent workflow steps (e.g., send as an email or SMS).

```
IMPORTANT: If you are concerned about where does the output go,

The AI-generated content can be:-  
  
1. Stored in Custom Fields
  
2. Used directly in Email or SMS steps
  
3. Logged internally or sent to a team via Slack/Webhook
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. What is GPT-4 Turbo, and how is it different from GPT-4 or GPT-3.5?**  
GPT-4 Turbo is a faster, more cost-efficient variant of GPT-4 with improved performance for high-volume use cases. Compared to GPT-3.5, it offers better contextual understanding, more accurate content generation, and supports larger prompts.

**Q. Is GPT-4 Turbo available in all HighLevel plans?**  
No. GPT-4 Turbo is part of HighLevel’s premium Content AI features. Access may vary based on your subscription plan and usage settings. Check your plan or contact support for upgrade options.

**Q. Does using GPT-4 Turbo in workflows cost extra?**  
Yes. GPT-4 Turbo is a premium workflow action, and usage is billed based on the number of tokens processed per execution. You can monitor usage and costs in the AI Billing Settings of your account.

**Q. Can I switch between GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 Turbo within the same workflow?**  
Yes. Each AI step allows you to select the model independently. You can mix and match GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and GPT-4 Turbo within a single workflow based on the complexity or budget of each step.

**Q. How many words are present in 1 million tokens?**

This is an Estimation, actual results may vary: 1,000,000 tokens × 0.75 words/token = 750,000 words

title_en: How to Add Gradient Backgrounds to Buttons in Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes
source_md:
Gradient button backgrounds let you create more modern, branded calls-to-action inside HighLevel Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes. Instead of relying only on a single solid color, you can now apply gradient styles directly from the button settings. This gives you more design flexibility without needing custom CSS for standard gradient button styling.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Gradient Button Background Styling?](#What-is-Gradient-Button-Background-Styling?)
- [Key Benefits of Gradient Button Background Styling](#Key-Benefits-of-Gradient-Button-Background-Styling)
- [Button Background Options](#Button-Background-Options)
- [Gradient Types](#Gradient-Types)
- [Gradient Angle](#Gradient-Angle)
- [Color Stops](#Color-Stops)
- [How To Setup Gradient Button Backgrounds](#How-To-Setup-Gradient-Button-Backgrounds)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles%E2%80%8B)

---

# **What is Gradient Button Background Styling?**

Gradient button background styling allows you to apply a multi-color background effect to buttons in the Form, Survey, and Quiz Builder. Instead of using one flat color, you can blend two or more colors together using supported gradient types.

This feature helps you create buttons that better match your brand, landing page design, or campaign style. You can choose between a solid background and a gradient background, then customize the gradient type, colors, angle, and color stops directly from the builder.

---

## **Key Benefits of Gradient Button Background Styling**

Gradient button backgrounds give you more control over how buttons appear across Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes. These styling options are especially useful when you want your call-to-action buttons to stand out while keeping the setup simple and code-free.

- **More Visual Flexibility:** Create button designs that feel more modern and dynamic than a single solid color.
- **No Custom Code Required:**Apply standard gradient button backgrounds directly from the button settings.
- **Brand Focused Design Control:**Blend multiple brand colors together for a more customized look.
- **Multiple Gradient Styles:**Choose from linear, radial, and angular gradient types.
- **Custom Color Blending:** Add and edit multiple color stops to control how colors transition across the button.
- **Existing Styles Remain Supported:**Current solid button background styles continue working while gradient styling adds another design option.

---

## **Button Background Options**

Button Background settings control whether a selected button uses a solid color or a gradient background. Choosing the right background type helps you match the button design to the purpose of your form, survey, or quiz.

You can choose between:

- **Solid Color:** Uses one background color for the button.
- **Gradient:**Uses multiple colors that blend together across the button.

Use a solid color when you want a clean, simple button style. Use a gradient when you want the button to feel more visually prominent or match a more dynamic page design.

---

## **Gradient Types**

Gradient types determine how the colors blend across the button. Each type creates a different visual effect, giving you more control over the final button appearance.

Supported gradient types include:

- **Linear Gradient:** Blends colors in a straight direction.
- **Radial Gradient:**Blends colors outward from a central point.
- **Angular Gradient:** Blends colors around an angle-based pattern.

Some gradient styles support angle adjustment, allowing you to change the direction or orientation of the gradient.

---

## **Gradient Angle**

Gradient angle controls the direction of supported gradient styles. Adjusting the angle changes how the colors flow across the button, which can help the button better match the surrounding page design.

For example, a linear gradient may flow from left to right, top to bottom, or diagonally depending on the selected angle. If the selected gradient type supports angle adjustment, use the angle control to fine-tune the direction of the blend.

---

## **Color Stops**

Color stops define the colors used in the gradient and where those colors appear in the blend. Adding multiple color stops gives you more control over how the gradient transitions from one color to another.

Use color stops to:

- Add two or more colors to the button background.
- Adjust how strongly each color appears.
- Create smoother or more customized transitions.
- Match brand color combinations more accurately.

---

## **How To Setup Gradient Button Backgrounds**

Proper setup helps ensure your button styling is applied to the correct element and matches the design of your form, survey, or quiz. Before making changes, select the button you want to update so the builder displays the correct button style settings.

1. Open the Form Builder, Survey Builder, or Quiz Builder in HighLevel.
2. Select the button element you want to customize.
3. Open the button style settings.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072470717/original/leKrNtFShxH8F4B7MGlXmQllArzC5LrHTw.png?1780057283)
4. Locate the Button Background section.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072471334/original/xlvUjjgr7RZ-an4I_hfEkHNqzcz6PuvJnQ.png?1780057453)
5. Choose Gradient instead of Solid Color.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072471504/original/STXFotmx430lKQ0KE4-TLMJLIYKWLdMXOA.png?1780057526)
6. Select the gradient type.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072471669/original/dtH-reNjhNgdvnbET2WfJRjijgRN7iPGBA.gif?1780057637)
7. Add or edit the gradient color stops.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072471737/original/wM7SqU_rUY468WbcfdylV29Z0eboCVpdyw.png?1780057695)
8. Adjust the gradient angle if the selected gradient type supports angle customization.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072471778/original/9t-PPrz8h2F1icXjvD16begl0BhVx3mRyA.png?1780057731)
9. Preview the form, survey, or quiz to confirm the button appears as expected.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072471850/original/zgWahThbUWoMQVEkTwkAQhrpdef0lK61-w.png?1780057775)
10. Save or publish your changes.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I still use a solid color for buttons?**A: Yes. You can choose between a solid color background and a gradient background.

**Q: Which builders support gradient button backgrounds?**A: Gradient button backgrounds are supported in the Form Builder, Survey Builder, and Quiz Builder.

**Q: Do I need custom CSS to create a gradient button background?**A: No. Standard gradient button backgrounds can now be configured directly from the button settings. Custom CSS 

may still be useful for advanced styling needs that are not available through the built-in controls.

**Q: Can I use more than two colors in a gradient?**A: Yes. You can add and edit multiple color stops for more customized button designs.

**Q: Will this change existing button styles automatically?**A: No. Existing button styles continue working. You can manually switch a button from a solid background to a gradient background when you want to use the new styling option.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Right Sidebar in Form and Survey Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004090)
- [Communities - How to Add Custom CSS/JS to Groups](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002165)
