title_en: A basic guide of RSS Campaign
source_md:
RSS email campaigns use published content from an RSS feed to create scheduled emails in HighLevel. Instead of rebuilding a newsletter for every new post, you can reuse one email design and choose when subscribers receive updates. RSS content blocks display the feed information, while **RSS Schedule** controls recurring delivery. This guide explains the essentials, including setup, testing, and what happens when no new content is available.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are RSS Email Campaigns in HighLevel?](#what-are-rss-email-campaigns)
- [Key Benefits of RSS Email Campaigns](#key-benefits)
- [How RSS Email Campaigns Work](#how-rss-campaigns-work)
- [Before You Begin](#before-you-begin)
- [How to Set Up an RSS Email Campaign](#setup-rss-campaign)
- [What to Expect from Scheduled RSS Emails](#scheduled-rss-emails)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

# **What Are RSS Email Campaigns in HighLevel?**

**RSS (Really Simple Syndication)** is a format websites use to publish updates, such as blog posts or news articles. An RSS email campaign reads those updates from a feed URL and places eligible posts into an email when its scheduled send runs.

The campaign runs on the frequency you choose; it does **not** automatically send a separate email every time a post is published.

---

## **Key Benefits of RSS Email Campaigns**

Recurring RSS emails help keep subscribers informed without manually building a new campaign for each blog update.

- **Less Manual Work:** Reuse one email design for multiple sends.
- **Consistent Updates:** Deliver new posts on a recurring schedule.
- **Flexible Content:** Show post titles, excerpts, images, or other supported feed details.
- **Controlled Volume:** Limit how many recent eligible posts appear in each email.

---

## **How RSS Email Campaigns Work**

RSS campaigns combine a source feed, content blocks, and an RSS-specific sending schedule. Each component has a different purpose.

| **Component** | **Purpose** |
| --- | --- |
| **RSS Feed URL** | Supplies published posts and their available details. |
| **RSS Items** | Displays individual posts, such as titles, excerpts, and links. |
| **RSS Header** | Optionally displays feed-level information, such as the feed name or description. |
| **RSS Schedule** | Sets when the campaign checks for content, who receives it, and how many items to include. |

Use **RSS Items** for the posts themselves. **RSS Header** is optional; it does not replace the RSS Items block.

---

## **Before You Begin**

A working RSS feed and a prepared email audience are the main requirements. Check the feed before designing the email so you know which post details are available.

- **RSS Feed URL:** Use a valid, accessible feed from your website or another content source. For a HighLevel blog, see [RSS Feed for Blogs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001231723-rss-feed-for-blogs).
- **Published Content:** Confirm the feed includes posts with the titles, links, and other details you want to display. HighLevel blog RSS feeds include published posts, not drafts.
- **Email Setup:** Prepare your sender details and recipient audience before scheduling.

---

## **How to Set Up an RSS Email Campaign**

Build the email using RSS blocks, test it with the actual feed URL, then choose **RSS Schedule** for recurring delivery. Using the correct sending method is essential for populating RSS content.

1. Go to **Marketing → Emails → Campaigns → Email Campaigns** and create a **New Campaign**.
2. Open a template or start a design in the **Email Builder**. Add an **RSS Items** block to display posts. Add **RSS Header** only if you want feed-level information.
3. Choose a supported RSS Items layout, such as **Title** or **Excerpts**, and adjust its available formatting.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083459049/original/emlqltn5gwkZTFOSNEz5xSr-S6tAqtQTRQ.png?1792104031)

4. Preview the email. To test feed content, open the menu beside **Preview**, select **Test Email**, and enter a valid **RSS Feed URL** along with the requested test details. Open the received email and check its post content and links.

5. Click **Send or Schedule** and select **RSS Schedule**. Enter the feed URL, choose the available recurrence and send time, and set the **maximum number of items**.

6. Complete the sender details, subject line, and recipient selection. Review the next execution time and displayed time zone.

7. Click **Schedule** to confirm the recurring campaign.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083459116/original/9kOz3escuNkPGMImn5LIXhIyxooeb0Y-9w.png?1792104201)

```
Important: Use RSS Schedule for emails containing RSS variables. Standard Send Now, Schedule, and Batch Schedule delivery can leave RSS content blank. An RSS test email also needs a valid RSS Feed URL.
```

For detailed screenshots and campaign-management instructions, see [How to Send RSS Email Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215372-how-to-send-rss-email-campaign-s-).

---

## **What to Expect from Scheduled RSS Emails**

The feed's available posts and your campaign settings determine what readers receive. Reviewing the first scheduled execution helps confirm that the results match your expectations.

- **New Posts:** Scheduled sends use eligible feed updates for the relevant period, rather than sending every past article in the feed.
- **Maximum Items:** If more posts are eligible than the limit you set, HighLevel includes the most recent eligible posts up to that limit.
- **No New Posts:** If the feed has no new items for a scheduled cycle, HighLevel skips that send. Check the campaign audit log when investigating a skipped execution.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083459263/original/OqWTjQ2YrBsmVpm8htCNmFeCKothZ5mZGg.png?1792104729)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use RSS information in the email subject line?**

Yes. HighLevel documents feed-level values such as `{{rss_feed.title}}` for use in an RSS campaign's subject line.

**Q: Why are RSS placeholders blank in my test email?**

Confirm you entered a valid **RSS Feed URL** when sending the test. Also check that the feed contains the fields used in your email layout.

**Q: Why is an image missing from an RSS post?**

The feed may not supply compatible image data, or the chosen RSS Items layout may not display images. Check the source feed and select an image-compatible layout.

**Q: Can I change an RSS campaign after scheduling it?**

Eligible scheduled campaigns can be edited or rescheduled using the available campaign actions. Follow the current [RSS campaign management instructions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215372-how-to-send-rss-email-campaign-s-); make changes before the next execution.

**Q: Can I resend an RSS email to people who did not open it?**

Yes. For an already-sent RSS campaign, use **Resend to Unopened** where available. See [Resend to Unopened for RSS and Batch Scheduled Emails](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005570-resend-to-unopened-for-rss-and-batch-scheduled-emails).

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Send RSS Email Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215372-how-to-send-rss-email-campaign-s-)
- [How to Use RSS Blocks in the Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001201780-how-to-use-rss-blocks-in-the-email-builder)
- [RSS Feed for Blogs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001231723-rss-feed-for-blogs)
- [Preview and Test Your Email Campaigns/Templates](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215382-preview-and-test-your-email-campaigns-templates)
- [RSS Email Body Showing HTML Tags? How to Fix It](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009199-rss-email-body-showing-html-tags-how-to-fix-it)
- [Resend to Unopened for RSS and Batch Scheduled Emails](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005570-resend-to-unopened-for-rss-and-batch-scheduled-emails)

title_en: How Auto-Translated Greetings Work in Voice AI
source_md:
Make your Voice AI Agent feel more natural for every caller by automatically translating the initial greeting when you change the agent’s language. This update helps you launch multilingual voice experiences faster, reduces manual setup, and creates a more localized first impression. If you create or edit Voice AI Agents in HighLevel, this feature helps streamline setup while keeping your greeting aligned with the selected language.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Voice AI Auto-Translated Greeting Message?](#What-is-Voice-AI-Auto-Translated-Greeting-Message?)
- [Key Benefits of Voice AI Auto-Translated Greeting Message](#Key-Benefits-of-Voice-AI-Auto-Translated-Greeting-Message)
- [How the Auto-Translated Greeting Works](#How-the-Auto-Translated-Greeting-Works)
- [Where to Find the Initial Greeting Message](#Where-to-Find-the-Initial-Greeting-Message)
- [How To Setup Voice AI Auto-Translated Greeting Message](#How-To-Setup-Voice-AI-Auto-Translated-Greeting-Message)
- [Best Practices for Using Auto-Translated Greetings](#Best-Practices-for-Using-Auto-Translated-Greetings)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Voice AI Auto-Translated Greeting Message?**

When you update your Voice AI Agent’s language, HighLevel can automatically translate the initial greeting message into the selected language. This helps ensure the first thing your caller hears matches the language configured for the agent, creating a smoother and more personalized experience from the start. The greeting remains part of the agent setup flow, so users can review and adjust it before saving if needed.

---

## **Key Benefits of Voice AI Auto-Translated Greeting Message**

Automatically translating the greeting helps reduce setup friction and improves consistency across multilingual Voice AI experiences. It is especially useful for businesses serving customers in different regions or languages, where the first message can shape the overall caller experience.

- **Faster setup**: Reduces the need to manually rewrite the initial greeting every time you change the agent language.
- **Better caller experience**: Helps customers hear a greeting in the language selected for the Voice AI Agent.
- **More consistent localization**: Keeps the first interaction aligned with your multilingual Voice AI settings.
- **Less room for error**: Minimizes the chance of forgetting to update the greeting after switching languages.
- **Flexible customization**: Lets you review and refine the translated greeting to better match your brand tone.

---

## **How the Auto-Translated Greeting Works**

The auto-translated greeting works as part of the Voice AI Agent language configuration. When the language is changed, the initial greeting updates automatically so the opening message better reflects the selected language. This helps maintain consistency between the agent’s language setting and what callers hear first.

- The feature applies when creating or editing a Voice AI Agent.
- The translation is triggered when the agent language is changed.
- The updated greeting appears in the Initial Greeting Message field.
- You can review the translated message before saving the agent.

[Screenshot: Voice AI Agent settings page showing the Language dropdown and the Initial Greeting Message field before the language change.]

---

## **Where to Find the Initial Greeting Message**

The Initial Greeting Message is part of the Voice AI Agent setup experience in HighLevel. Knowing where this field lives makes it easier to confirm that the translated greeting matches your intended caller experience and brand voice before the agent goes live.

- Navigate to your Voice AI Agent in HighLevel.
- Open the agent you want to create or edit.
- Go to the agent details or setup area where the greeting message is configured.
- Locate the **Initial Greeting Message** field.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067007760/original/6T8_12Ds-NriaOdbOcvH_36Vvf1p43Qdlg.png?1773658115)

---

## **How To Setup Voice AI Auto-Translated Greeting Message**

Proper setup helps make sure your Voice AI Agent greets callers in the correct language from the very first interaction. Reviewing the translated greeting before saving is important because it gives you a chance to confirm tone, clarity, and brand alignment.

1. Go to **AI Employee** > **Voice AI** in your HighLevel account.
2. Create a new Voice AI Agent or open an existing one for editing.
3. Find the **Language** setting for the agent.
4. Select the language you want the agent to use.
5. Review the **Initial Greeting Message** field.
6. Confirm that the greeting has been automatically translated into the selected language.
7. Edit the translated greeting if you want to personalize the wording or match your brand tone more closely.
8. Save the agent.
9. Run a test call using Phone Call or Web Call to verify that the greeting sounds correct for callers.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067007991/original/RkAsbc2639dTsJJDgAJmS_SxUMl2xwSvHQ.png?1773658239)![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067008113/original/OxbnA5YJsljWN3pD74IbCvU6hYFWjav31A.png?1773658336)![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067008370/original/q9_vUpJJ_wshi9LvOuTj6V6BOnmXWbZiyQ.png?1773658432)

---

## **Best Practices for Using Auto-Translated Greetings**

A translated greeting is most effective when it sounds natural, clear, and appropriate for your audience. Taking a moment to review the greeting after translation can help you maintain professionalism and improve the overall caller experience. This is especially important for businesses with a specific brand voice or region-specific phrasing.

- Review the translated greeting before publishing the agent.
- Adjust the greeting to reflect your business name, tone, and preferred phrasing.
- Test the greeting with a real or web-based call before going live.
- Make sure the selected voice matches the chosen language and audience.
- Recheck the greeting any time you switch the agent language again.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What happens when I change the language of my Voice AI Agent?**  
The initial greeting message is automatically translated to match the newly selected language.

**Q: Do I still need to manually translate the greeting?**  
In most cases, no. HighLevel automatically translates the initial greeting when you change the agent language, but you can still review and edit it before saving.

**Q: Can I customize the translated greeting?**  
Yes. The greeting remains editable, so you can adjust wording, tone, or branding as needed.

**Q: Is this feature available when editing an existing agent?**  
Yes. The feature is live for users creating or editing their Voice AI Agents.

**Q: Should I test the translated greeting before going live?**  
Yes. Testing helps confirm pronunciation, clarity, and the overall caller experience in the selected language.

**Q: Does this feature translate call transcripts and summaries too?**  
No. This feature is for the agent’s initial greeting during setup. Transcript and summary translation is a separate Voice AI feature.

**Q: Does the selected voice matter when using translated greetings?**  
Yes. Choosing a voice that fits the selected language can help create a more natural and localized caller experience.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Voice AI: Multi-Language Support](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004683)
- [How to Create Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004107)
- [Testing Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004108)
- [AI Voice Agents Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003911)
- [How to Edit a Voice AI Agent’s Voice](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005874)
- [Voice AI: Translation Service for Call Transcript & Summary](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005797)

title_en: How to Edit Your Brand Board Design Kit in HighLevel
source_md:
Keep your branding consistent by managing your logos, colors, fonts, and typography styles in one place. HighLevel Brand Boards let you organize these elements in a Design Kit, making it easier to maintain your brand's visual identity. You can also customize predefined Typography Styles to establish consistent formatting for titles, headings, body text, and more. This guide explains how to edit your Design Kit, customize typography settings, and save your changes.

---

# **What is a Design Kit?**

A Design Kit is a collection of branding elements stored within a Brand Board in HighLevel. It includes your logos, brand colors, fonts, and predefined typography styles, helping you manage your brand's appearance from one location.

Your saved brand colors and fonts are available in supported HighLevel builders, making it easier to create content that follows your brand guidelines.

The Typography Styles feature also allows you to define specific formatting for different types of text, including font, weight, size, and line height.

```
Note: Updating your Design Kit does not automatically change the appearance of existing pages or emails. Predefined Typography Styles can be configured in Brand Boards, but direct selection of these styles in builders is planned for a future update.
```

## 

## 

## **Understanding Typography Styles**

Typography Styles help you establish a consistent text hierarchy by defining how different types of text should appear. Each predefined style has its own font, weight, size, and line-height settings, allowing you to customize your brand's typography to match your design preferences.

Your Design Kit includes eight predefined Typography Styles:

| Typography Style | Intended Use |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | Main titles and prominent text |
| **Subtitle** | Supporting text beneath titles |
| **Heading 1** | Primary headings |
| **Heading 2** | Secondary headings |
| **Section header** | Headings that introduce content sections |
| **Quote** | Quotations or highlighted statements |
| **Body** | Paragraphs and general text |
| **Caption** | Short descriptions and supporting information |

Each style is pre-filled with default settings that you can customize independently.

The available formatting options include:

- **Font:** Choose the font family used for the style.
- **Weight:** Control how bold or light the text appears.
- **Size:** Adjust the size of the text.
- **Line Height:** Set the spacing between lines of text.

```
Note: These predefined styles help establish your brand's typography settings within the Design Kit. Configuring a style does not automatically apply it to existing content.
```

---

## **How to Edit Your Design Kit**

### Step 1: Open Your Brand Board

1. From your HighLevel sub-account, navigate to **Marketing > Brand Boards**.
2. Locate the Brand Board you want to update.

### Step 2: Update Your Logos

The **Logos** tab allows you to replace existing brand images so your Design Kit contains your current logos.

1. In the Design Kit, select the **Logos** tab.
2. Locate the logo you want to update.
3. Click the **Edit** (pencil) icon next to **Logo 1** or **Logo 2**.
4. Select or upload the replacement logo.

```
Note: Replacing a logo in your Design Kit does not delete the original file from your Media Library. To permanently remove an old logo file, delete it directly from the Media Library.
```

### 

### Step 3: Manage Your Brand Colors

The **Colors** tab lets you maintain your saved brand color palette. You can add, replace, rename, or remove colors to keep your Design Kit aligned with your current branding.

1. Select the **Colors** tab in the Design Kit.
2. Choose the action you want to perform:

   - **Add a color:** Click **+ Add** to create another brand color.
   - **Change a color:** Click the color square beside an existing color and select a replacement.
   - **Rename a color:** Click the color name field and enter a new name.
   - **Remove a color:** Click the trash icon beside the color you want to delete.

```
Note: Updating standard Brand Board colors does not automatically change colors already applied to existing pages or emails. Global Custom Colors have separate synchronization behavior.
```

### Step 4: Add or Change Your Fonts

The **Typography** tab allows you to manage the font families associated with your Brand Board. Keeping your preferred fonts saved makes them easier to access when creating content in supported builders.

1. Select the **Typography** tab in the Design Kit.
2. Manage your fonts using the available options:

   - **Add a font:** Click **+ Add** and select a font.
   - **Change a font:** Use the font dropdown to select a different font.
   - **Remove a font:** Click the trash icon next to the font you want to delete.

You can store up to **five fonts** in your Design Kit, and at least one font must remain.

### Step 5: Customize Typography Styles

The **Styles** area within the Typography tab lets you customize the appearance of different text types. Each style can be edited independently, allowing you to create a consistent hierarchy without applying the same formatting to every type of text.

1. In the **Typography** tab, locate the **Styles** area.
2. Review the eight predefined Typography Styles.
3. Find the style you want to customize.
4. Click the **Edit** icon next to that style.

   [Screenshot: Typography Styles area highlighting the Edit icon next to a predefined style.]
5. Adjust the available formatting settings:

   - **Font:** Select your preferred font.
   - **Weight:** Choose the font weight.
   - **Size:** Set the text size.
   - **Line Height:** Adjust the spacing between lines.
   - [Screenshot: Typography Style editing controls showing the Font, Weight, Size, and Line Height settings.]
6. Repeat these steps for any additional styles you want to customize.

```
Important: Predefined Typography Styles can be configured in Brand Boards. Support for selecting and applying these styles directly in builders is planned for a future update.
```

### 

### Step 6: Save Your Changes

Saving your Brand Board preserves the changes you make to its logos, colors, fonts, and typography styles.

1. Review your updated Design Kit settings.
2. Click **Save Board** in the upper-right corner.

Your updated branding settings are now saved in your Brand Board.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do changes to my Design Kit automatically update existing pages or emails?**

No. Updating your Design Kit does not automatically change existing pages or emails. You can use the updated brand assets when making future edits in supported builders.

**Q: Can I customize each Typography Style separately?**

Yes. Each of the eight predefined styles has its own font, weight, size, and line-height settings, allowing you to customize different text types independently.

**Q: Can I apply my predefined Typography Styles directly in the Email, Funnel, or Website Builder?**

Direct support for selecting the eight predefined Typography Styles in builders is planned for a future update. Saved Brand Board fonts and colors are available in supported builders, but this is separate from applying predefined Typography Styles.

**Q: Why aren't my Brand Board colors appearing in a supported builder?**

Only the default Brand Board populates the relevant brand color pickers. Make sure the correct Brand Board is set as default and that your changes have been saved. For instructions, see [How to Change Default Brand Boards in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003138-how-to-change-default-brand-boards-in-highlevel).

**Q: Can I use more than five fonts in my Design Kit?**

No. A Design Kit supports up to five saved fonts, and at least one font is required.

**Q: Will replacing a logo in my Design Kit remove the original image from the Media Library?**

No. Replacing a logo in your Design Kit does not remove the original file from the Media Library. You must delete the file separately if you no longer need it.

**Q: Will updating my Brand Board affect my Payment Links?**

If your Payment Links use Brand Board theming, updates to the applicable brand colors can be reflected in those links.

title_en: How to Customize Your Prospect Report Layout
source_md:
Personalize your Prospect Reports in HighLevel by choosing which sections to display and controlling the order they appear. This allows you to tailor Marketing Audit Reports to match your sales strategy, highlight priority insights, and remove unnecessary data. You can set a global default layout for all reports or customize a single report without affecting others.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Prospect Report Layout Customization?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Prospect-Report-Layout-Customization?)
- [Key Benefits of Prospect Report Layout Customization](#Key-Benefits-of-Prospect-Report-Layout-Customization)
- [Global Report Layout (Default for All Reports)](#Global-Report-Layout-(Default-for-All-Reports))
- [Access the Global Report Layout Settings](#Access-the-Global-Report-Layout-Settings)
- [Adjust Section Visibility](#Adjust-Section-Visibility)
- [Reorder Sections](#Reorder-Sections)
- [Save Your Global Layout](#Save-Your-Global-Layout)
- [Customize a Specific Report Only](#Customize-a-Specific-Report-Only)
- [Access Section Controls Inside a Report](#Access-Section-Controls-Inside-a-Report)
- [How To Set Up Prospect Report Layout Customization](#How-To-Set-Up-Prospect-Report-Layout-Customization)
- [To Configure a Global Default Layout](#To-Configure-a-Global-Default-Layout)
- [To Customize an Individual Report](#To-Customize-an-Individual-Report)
- [Verify Changes](#Verify-Changes)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Prospect Report Layout Customization?**

Prospect Report Layout Customization allows you to control the structure of your Marketing Audit Reports generated through the Prospecting tool in HighLevel. You can enable or disable report sections and reorder them to better support your presentation flow. This ensures your reports align with your agency’s sales process and client focus areas while maintaining flexibility for one-off adjustments.

---

## **Key Benefits of Prospect Report Layout Customization**

Customizing your report layout ensures your Prospect Reports present insights in a way that strengthens your pitch and aligns with client priorities.

- **Control the Narrative:** Arrange sections in a logical order that supports your sales conversation.
- **Highlight What Matters Most:** Move key insights like Overall Score or SEO Analysis to the top.
- **Remove Unnecessary Sections:** Hide sections such as Techno Stack if they’re not relevant to your prospect.
- **Set a Global Default:** Create a standardized layout for consistency across all future reports.
- **Customize Individual Reports:** Make one-off adjustments without impacting your default structure.
- **Consistent PDF Output:** Section visibility and order apply to both the web report and exported PDF.

---

## **Global Report Layout (Default for All Reports)**

Global layout settings define the default structure used in Prospect Reports moving forward. This is ideal for agencies that want consistency across all sales presentations.

### **Access the Global Report Layout Settings**

Properly configuring your global layout ensures every new report follows your preferred structure automatically.

1. Go to **Marketing**
2. Select **Prospecting**
3. Click **Prospect Accounts**
4. Open the **Settings** tab
5. Select **Report Settings**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066407975/original/GFKSq3tMM8PsV2ie5q-yhUs8rhk3fa_N0A.png?1772837485)**

This screen displays the **Customize Report Layout** panel, where you can control section visibility and order.

### **Adjust Section Visibility**

Controlling section visibility allows you to remove content that doesn’t align with your sales focus.

- By default, all sections are enabled.
- Uncheck any sections you do not want included in your reports.
- You can re-enable sections at any time.

Example: Hide **Techno Stack** if your agency focuses strictly on SEO and reputation services.

### **Reorder Sections**

Reordering sections allows you to guide prospects through insights in a strategic order.

- Use the drag-and-drop handles beside each section.
- Arrange sections in the sequence you want them displayed.

Example: Move **Overall Score** to the top to immediately show impact metrics.

### **Save Your Global Layout**

Saving ensures your structure becomes the default for reports using the standard layout.

1. Click **Save**
2. The updated structure becomes your default layout for future reports

> **Important:**

- > **Save = Global Default Layout**
- > Previously customized reports will not automatically update.

You can return to these settings anytime to update, reorder, include, or exclude sections.

---

## **Customize a Specific Report Only**

When you need a different structure for a single prospect, you can adjust that report without changing your global settings.

### **Access Section Controls Inside a Report**

Per-report customization allows flexibility for unique sales situations while preserving your standard template.

1. Open the desired **Marketing Audit Report**
2. Click **Sections** in the top-right corner

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066407982/original/opzFhjGd_zYjgQGss0bxplmTwWWVuCzDPA.jpeg?1772837513)**

The Sections panel allows you to:

- Check or uncheck sections to control visibility
- Drag sections to reorder them
- Click **Apply** to confirm changes

> **Apply = Changes affect this report only**

Your global layout remains unchanged.

---

## **How To Set Up Prospect Report Layout Customization**

Setting up your layout correctly ensures your reports consistently reflect your agency’s positioning and priorities.

### **To Configure a Global Default Layout**

1. Navigate to **Marketing → Prospecting → Prospect Accounts**
2. Click **Settings**
3. Select **Report Settings**
4. Enable or disable sections as needed
5. Drag sections into your preferred order
6. Click **Save**

### **To Customize an Individual Report**

1. Open the specific **Marketing Audit Report**
2. Click **Sections**
3. Reorder or hide sections
4. Click **Apply**

### **Verify Changes**

- Click Refresh inside the report if changes are not immediately visible.
- Confirm the report generation timestamp.
- Export the report using Export PDF to confirm structure consistency.
- Refresh existing reports after major audit improvements to load the latest scoring, detection, and analysis updates.

```
Note:  

Some report improvements are applied through backend processing. Existing reports may need a manual refresh before updated results appear.
```

  

Section order and visibility apply to:

- The web-based report view
- Shared report links
- Exported PDF versions

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do global layout changes affect all reports?**

Global changes become the default layout for reports moving forward that use the standard structure.

**Q: Can I hide a section for just one report?**

Yes. Use the **Sections** panel inside that specific report and click **Apply**.

**Q: Will previously customized reports update if I change the global layout?**

No. Reports that were individually customized retain their own layout settings.

**Q: Does the section order affect the exported PDF?**

Yes. The section order and visibility apply to both the web report and the exported PDF.

**Q: What happens if I remove a section by mistake?**

Return to either the global layout settings or the report’s Sections panel and re-enable the section.

**Q: Why aren’t my layout changes appearing?**

Confirm you clicked **Save** (global) or **Apply** (individual report), then click **Refresh**. If the issue continues, clear your browser cache.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Customize Your Prospect Report Layout](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005053)
- [Prospecting Tool - Customize and Reorder Your Report Sections](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004127)
- [Prospecting Tool - Fully Customizable Prospect Report Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005558)

title_en: WhatsApp Media Templates
source_md:
# WhatsApp Media Templates

WhatsApp's media templates support enables you to send Images, Videos, Documents, and Location content. This guide shows how to leverage this feature to enhance communication and improve marketing efforts.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/NlWYiphUv\_8?&wmode=opaque)

Table of Contents

[What are WhatsApp Media Templates?](#what-is) [WhatsApp Media Template Use Cases](#usecases) [How to Create a WhatsApp Media Template](#create) [How to Create a Location WhatsApp Template](#location) [Send Media Templates from Bulk Action](#bulk) [Send Media Templates from Workflows](#workflows) [Send Media Templates from the Conversation Page](#conversation) [Media Limits](#limits) [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)

---

What are WhatsApp Media Templates?

WhatsApp Media templates allow users to send rich media content, such as Images, Videos, Documents, and Location data, to their contacts or customers. This feature expands the possibilities of communication on WhatsApp, enabling businesses to create more engaging and visually appealing messages.

---

WhatsApp Media Template Use Cases

Elevate your WhatsApp marketing campaigns to the next level with media templates:

►**Product Launches:** Showcase new products with images and attention-grabbing videos.

►**Promotions and Offers:** Share discount codes or special offers accompanied by eye-catching visuals.

►**Event Announcements:** Promote events with location sharing and engaging imagery.

►**Customer Service:** Provide helpful tutorials or guides in document format.

---

How to Create a WhatsApp Media Template

Go to Settings > WhatsApp > Templates > Create Template

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025237169/original/CijuA5Ux_0BnU1Nrj5gh-e62i_X1ZHxUjQ.png?1714394949)

Add template name, category and language > Show header and click on the Media > Upload Media

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025237423/original/Fc1WILQS2I7KVbmPiTuv03mgH9DQJbyGVw.png?1714395054)

Press Create > Template will be sent for approval to Meta

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025237581/original/viICB0j-AIQVIaVcuZCaqp3xS6lvkTFTKw.png?1714395178)

```
Check out the guide on WhatsApp template statuses and best practices.
```

---

How to Create a Location WhatsApp Template

Go to Settings > WhatsApp > Templates > Create Template

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025237169/original/CijuA5Ux_0BnU1Nrj5gh-e62i_X1ZHxUjQ.png?1714394949)

Select Location > Add the Location Latitude and Longitude > Add Location Name and Address

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025357835/original/fJ9DeOFC5SpbdLUGLojy753XxdclmLmxVQ.png?1714564066)

```
Get the latitude and longitude from Google Maps by right-clicking on the place or area on the map. Refer to the detailed article here.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025357928/original/r3hyUUixnEHIswO2PmoOQPysqCEaYNP6kw.png?1714564202)

---

Send WhatsApp Media Templates from Bulk Action

Go to Contacts > Select the smart list for which you want to send a bulk WhatsApp message

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025237996/original/POcC4G2Axs2WSgFglEyfEQcRCcpA9tJgqg.png?1714395526)

Select all Contacts > Click on WhatsApp icon > Select template > Add action name

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025285340/original/hRh15nKutjoHCwCrlo6ESGUqZM6yiJcXWw.png?1714468175)

Select Show Stats > Click on Processed > View Bulk Action Statistics

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025287528/original/PxY-nT91cfGzaHO9pr7wjev7-2CTe8LMjw.png?1714469588)

---

Send WhatsApp Media Templates from Workflows

Go to Automations > Create Workflow > Start from Scratch > Select Trigger

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025287890/original/1N3LfnTtW9sp1FTUm852Lv5E92gZ56T6cg.png?1714469742)

Select WhatsApp action

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025287985/original/eKc8ZUh4cKVc1mxFxvJmJaLTsfOos38OLw.png?1714469804)

Select WhatsApp Template > Save Action > Save workflow

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025288160/original/iHjxbz4XLwtkXhUd6NEvaQFmwm4_gFPpXw.png?1714469956)

```
The media URL will be shown in the preview under the workflow. When the WhatsApp message is sent, the actual media will be rendered.
```

---

Send WhatsApp Media Templates from the Conversation Page

Go to Conversations > Select the contact you wish to send a WhatsApp media template to

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025291772/original/L5sNW5bjZSCOjKLOaMg1WRL4jNuhFtCdAQ.png?1714472231)

Click "Please use a template to initiate a chat" > Select media template you wish to send > Click Send

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025292153/original/e51fQOCm-J97ged4u_5muGGePMSDHnhM9w.png?1714472510)

```
You can change the media by changing the media URL. The URL should be a public link and should contain the same type of media — for example, if it is an Image template, it will only accept PNG and JPEG files.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025292306/original/cSdHIsHbjHZkZGwxVyh6ImrR9zgj-YXTcg.png?1714472643)

```
Users will get the error below when using media which is not approved — for example, if a user tries to add a video file in an Image template, this error will be shown.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155025293392/original/d_WPOiZY-Ok_HVnUumuE-ArnXkMHY3S7Ow.png?1714473368)

---

Media Limits

Document

`application/pdf`

100MB

Image

`image/jpeg`, `image/png`  
Images must be 8-bit, RGB or RGBA

5MB

Video

`video/mp4`

16MB

```
If a user tries to upload a media file which exceeds the size limit, an error will be shown.
```

---

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What are the media limits for WhatsApp Media Templates?

Supported types and size limits:

- **Document:** application/pdf, 100MB
- **Image:** image/jpeg, image/png (must be 8-bit, RGB, or RGBA), 5MB
- **Video:** video/mp4, 16MB

Users will receive an error if they try to upload a media file exceeding the size limit. For example, if a user attempts to add a video file in an Image template, they will receive an error message.

Q: What are WhatsApp Media Templates?

They are pre-approved message formats that allow you to include images, videos, documents, or location information within WhatsApp messages. They help streamline communication with customers, especially for marketing, support, or authentication purposes.

Q: What happens if I try to use media that doesn't fit the guidelines?

You'll likely encounter an error message, and your template may not be sent. Ensure your media adheres to [WhatsApp's Template Guidelines](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/message-templates/guidelines/).

Q: Do I need approval before using WhatsApp message templates?

Yes, all templates must go through an approval process with WhatsApp (Meta) to ensure they meet specific guidelines.

Q: What factors can lead to a template being rejected?

Common reasons for rejection include:

- Missing or incorrect variable formatting
- Content violating [WhatsApp's Business or Commerce policies](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/overview/policy-enforcement/violations/)
- Sensitive information requests (e.g., full payment card numbers)
- Abusive or threatening language
- Duplicating an existing template

Q: What does it mean if my template is 'Paused'?

A paused template means it received negative customer feedback or low engagement. You cannot send a paused template until its status changes back to 'Active'.

title_en: Interactive Live Data Preview in Ecommerce Store Builder
source_md:
Live Preview in Ecommerce Store Builder lets you test your Store with real product data before publishing. You can browse products, select variants, use Add to Cart, update quantities, and move through supported Store pages directly inside the builder.

Turn Live Preview off whenever you want to return to dummy product data. This guide explains how Live Preview works, what you can test, and how preview behavior changes across Store pages.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is Live Preview in Ecommerce Store Builder?](#what-is-live-preview)
- [Key Benefits of Live Preview](#key-benefits)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#prerequisites)
- [How to Use Live Preview](#use-live-preview)
- [Preview Products and Store Interactions](#preview-products)
- [Interact with Sections in the Builder](#interact-sections)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **What Is Live Preview in Ecommerce Store Builder?**

Live Preview lets you use real product data while designing and reviewing your Ecommerce Store inside the Store Builder.

When enabled, supported Store pages and product elements display real products instead of dummy preview data.  
  
 You can then test supported product, navigation, and cart interactions without leaving the builder.

Turn **Live Preview** off whenever you want to return to dummy product data.

---

## **Key Benefits of Live Preview**

Live Preview gives you a more realistic way to review the Store experience before publishing.

- **Real product data:** Preview your Store with products from your account.
- **Interactive product testing:** Navigate products, select variants, and test supported Add to Cart actions.
- **Cart testing:** Add products, update quantities, and remove items.
- **Cross-page preview:** Carry preview-cart products through Cart, Checkout, and Thank You.
- **Flexible previewing:** Switch between real and dummy product data while designing.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

Live Preview behavior depends on whether products are available in the account and which Store page you are editing.

- If the account has products, **Live Preview is ON by default**.
- If the account has no products, **Live Preview is OFF by default** and dummy products appear.
- Custom Product Details Pages do not include the Live Preview toggle and continue using dummy preview data.
- Checkout inside Live Preview is a preview experience only.
- Real-time shipping rates, taxes, multiple payment methods, and functional checkout fields are not supported in the current Checkout preview.

```
Note: Checkout limitations described in this article apply only to the Store Builder Live Preview experience. They do not describe the behavior of the published Ecommerce Store checkout.
```

---

## **How to Use Live Preview**

Use the Live Preview toggle to switch between real and dummy product data while reviewing your Store.

1. From the **Sub-Account View**, go to **Sites**.
2. Select **Stores**.
3. Open the Ecommerce Store you want to edit.
4. Open the Store page you want to review.
5. Locate the **Live Preview** toggle in the Store Builder.
6. Turn **Live Preview ON** to use available real product data.
7. Test supported products, variants, navigation, and cart actions.
8. Turn **Live Preview OFF** to return to dummy product data.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082985564/original/CXtm9Ndm_cUk0moAQn6I0kZ83yL9kMwx6w.png?1791570536)

---

## **Preview Products and Store Interactions**

Live Preview lets you test supported interactions across the Store flow instead of reviewing each page with static product data.

### **Product List Page and Product Details Page**

Use the Product List Page and Product Details Page to review how real products behave inside the builder.

With Live Preview enabled, you can:

- Navigate from the Product List Page (PLP) to a product.
- Review real product data on the Product Details Page (PDP).
- Select available product variants.
- Use supported Add to Cart actions.
- Navigate through supported Store pages.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082986800/original/iJauy84vygJsKroIGEjfhonTI153O4O0gg.gif?1791572057)

If you open the default PDP directly in the builder, HighLevel displays one random real product from the account.

```
Note: Custom Product Details Pages continue using dummy preview behavior and do not include the Live Preview toggle.
```

### **Product Widgets**

Product widgets continue using their configured actions while you preview the Store.

Supported widgets include:

- **Featured Product**
- **Featured Products**
- **Upsell**

Whether a widget displays dummy or real product data depends on the Live Preview state and its configured product assignment.

### **Cart, Checkout, and Thank You**

The preview cart carries supported product data through the Store flow so you can review multiple pages with realistic content.

With Live Preview enabled, you can:

- Add products to the cart.
- Update quantities.
- Remove items.
- Review products on the Cart page.
- Carry preview-cart contents into Checkout and Thank You.

If the preview cart is empty, Checkout and Thank You still display one or two products from the account so you can review the page design.

Checkout remains preview-only inside the builder. Real-time shipping rates, taxes, multiple payment methods, and functional checkout fields are not included in the current Live Preview experience.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082986935/original/QDwXige9QhkzUCT4rXkNiWYI6whcPhbTgw.gif?1791572232)

---

## **Interact with Sections in the Builder**

The Store Builder separates selecting a section for editing from interacting with actionable elements inside that section.

The first click on a section selects it for editing.

After the section is selected, supported actionable elements can perform their expected preview behavior, including:

- Product navigation
- Redirection
- Add to Cart

This lets you edit the Store while also testing supported customer interactions directly inside the builder.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082987137/original/ViwUOH86WmWJip2AMNsWH5VLz6Nnj8Rxqw.gif?1791572353)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What happens when I enable Live Preview?**

Supported Store pages and product elements use available real product data instead of dummy preview data.

**Q: Is Live Preview enabled automatically?**

Yes, when the account has products. If no products exist, Live Preview is off by default and dummy products appear.

**Q: Can I switch back to dummy product data?**

Yes. Turn **Live Preview** off at any time.

**Q: Does Live Preview work with Custom Product Details Pages?**

No. Custom PDPs continue using dummy preview behavior and do not include the Live Preview toggle.

**Q: What happens when I open the default Product Details Page directly?**

With Live Preview enabled, the builder displays one random real product from the account.

**Q: What happens when the preview cart is empty?**

Checkout and Thank You can still display one or two products from the account so you can review their page designs.

**Q: Can I complete a real checkout inside Live Preview?**

No. Checkout inside Live Preview is for reviewing the Store experience. Functional checkout fields, real-time shipping rates, taxes, and multiple payment methods are not supported in the current Live Preview experience.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Set Up an E-Commerce Online Store (Websites)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001157)
- [Custom Product Details Page for E-commerce Stores](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006238)
- [Ecommerce Store - Customizing Checkout Pages](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004467)
- [Share & Preview Product Pages Directly from Stores](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008690)

---

title_en: How to Use Opportunity Notes?
source_md:
**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are opportunity notes?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-are-opportunity-notes?)
- [Key Benefits of Opportunity Notes](#Key-Benefits-of-Opportunity-Notes)
- [How do opportunity notes work?](#How-do-opportunity-notes-work?%C2%A0)
- [How to use opportunity notes?](#How-to-use-opportunity-notes?)
- [Best Practices](#Best-Practices%C2%A0)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

## **What are opportunity notes?**

We’ve launched Opportunity Notes that lets you link notes to both Opportunities and Contacts independently. This gives you more flexibility in how you manage and view your notes in both opportunities and contacts.

   
Each opportunity can have their own dedicated notes, separate from contact notes, while still maintaining the flexibility to associate notes with multiple entities when needed.

```
Note: To enable this feature, go to Subaccount > Settings > Labs and toggle "Opportunity Notes" on.
```

---

## **Key Benefits of Opportunity Notes**

The Opportunity Notes feature enables you to:

- Entity-Specific Notes: Create dedicated notes for opportunities without mixing them with contact notes either from the contacts tab or from the opportunities tab directly. (see example)
- Flexible Associations: Choose to either associate notes with Contacts, Opportunities, or both.
- Cleaner Organization: Maintain distinct notes for Contacts and Opportunities, reducing clutter and improving clarity.
- Smart Filtering: Quickly filter and find notes based on their entity associations.
- Powerful Search: Instantly find notes using improved search functionality.

## **How do opportunity notes work?**

***Example scenario:***   
John Doe (a contact) has two opportunities for 2 different real estate properties- Property A and Property B. Sara (the Sales Agent & GHL Admin) managing the properties for John Doe wants to create specific notes for each opportunity to keep relevant information tied to each property’s opportunity only.

Here’s how Sara will create opportunity & contact-specific notes.

Step #1: Under Property A’s Opportunity, Sara navigates to the Notes section, clicks Add Note, and enters the note’s contents.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627261/original/kwy2UiLV7N-uILJBzwVlJAz4FS4Q0rnqvw.png?1745524788)

Step #2: She selects the associations for the note; in this case, she chooses both the Opportunity (Property A) and the Contact (John Doe).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045647246/original/xdAovQUWcyu1PBp0DejOCt6Jp68gFCGJsQ.png?1745569459)

Step #3: She adds another note but selects only the opportunity under associations (omitting the contact John Doe), then clicks Save to create an opportunity-only note.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627266/original/VGNeUWF6_trrPym_pNs24iRfTESoO_Sh4A.png?1745524789)

After Step #3: Sara now has two notes:

- One linked only to Property A (opportunity-specific note).
- One linked to both John Doe and Property A (shared note between opportunity and contact.)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627523/original/MSUyi0PkUaM6ny-6x6xUxNWhrz-wF3IYMg.png?1745525361)

Viewing Property B: When Sara switches to Property B’s Opportunity, she sees only the shared note (the one linked to John Doe), because the Property A–specific note isn’t associated with Property B.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627260/original/ObSJPVXX6s8Fr9to5iASYohEgeidE7hjdg.png?1745524788)  
  
Adding a Note for Property B: She clicks Create New Note, enters the note, selects both contact associations and then hits save.

 ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627265/original/rcbvigQAEJGo99-8W43GmIV304D4YQeajQ.png?1745524789)

Filtering in Contacts: In the Contacts tab, selecting John Doe and going to Notes, Sara can filter notes by Opportunities or Contacts to view exactly what she needs.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627262/original/gFHid4Gk7T8DArL19M9W8KLLx0fcMrc8LA.png?1745524789)    ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627267/original/HzD70z868F_a_nQYfoxPKdS-FGot9xqUtw.png?1745524790)

Key Takeaways:

1. Opportunity notes let you maintain notes specific to each deal without mixing contexts.
2. Notes shared with a contact appear across opportunities; opportunity-only notes remain in their respective opportunities.

## **How to use opportunity notes?**

1. Create Notes and Select Associations

a) Adding Notes Via Opportunities

Navigate to the Opportunities section, select the specific opportunity and click on add note.   
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045647422/original/4lWljMRq9emO8ebjRFfWWoKhAwnu312Cbw.png?1745569563)

Enter your note description clearly in the provided text box:  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627296/original/5HP1rcAbNlj4q3ml2KyxdB03-T4uA6ik-Q.png?1745524863)

Under Associated Objects, click on **Associate To** and choose whether the note should be associated with:

- Opportunities
- Both Opportunities and Contacts
- Contact

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045647521/original/6BxOICn-Cp91zbh9_WGiLGeFARID1eeznA.png?1745569610)

Use the search and add functionality to precisely link entities and then click on save.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627317/original/6Ls8K5JqPbx6UE_LFK0rw6Sk_PISfdRyiA.png?1745524884)

b) Adding Notes Via Contacts

Navigate to Contacts, select a contact, then click Notes Button.        ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045647557/original/ODHrVGcIjV7dyroQhmvL2FPrqCY39KhDsQ.png?1745569647)

Select the Relevant associations you’d like to add with the specific opportunity.   
                    ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045627300/original/NOgGDN6tKKtumUWjqjq3qRAfV2_TUZI-1A.png?1745524864)

Easily search for the opportunities and select the relevant one.

2. Filtering Notes by Associations

- In the Notes tab in Opportunity and also in contacts, use filters to quickly find notes linked to specific opportunities or contacts.

Filter Tab in Opportunities.
