   - These filter helps you distinguish between different lead sources, allowing for customized follow-up strategies.
2. **Conversion Rate:**

   - Filter prospects by their conversion rate.
   - Create separate workflows for:
     - **High-Conversion Prospects:** Trigger personalised outreach or direct sales follow-up.
     - **Low-Conversion Prospects:** Set up nurturing campaigns to increase engagement.
   - This segmentation enables strategic engagement, maximising your sales potential.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049068387/original/VHH3ra6k19va_c7eZctZZ6gmyf_AuQN5mw.png?1751275982)

---

#### **Step 3: Mapping Prospect Details to Automated Actions**

After configuring the trigger and applying filters, the next step is to map prospect details to automated actions. This ensures you can leverage advanced workflow automation within the Prospecting Tool.

**Automated Actions Include:**

- **Assigning Prospects to Sales Pipelines:** Automatically organize prospects into relevant stages of your sales pipeline.
- **Sending Welcome Emails or SMS:** Initiate personalized communication with newly generated prospects.
- **Notifying Team Members:** Alert your sales team about high-conversion prospects in real-time.
- **Tagging and Categorising Prospects:** Automatically organize prospects by tags, categories, or niches for better segmentation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049068267/original/ciPMPvtaGZ1AR26cLqPGmfKMIk2PzWv-pQ.jpeg?1751275910)

---

#### **Step 4: Saving and Testing Your Workflow**

Once all configurations and mappings are completed:

- **Click Save:** Finalise your workflow.
- **Test the Workflow:** Simulate a new prospect generation (both in-app and via widgets) to verify if the automation is triggered as expected.
- **Adjust as Needed:** If the workflow isn't functioning as intended, fine-tune the conditions or actions.

---

## **Example**

**Scenario:** You want to send a personalised welcome email to every new prospect generated via an embedded widget and alert your sales team for high-conversion prospects.

1. **Trigger Configuration:**

   - Set the trigger as **"Prospect Generated"**.
   - Filter by **Source = Widget** and **Conversion Rate > 70%**.
2. **Automated Actions:**

   - **Send Welcome Email:** Personalised email is automatically sent to the new prospect.
   - **Notify Team:** Sales team is notified about the high-conversion lead for immediate follow-up.
3. **Outcome:**

   - New prospects from the widget receive an instant welcome email.
   - High-conversion prospects are flagged, ensuring prioritized engagement by your sales team.

---

### **Conclusion**

By setting up workflow triggers for new prospects generated through the Prospecting Tool, you can automate lead management, enhance sales targeting, and improve overall conversion rates. Using filters like prospect source and conversion rate, you can tailor workflows to engage prospects strategically, streamlining your sales funnel and optimizing team productivity.

For any questions or support, feel free to reach out to our team.

##

title_en: Configuring Calendar Widget Style (Classic & Neo)
source_md:
HighLevel provides two calendar widget styles—Classic and Neo—that determine how your booking calendar is displayed to clients. Choosing the right widget style ensures the best scheduling experience for your business and customers. This article explains the differences, benefits, and setup process for each style.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Calendar Widget Style?](#What-is-the-Calendar-Widget-Style?)
- [Key Benefits of Calendar Widget Styles](#Key-Benefits-of-Calendar-Widget-Styles)
- [Classic Widget](#Classic-Widget)
- [Neo Widget](#Neo-Widget)
- [How To Setup Calendar Widget Styles](#How-To-Setup-Calendar-Widget-Styles)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/hrcqjFkB-2I?&wmode=opaque)

---

# **What is the Calendar Widget Style?**

Calendar widget styles define how your booking calendar appears when shared with leads or clients. HighLevel offers the Classic widget and the Neo widget, each designed for different use cases and levels of customization.

---

## **Key Benefits of Calendar Widget Styles**

Understanding the benefits of each widget style helps you choose the right one for your scheduling needs.

- **Classic Style**: Simple, reliable layout designed for quick setup and basic appointment booking.

- **Neo Style**: Modern, customizable interface with advanced features like widget step reordering, color customization, staff selection, and class seat displays.

- **Flexibility**: Ability to switch between styles when creating or editing a calendar.

- **Default for Group Calendars**: The Neo widget is automatically applied for Group Calendars, offering a sleek group booking experience.

---

## **Classic Widget**

The Classic widget is designed for straightforward appointment booking with a simple layout. It’s best for businesses that don’t need advanced customization or modern design elements.

- Quick setup process

- Standard layout for single or unassigned calendars

- Ideal for businesses wanting minimal customization

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053389155/original/ITlrUJmXGd8onCHwAW3wpA-NXeTdjgBokQ.png?1757424303)

---

## **Neo Widget**

The Neo widget is the newer, modern style designed with customization and flexibility in mind. It’s the default style for Group Calendars and supports enhanced features.

- Customizable colors, backgrounds, and buttons

- Ability to reorder widget steps (Form, Date & Time, Payment)

- Staff selection option for Round Robin calendars

- Seat display for Class Booking calendars

- Streamlined and modern interface

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053389123/original/vrF3eAhQgwPB6xaHA0xekaPfZKlCeVBVPQ.png?1757424283)

---

## **How To Setup Calendar Widget Styles**

Choosing or changing your calendar widget style ensures that your booking page matches your preferred design and features.

```
Classic vs Neo: Things to Keep in Mind. 

It’s important to be aware of how Classic and Neo widgets differ so you can choose the right option for your calendar setup. 

Classic is the default for unassigned calendars, while Neo is the default for group calendars. Customization options such as colors, backgrounds, and button text are only available in Neo. 

Staff selection in Round Robin calendars also requires Neo, and the Class Booking seat display is only supported in Neo. 

Payment collection, however, is supported in both Classic and Neo. 

You can switch widget styles anytime without affecting existing bookings.
```

  

### **Open Settings**

Begin by navigating to the **Settings** menu from the left sidebar. This is where you can manage your account preferences, business details, and calendar configurations.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053389542/original/nWbGf1844DFD6LZ2BZ-cdxkMBKzdyR8LfQ.png?1757424497)

### **Access Calendars**

Inside the Settings menu, click on **Calendars** under the Business Services section. This will take you to the calendar management area where all your existing calendars are listed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053389596/original/R8zGPM6caJtwmbcZnsyILto3USKu-aQ3-A.png?1757424537)

### **Create or Edit Calendar**

In the Calendars section, you can either click **New Calendar** to create a fresh one or use the **edit icon** next to an existing calendar to update its settings. This is where you’ll set or adjust the widget style.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053389669/original/knlBJ5svshub779YYyQQtSglHMRj5T1NGA.png?1757424579)

### 

### **Select Widget Style**

Go to the **Customizations** tab in the calendar setup. Under **Calendar Widget Style**, choose between the Classic or Neo design. Neo is the default for group calendars, while Classic is the default for unassigned calendars.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053389793/original/hSuU6gasTFdtF6G1aLWDdm15ZkmzzrGb3A.png?1757424651)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I switch from Classic to Neo after creating a calendar?**  
Yes, you can edit an existing calendar at any time and change the widget style.

**Q: Do all customization options apply to both Classic and Neo widgets?**  
No, customization features such as colors, backgrounds, and reorder options are exclusive to the Neo widget.

**Q: Why is Neo the default for Group Calendars?**  
Neo supports advanced group booking features, staff selection, and a modern layout better suited for multiple team members.

**Q: Which widget should I use for class bookings with multiple seats?**  
The Neo widget is required to display available seats per slot.

**Q: Does switching widget styles affect existing bookings?**  
No, changing the widget style only changes the booking page appearance, not your existing appointments.

---

## **Related Articles**

- ### [Calendar Widget Customization](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000001529?portalId=48000045315)
- ### [Calendar Widget Reorder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000002684?portalId=48000045315)
- ### [Show Seats per Slot for Class Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000000956?portalId=48000045315)
- ### [Round Robin Calendar Staff Selection](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001239842)
- ### [Neo Group View Template](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000973-neo-group-view-template)

title_en: Manage Notification Settings in a Sub-Account
source_md:
Notification Settings let users control how and where they receive alerts for conversations, tasks, appointments, reviews, and other supported activity. Each user can customize their notification channels and preferences to stay informed without receiving unnecessary alerts.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Notification Settings?](#What-Are-Notification-Settings?)
- [Key Benefits](#Key-Benefits)
- [Manage Your Notification Settings](#Manage-Your-Notification-Settings)
- [Notification Behavior and Redirects](#Notification-Behavior-and-Redirects)
- [Add Users to a Sub-Account](#Add-Users-to-a-Sub-Account)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles%E2%80%8B)

---

## **What Are Notification Settings?**

Notification Settings determine which supported events notify you and which channels are used to deliver those alerts.

Depending on the notification type, available channels can include **In-App/Web**, **Desktop**, **Email**, **Mobile**, and **SMS**.

---

## **Key Benefits**

- **Control notification channels:** Choose how supported alerts are delivered.
- **Reduce notification noise:** Disable alerts that are not relevant to your work.
- **Stay on top of tasks:** Configure reminders and supported daily task summaries.
- **Open relevant records faster:** Supported notifications can redirect you directly to the related conversation, task, calendar, or record.

---

## **Manage Your Notification Settings**

### **Step 1:** Open Notifications

From the applicable Sub-Account, go to **Settings → My Profile → Notifications**.

In **My Profile**, select **Notifications** from the left-side menu.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082697437/original/oD-h8G9pNL4T5u3dSAu5ykX_4qJpd-24lA.png?1791350860)

### **Step 2:**Choose Your Notification Preferences

Review the available notification categories and select the channels you want to use for each supported notification type.

Preferences can include alerts for:

- Conversations and assigned messages
- Tasks and task reminders
- Daily due or overdue task summaries
- Appointments and calendar activity
- Reviews
- Other supported account activity

**Language:** Notification titles and content are delivered in the recipient's Platform Language when a translation is available. If no translation is available, the notification falls back to English (en\_US).  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082697094/original/RYSQsur6aJ0lDZUHNsyJ_-fZ7GeLX0aeMw.png?1791350434)

### **Step 3:**Save Your Preferences

After configuring your notification preferences, use the available save action to apply your changes.

**Note:** A user must have access to the applicable Sub-Account to receive its notifications. Users with **Only Assigned Data** enabled do not receive supported notifications for unassigned leads.

Admins can review changes to notification preferences from **Sub-Account → Settings → Audit Logs** by filtering the module to **Notification Preferences**.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082697486/original/-rmfqT9l5fdaBms_P4vJXdpDhvifxjjtaA.png?1791350923)

---

## **Notification Behavior and Redirects**

Supported In-App notifications can be clicked to open the related area of the Sub-Account.

- **Conversations:** Opens the relevant conversation or message.
- **Tasks:** Opens the applicable task area.
- **Calendars:** Opens the relevant calendar or appointment area.
- **Review notifications:** Supported review alerts can redirect to the relevant conversation or review-related record.

### **Follower Message Notifications**

**Notify for new messages on a conversation where I am a follower** is enabled by default for In-App notifications for existing and new users.

This notification applies to inbound messages. Additional channels such as Email or SMS can be configured when available.

### **Task and Appointment Reminders**

Supported notification preferences can include:

- Reminders before an assigned task is due
- Daily summaries of due tasks
- Daily summaries of overdue tasks
- Reminders before assigned appointments
- Alerts for new or assigned appointments

Scheduled notification summaries use the applicable time and timezone configuration.

---

## **Add Users to a Sub-Account**

Users must have access to a Sub-Account before they can receive and manage notifications for it.

1. From **Agency View**, go to **Settings → Users**.
2. Open the user you want to update.
3. Select **Roles & Permissions**.
4. Assign the Sub-Account or Sub-Accounts the user should be able to access.
5. If needed, restrict the user to only the selected Sub-Accounts.
6. Save the user's access settings.

After access is assigned, the user can go to **Sub-Account → Settings → My Profile → Notifications** to configure their personal notification preferences.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082697508/original/7kVdlsqkZ_fj9Ru9zcRTglJRtE_LxA-f0g.png?1791350950)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How does Mark all as read work?**

It changes the logged-in user's current unread notifications to read.

**Q: Why am I receiving duplicate notifications for the same message?**

Multiple notification conditions may apply to the same activity. For example, a message could trigger both an assigned-conversation notification and a new-message notification. Review your preferences and disable overlapping alerts if needed.

**Q: What does Clear All do?**

Clear All removes the current notifications from view. New notifications can still appear afterward, and cleared notifications cannot be restored.

**Q: Why am I not receiving notifications for some leads?**

Confirm that you have access to the applicable Sub-Account and review whether **Only Assigned Data** is enabled. Users with restricted assigned-data access do not receive supported notifications for unassigned leads.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Manage Sub-Account User Roles and Permissions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002544)
- [Audit Logs in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006667-audit-logs)
- [Calendar: Email, In-App, SMS & WhatsApp Appointment Notifications](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003441-calendar-email-in-app-appointment-notifications)
- [Diagnose Mobile App Notification Issues](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008971-diagnose-mobile-app-notification-issues)

title_en: How to Restore Deleted Blog Posts
source_md:
Deleted Blog Post Recovery in HighLevel helps protect blog content from accidental loss by moving deleted posts into a recoverable Deleted state. This article shows how to find deleted blog posts, restore them within 30 days, use bulk recovery actions, and permanently remove posts when needed.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Deleted Blog Post Recovery?](#What-is-Deleted-Blog-Post-Recovery?)
- [Key Benefits of Deleted Blog Post Recovery](#Key-Benefits-of-Deleted-Blog-Post-Recovery)
- [How To Restore Deleted Blog Posts](#How-To-Restore-Deleted-Blog-Posts)
  - [Restore a Deleted Blog Post](#Restore-a-Deleted-Blog-Post)
  - [Restore Multiple Deleted Blog Posts](#Restore-Multiple-Deleted-Blog-Posts)
  - [Permanently Delete Blog Posts](#Permanently-Delete-Blog-Posts)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Deleted Blog Post Recovery?**

Deleted Blog Post Recovery allows users to restore blog posts that were deleted from HighLevel Blogs. When a blog post is deleted, it moves into a recoverable Deleted state instead of disappearing permanently right away. Deleted blog posts remain recoverable for 30 days, giving users a self-serve way to bring content back without contacting support.

With this recovery flow, users can review deleted posts, restore them with their previous status intact, or permanently remove posts when they are no longer needed. Restored posts return to the main blog post list with their prior draft or published state.

---

## **Key Benefits of Deleted Blog Post Recovery**

- **Accidental deletion protection:** Deleted blog posts can be restored from the Deleted filter for up to 30 days.
- **Self-serve recovery:** Users can restore deleted posts directly from the Blog Dashboard without contacting support.
- **Cleaner blog management:** Deleted posts are separated from active posts so the main blog list stays organized.
- **Bulk recovery support:** Multiple deleted posts can be selected and restored at the same time.
- **Safer content cleanup:** Users can permanently delete posts only when they are sure the content is no longer needed.
- **Status preservation:** Restored posts return with their previous draft or published state intact.

---

## **How To Restore Deleted Blog Posts**

Restoring deleted blog posts from the Blog Dashboard helps recover content quickly and keeps publishing workflows moving without support intervention. Follow these steps to locate deleted posts, restore the content you need, or permanently remove posts that should no longer be available.

### **Restore a Deleted Blog Post**

1. Navigate to **Sites** > **Blogs**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/CaktdH4pYMYmXow5UDqG+/Screen+Shot+2026-05-14+at+21.07.29.png)
2. Open the blog that contains the deleted blog post.
3. Click the **Status** filter.
4. Select **Deleted**.
5. Locate the blog post you want to restore.
6. Open the action menu for the deleted post.
7. Select **Restore blog post**.
8. **Confirm** the restore action.
9. After restoration, the post returns to the main blog post list with its prior draft or published state.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/LN8xPxqUNxyPrZ2NyDOS+/GIF+Recording+2026-05-14+at+21.10.14.gif)

### **Restore Multiple Deleted Blog Posts**

1. Navigate to **Sites** > **Blogs**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/CaktdH4pYMYmXow5UDqG+/Screen+Shot+2026-05-14+at+21.07.29.png)
2. Open the blog that contains the deleted posts.
3. Click the **Status** filter.
4. Select **Deleted**.
5. Select the **checkboxes** next to the posts you want to restore.
6. Click **Bulk Action**.
7. Select **Restore blog posts**.
8. **Confirm** the restore action.
9. Selected posts return to the main blog post list with their previous draft or published states.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/G9ZWN9Kajvmxa3DyyE6g+/GIF+Recording+2026-05-14+at+21.12.12.gif)

### **Permanently Delete Blog Posts**

```
Note: Permanently deleted posts cannot be restored. Only use this option when the content is no longer needed.
```

1. Navigate to **Sites** > **Blogs**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/CaktdH4pYMYmXow5UDqG+/Screen+Shot+2026-05-14+at+21.07.29.png)
2. Open the blog that contains the deleted posts.
3. Click the **Status** filter.
4. Select **Deleted**.
5. Select the post or posts you want to permanently remove.
6. Click **Bulk Action** or open the post action menu.
7. Select **Delete permanently**.
8. **Confirm** the permanent delete action.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/QzhsMIfihmhukIXKtPR3+/GIF+Recording+2026-05-14+at+21.14.41.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How long can I restore a deleted blog post?**  
Deleted blog posts can be restored for up to 30 days. After 30 days, they are permanently removed from the system.

**Q: What happens when I restore a deleted blog post?**  
The post returns to the main blog post list with its previous draft or published state intact.

**Q: Does restoring a blog post automatically publish it?**  
No. Restoring a post keeps its prior status. A draft returns as a draft, and a published post returns as published.

**Q: Can I restore multiple deleted posts at the same time?**  
Yes. Use the Deleted filter, select the posts you want to recover, then choose Restore blog posts from the Bulk Action menu.

**Q: Can permanently deleted posts be restored?**  
No. Once a blog post is permanently deleted, it cannot be restored.

**Q: Does this recovery flow include version history?**  
No. Version history is not included in this release.

**Q: Where do I find deleted blog posts?**  
Deleted blog posts are available in the Blog Dashboard by selecting Deleted from the Status filter.

**Q: Do I need support to restore deleted blog posts?**  
No. Deleted Blog Post Recovery is self-serve and available directly from the Blog Dashboard.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Blog and Blog Post Statuses](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002454-blog-and-blog-post-statuses)
- [Getting Started with Blogs and Blog Posts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001220286-getting-started-with-blogs-and-blog-posts)
- [Create Blog Posts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002450-create-blog-posts)
- [How to Create a Blog?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002448-how-to-create-a-blog-)
- [Canonical URLs Explained: Boost Your HighLevel Blog SEO](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002451-canonical-urls-explained-boost-your-highlevel-blog-seo)

title_en: How to Set Up and Manage Ask AI Connectors on Mobile
source_md:
Ask AI Connectors let you connect third-party applications directly to Ask AI from the HighLevel mobile app. You can manage connected accounts, control which tools Ask AI can use, and add custom MCP servers without accessing a computer. Connections stay synchronized between mobile and web.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Ask AI Connectors on Mobile?](#What-Are-Ask-AI-Connectors-on-Mobile?)
- [Key Benefits of Ask AI Connectors](#Key-Benefits-of-Ask-AI-Connectors)
- [Connected and Browse Tabs](#Connected-and-Browse-Tabs)
- [Connector Accounts and Tool Permissions](#Connector-Accounts-and-Tool-Permissions)
- [Custom MCP Servers](#Custom-MCP-Servers)
- [How to Set Up Ask AI Connectors on Mobile](#How-to-Set-Up-Ask-AI-Connectors-on-Mobile)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Are Ask AI Connectors on Mobile?**

Ask AI Connectors allow Ask AI to interact with supported external applications using Model Context Protocol (MCP). You can connect apps, manage accounts, and select the tools Ask AI can use directly from your mobile device. 

Connectors are available in HighLevel, LeadConnector, and white-label mobile apps running **version 4.27.0 or later**, for users with Ask AI access.

---

## **Key Benefits of Ask AI Connectors**

Mobile Connectors make it easier to manage integrations while working away from your desk, without sacrificing control over connected accounts and permissions.

- **Connect Anywhere:** Add and manage third-party applications directly from your phone.
- **Control Permissions:** Choose which tools Ask AI can access for each application.
- **Reconnect Easily:** Restore expired connections without using a computer.
- **Stay Synchronized:** Access the same connections across mobile and web.
- **Maintain Privacy:** Connected accounts remain private to the user who connected them.
- **Use Custom Integrations:** Add compatible MCP servers to extend Ask AI's capabilities.

---

## **Connected and Browse Tabs**

The Connectors screen provides two tabs to help you manage existing integrations and discover new applications.

- **Connected:** Displays connected applications, the number of linked accounts, and enabled tools.
- **Browse:** Allows you to search for available applications and connect them to Ask AI.

---

## **Connector Accounts and Tool Permissions**

Each connector provides tools that determine which actions Ask AI can perform in the connected application. Selecting only the tools you need helps maintain control over the integration.

- Connect one or more supported accounts to an application.
- Select individual tools or use **Select all**.
- Keep the **Connector enabled** toggle turned on.
- Tap **Save** to apply your changes.

**Important:**

- A connector requires at least one connected account and one selected tool to be enabled.
- Tool selections apply to the application, regardless of which connected account is used.
- Connected accounts are private and cannot be viewed by other users in the same sub-account.

---

## **Custom MCP Servers**

Custom MCP servers allow you to connect compatible external services that may not appear in the connector catalog. They extend the tools and integrations available to Ask AI. To configure a custom server, provide:

- **Server Name:** A recognizable name for the connection.
- **Server URL:** A URL beginning with `https://` or `http://`.
- **Authentication Details:** Client ID and Client Secret, when required.
- **Redirect URL:** A copyable URL for services that require it.

```
Important: Deleting a custom MCP server also permanently removes all accounts connected through it.
```

---

## **How to Set Up Ask AI Connectors on Mobile**

Setting up a connector involves selecting an application, authenticating your account, and enabling the tools Ask AI can use.

1. Open the HighLevel mobile app and navigate to **Ask AI**.
2. Tap the **Chat history** icon in the upper-right corner.
3. Tap **Customize → Connectors**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084739663/original/b1iWHu9CoYXq92vkgUrKIw6sKLWj8q824g.png?1793622769)
4. Open the **Browse** tab and select an application.
5. Tap **Connect** and complete authentication.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084745065/original/X93S6ZyTZUhWOnG-YluWegcE5SUuySEDiw.png?1793625813)
6. Select your connected account and choose the tools Ask AI can use.
7. Ensure **Connector enabled** is turned on.
8. Tap **Save** to complete the setup.

Once connected, return to Ask AI and submit a request using the application's supported tools.

```
Important Notes:
  
• Connectors are configured at the sub-account level.  
  
• Tapping Back without saving discards changes without a warning.  
  
• Some applications require authentication through a secure in-app browser.  
  
• Connector changes synchronize between mobile and web.  
  
• Ask AI Skills are available on web but are not included in mobile Customize in version 4.27.0.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why can't I see Connectors on mobile?**

A: Ensure your app is updated to version 4.27.0 or later, you have Ask AI access, and you are working within a sub-account.

**Q: Can I connect multiple accounts to one application?**

A: Yes, where supported. However, the selected tools apply to the application rather than individual accounts.

**Q: Can other users see my connected accounts?**

A: No. Connected accounts are private to the user who configured them.

**Q: What happens if my connection expires?**

A: Open the connector and complete the available reconnection or authentication process.

**Q: Can I manage Connectors while offline?**

A: You can view the last loaded list, but it cannot refresh. Once online, tap **Try again**.

**Q: Are Connectors synchronized between mobile and web?**

A: Yes. Applications connected on either platform are available on the other.

**Q: What happens when I delete a custom MCP server?**

A: All accounts connected through that server are permanently removed.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Ask AI Skills and Connectors](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008434)
- [Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005327)
- [New MCP Connectors](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008709-new-mcp-connectors)
- [HighLevel Mobile App Experience](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008398)
