title_en: SaaS Configurator - Modify Plan Category and Plan Level
source_md:
Quickly reorganize your HighLevel SaaS offers (without deleting live plans). This guide shows you how to move a plan to a new category and reposition its upgrade-path.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Modify SaaS Plan Category and Plan Level?](#What-is-Modify-SaaS-Plan-Category-and-Plan-Level?)
  - [Key Benefits of Modifying SaaS Plan Category and Plan Level](#Key-Benefits-of-Modifying-SaaS-Plan-Category-and-Plan-Level)
  - [Move Plans Across Categories](#Move-Plans-Across-Categories)
  - [Change Plan Level within Category](#Change-Plan-Level-within-Category)
  - [How To Modify Plan Category or Level](#How-To-Modify-Plan-Category-or-Level)
    - [Move categories:](#Move-categories%3A)
    - [Change level order:](#Change-level-order%3A)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Modify Plan Category and Plan Level in SaaS Configurator?**

Agencies can edit an existing SaaS plan’s category (pricing group) and its level (order in the upgrade/downgrade path). Instead of recreating plans from scratch, you can shift a plan to a different category **that uses the same currency**, or drag it higher or lower inside a category, to redefine how customers upgrade or downgrade.

---

## **Key Benefits of Modifying SaaS Plan Category and Plan Level**

- Protect live subscriptions – reorganize plans without forcing customers onto new products.
- Faster pricing experiments – reorder plans to test new “good / better / best” structures in minutes.
- Seamless upgrade paths – new hierarchy automatically appears when clients choose to upgrade or downgrade.
- Future-proof for multi-brand – plan mobility lays the groundwork for moving clients across brands in upcoming releases.

---

## **Move Plans Across Categories**

Reassign a plan to any other category **that uses the same currency** so you can group offers more logically or launch seasonal bundles. The plan keeps all of its current subscribers; only future upgrade/downgrade options change.

---

## **Change Plan Level within Category**

Drag-and-drop (or use the level selector) to reposition the plan’s order in its category. **Higher-level plans inherit** features from every level beneath them, so shifting a plan upward or downward changes what’s included at each tier going forward. Existing subscribers keep their current entitlements.

---

## **How To Modify Plan Category or Level**

Navigate to Agency View ▶ SaaS Configurator. Locate the plan you want to edit and **click Edit**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055038313/original/m7YbA3OcxyxDr_x-fBNJyeyCZgKyK_WHJg.png?1759363013)

### **Move categories:**

1. Open the Category dropdown.
2. Select a category with the same currency. (If no categories appear, create one in that currency first.)
3. Click Save.

### **Change level order:**

1. In the Plan Level field, choose the new position number or drag the plan to the desired spot in the list.
2. Confirm the on-screen summary of feature inheritance.

**Publish changes**. New upgrade/downgrade paths are live immediately for all plans in the affected categories.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055038316/original/f4obGgD0z0XO91Tmrz5nb8113oelR_d0MQ.png?1759363050)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will existing customers automatically gain or lose features after I move a plan?**

A: No. They keep their current subscription. Only future upgrades/downgrades use the new hierarchy.

**Q: Can I move a plan to a category with a different currency?**

A: Not at this time. The destination category must use the same currency as the plan. (ideas.gohighlevel.com)

**Q: How many times can I reorder a plan?**

A: Unlimited—plan level can be adjusted whenever your pricing strategy changes.

**Q: Does moving a plan affect active Stripe subscriptions?**

A: Stripe product IDs stay the same, so billing continues uninterrupted. Only the plan’s position inside HighLevel changes.

**Q: What happens to inherited add-ons or rebilling products?**

A: Add-ons remain attached to the plan. Higher-level plans inherit them if they sit above the moved plan after reordering.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [SaaS: Reselling Add-Ons with SaaS Plans](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004175)
- [SaaS Mode – Full Setup Guide + FAQ](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001184920)
- [How to Modify SaaS Plan Category and Plan Level](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006420)

title_en: New Agency-Level Control for Email SMTP Services
source_md:
Email · What's New

New: Agency-Level Control Over Email Services

Centrally manage whether sub-accounts can add their own Email Services, with per-account overrides when needed.

Overview

We've introduced a new agency-level setting that gives you centralized control over Email Services across all your sub-accounts. This update improves governance, simplifies management, and makes email configuration easier to find and oversee from one place.

## What's New

A new toggle has been added under:

Agency View → Settings → Email Services → Advanced Settings

This toggle controls whether the **"Add Email Service"** button is visible and available within sub-accounts. Agencies can now enable or disable access to Email Services for sub-accounts directly from this centralized setting — no need to manage it account by account.

![The new Email Services control toggle under Agency Settings](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068522287/original/8ZjFa-LPCS3Ai6g3Ah2Ngy4sBZFrfgV0rw.png?1775474506)

## How It Works

![How the Email Services toggle affects sub-account visibility](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068522663/original/gm7UVMVnu2CbV_cxztCqe-qjKKdxA1dGdQ.png?1775474898)

For New Agencies

- The Email Services control toggle is **enabled by default**
- The **"Add Services"** button will be **hidden** in sub-accounts
- Sub-account access to Email Services is governed entirely by the agency-level setting

For Existing Agencies

- The Email Services control toggle is **disabled by default**
- The **"Add Services"** button **remains visible** in sub-accounts, preserving your current workflow
- No disruption to any sub-accounts already using Email Services

Good to Know

**No action is required** for existing sub-accounts that are already set up with Email Services. Their configurations will continue to work as expected.

## Managing Email Services for a Specific Sub-Account

If you want to enable or disable the "Add Email Service" button for an individual sub-account rather than applying the setting globally, you can do so at the sub-account level:

Step 1

Go to **Agency View → Sub-Accounts**.

Step 2

Select the sub-account you want to configure.

Step 3

Navigate to **Advanced Settings** and find the option to disable the "Add Email Service" button in the sub-account's Email Service settings.

Step 4

Toggle the setting on or off based on your preference for that sub-account.

![Toggling the Add Email Service button for an individual sub-account](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068523675/original/rpCTjGSQFOHGCKZAiIP6q93kcOtVotiJuA.png?1775476100)

This allows you to fine-tune access for specific sub-accounts, overriding the global agency-level setting where needed.

## Key Benefits

**Centralized Governance** — manage Email Services availability across all sub-accounts from a single agency-level toggle, rather than handling it individually per account.

**Better Discoverability** — all email-related controls are now organized under Email Services in Agency Settings, making it easier to find and manage configurations in one place.

**Flexible Overrides** — sub-accounts can still respect and, where applicable, override the agency-level configuration to accommodate unique needs.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Will this affect my existing sub-accounts that are already using Email Services?

No. Existing sub-accounts with Email Services already configured are not affected. This change only governs the visibility of the "Add Services" button going forward.

Q: I'm an existing agency. Do I need to do anything?

No action is required. The toggle defaults to disabled for existing agencies, so your current setup remains unchanged.

Q: Can sub-accounts still manage their own Email Services settings?

Yes. Sub-accounts can still respect and override the agency-level configuration where applicable.

Q: Where do I find this new setting?

Navigate to **Agency View → Settings → Email Services → Advanced Settings** to find the new toggle.

Q: Does this setting apply retroactively to sub-accounts created before the update?

For existing agencies, the toggle defaults to disabled, so past sub-account behavior is preserved. You can still apply the setting going forward, either agency-wide or per sub-account.

Q: Can I re-enable the "Add Email Service" button later if I disable it?

Yes. The toggle can be switched back on at any time, either at the agency level or for an individual sub-account.

title_en: Courses - Embed Media from Third-Party Platforms
source_md:
Third-party media embedding lets you add externally hosted video or audio directly to a HighLevel course lesson using an iframe embed code. This article shows you how to embed supported video and audio platforms in course lessons, including the required steps and best practices.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Third-Party Media Embedding in Courses?](#What-is-Third-Party-Media-Embedding-in-Courses?)
- [Supported Platforms](#Supported-Platforms)
- [How to Embed Media from a Third-Party Platform](#How-to-Embed-Media-from-a-Third-Party-Platform)
- [Copyright & Usage Compliance](#Copyright-&-Usage-Compliance)
- [Best Practices](#Best-Practices)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Third-Party Media Embedding in Courses?**

Third-party media embedding lets you add externally hosted video or audio directly to a HighLevel course lesson using an iframe embed code. This allows learners to view supported media within the lesson without requiring you to upload the media file to HighLevel.

You can embed **videos, podcasts, demos, and audio** from supported third-party platforms directly into your course lessons.

---

## **Supported Platforms**

We currently support media embedding from:

**For Video:**

- YouTube
- Vimeo
- Loom

**For Audio:**

- SoundCloud
- Wistia
- Spotify
- Mixcloud

You can use iframe embed code from these platforms.

---

## **How to Embed Media from a Third-Party Platform**

Adding the embed code to the lesson media area allows HighLevel to display the externally hosted media directly within the course lesson.

1. Go to **Memberships > Courses > Products.**  
     
   **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/A7WHVC6w3l9bcV00Qyl4+/Screenshot+2026-09-01+at+20.41.15.png)**
2. **Open** the **course** you want to edit.
3. **Open** the **lesson/module** where you want to add the media.
4. In **Lesson Media or Description**, select **Embed Media**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/zb03QtrUa3qpGpu4hr7l+/GIF+Recording+2026-09-01+at+20.44.08.gif)
5. Copy the iframe embed code from the supported third-party platform.

   **YouTube example:**

   - Open the YouTube video.
   - Click **Share**.
   - Select **Embed**.
   - Copy the iframe code.  
       
     ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/TeekGpZfye0qdK4DFi2U+/GIF+Recording+2026-09-01+at+20.51.52.gif)
6. Return to the course and paste the iframe code into the **Embed Media** field.
7. Click **Embed**.
8. Confirm that the media appears correctly in the lesson.
9. **Save** and **publish** your lesson as needed.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/OUZQcblM8CIHZTj41Hwx+/GIF+Recording+2026-09-01+at+20.53.42.gif)

---

## **Copyright & Usage Compliance**

```
Reminder: You are responsible for ensuring you have the right to embed third-party content.
```

**Before embedding, confirm:**

- The content is public or has permission for sharing.
- You have the legal right to display the content.
- You are complying with the source platform’s terms of service and usage guidelines.
- Do not embed content that’s private, licensed without permission, or marked as non-shareable.

---

## **Best Practices**

- Always test your post using the **preview** feature to ensure embeds load correctly.
- Avoid shortened or redirected links; use **official embed codes**.
- Educate your team on content licensing to avoid violations.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I embed media from any third-party platform?**  
No. Use iframe embed code from one of the supported video or audio platforms listed above.

**Q: Do I need to upload the video or audio file to HighLevel first?**  
No. The media remains hosted on the third-party platform and is displayed in the lesson through its iframe embed code.

**Q: Where do I get the iframe embed code?**  
The process varies by platform. Look for the platform's sharing or embedding options. For example, YouTube provides the code under **Share > Embed**.

**Q: What should I do if the embedded media does not display correctly?**  
Confirm that you copied the official iframe embed code from a supported platform and that the source media can be shared publicly.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Import Content from Another Course](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007816)
- [Courses - Import from Media Storage](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007395)
- [Getting Started - Launch a Course](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005072)

title_en: Agency App Reselling Config API
source_md:
Easily surface your agency’s marked-up app prices inside custom plan cards, paywalls, or checkout flows using the new Agency App Reselling Config API. By pulling the exact rebilling configuration HighLevel stores for each sub-account, you guarantee that clients always see the right, white-labeled price—no matter where you sell.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Agency App Reselling Config API?](#What-is-the-Agency-App-Reselling-Config-API?)
- [Key Benefits of the Agency App Reselling Config API](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Agency-App-Reselling-Config-API)
- [Authentication Requirements](#Authentication-Requirements)
- [Key points](#Key-points)
- [Response Objects & Pricing Types](#Response-Objects-&-Pricing-Types)
- [Best Practices for Displaying Prices](#Best-Practices-for-Displaying-Prices)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What is the Agency App Reselling Config API?**

The Agency App Reselling Config API (technically the Get Rebilling Config for App endpoint) is a Marketplace‐developer REST endpoint that returns the final, client-facing prices an agency has set for a specific app. When called with a sub-account OAuth token, the API responds with every active subscription, one-time, and usage-based rate so you can render prices that match the Marketplace and the Agency’s internal billing rules.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060766936/original/X2hgGWeK5Y-K7B6RHJ5z1TLVbZO6FkL51Q.png?1765918492)

---

## **Key Benefits of the Agency App Reselling Config API**

- Prevents price mismatches between your custom UI and HighLevel’s native Marketplace.
- Protects internal cost prices—only the agency’s upsell price is returned.
- Supports every billing model (subscription, one-time, usage-based) in a single call.
- Keeps checkout flows white-labeled; sub-accounts never see HighLevel branding.
- Simplifies maintenance—no more hard-coding plan IDs or mark-ups.

---

## **Authentication Requirements**

A valid sub-account (location) access token is required because pricing can vary by agency and by client. Calling the endpoint with an agency or developer token will return 403 Forbidden.

---

## **Key points**

- OAuth-2.0 Authorization Code or Refresh-Token flow.
- The token scope must include [marketplace.app.read.](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/get-rebilling-config-for-app/index.html)
- Rate-limit: 60 requests/min per app (subject to change).

---

## **Response Objects & Pricing Types**

The JSON response is namespaced under subscriptionPlans, oneTimePlans, and usageMeters—each array containing planId, planName, currency, price, and billingInterval. These fields let you build dynamic UI elements such as:

- Monthly/annual toggle buttons (use billingInterval).
- Usage tiers charts (use included units and overage rate).
- Limited-time offers (use planName or metadata tags).

---

## **Best Practices for Displaying Prices**

Build trust and reduce cart abandonment by:

- Refreshing prices in real time when a user changes plan quantity or billing cycle.
- Caching the response for 5–10 minutes to minimise API calls without showing stale data.
- Clearly labelling currency and billing interval to avoid ambiguity.
- Using agency colours and typography to keep the experience fully white-labeled.
- Testing edge cases where the agency removes a plan or sets price to 0.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does the API return prices in the agency’s default currency?**

Yes. Each object includes a currency field so you can display the correct symbol.

**Q: What happens if the agency has not enabled rebilling for a sub-account?**

The endpoint still responds, but price values equal the base Marketplace cost (no markup).

**Q: How often should I refresh prices?**

Best practice is on page load and whenever the client changes plan options, with server-side caching of 5–10 minutes to respect rate limits.

**Q: Can I call this API with an agency-level token?**

No. You must use a sub-account token; agency tokens will receive 403 Forbidden. ([marketplace.gohighlevel.com](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/get-rebilling-config-for-app/index.html))

**Q: Does the response include coupon or promotional discounts?**

Not at this time. You’ll need to compute and display discounts in your own logic.

**Q: Is the endpoint rate-limited?**

Yes—currently 60 requests per minute per app (subject to change). Return 429 means you exceeded the limit.

title_en: Web Widget Marketplace for Funnels and Websites Builder
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/NfukdHZcYM8?&wmode=opaque)

We’re excited to share a new feature that makes it easier for you to customize your online funnels, websites, stores, and blogs. Our new Web Widget Marketplace lets you find, install, and use small add-ons called “widgets” to make your website more engaging and unique. These widgets are created by other developers and can be quickly added to your pages to make them more interactive, useful, and eye-catching.

What Is the Web Widget Marketplace?  
  
The Web Widget Marketplace is like an app store but for small website add-ons, or “widgets.” Widgets are tools you can add to your Funnel/Website page, like Pricing Cards to display pricing details, Banners for announcements, and other interactive items. By adding widgets, you can make your site more engaging, boost conversions, and improve your visitors’ experience—all without needing advanced coding skills.

Real-World Example:

Imagine you have an online store and want to display a special discount. You can add a Banner widget to your homepage to announce the offer. If you run a blog, you could use an Email Signup widget to grow your subscriber list. These small changes can make a big difference in how visitors interact with your site.

Why Did We Build This Feature?

Many people want easy-to-use tools that don’t require hiring a developer or learning to code. The Web Widget Marketplace was designed to give you this flexibility, allowing you to quickly find and add the right widgets for your site. With these widgets, you can now personalize your website with just a few clicks to better fit your brand and goals.

How to Use the Web Widgets Marketplace

Using the Web Widget Marketplace is simple, and you don’t need to be a tech whiz. Here’s a quick step-by-step guide to get you started:

Step 1: Access the Marketplace

    •    Go to your funnel or website builder.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036534878/original/k9T2Au89yFBgFoD0PF23xv8w8wsqr2o4Hg.png?1731567830)

    •    Open the Widget Marketplace tab.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036534753/original/IIjkdDacb50j11-sXghgdKhBKjZU1_HM5A.png?1731567693)

Step 2: Browse the Widgets

    •    Scroll through the available widgets or use the search bar to find something specific.

    •    You might find Countdown Timers for time-limited sales, Testimonials to build trust, or Product Grids for easy browsing of your items.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036534714/original/w28E9S1xwobuJ0aydGy0rsjqQKVrS-pp2Q.png?1731567646)

Step 3: Install the Widget

    •    When you find a widget you like, click Install. The widget will now be available in your Installed Apps section.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036534695/original/CcaFFHIcqYh__uCE4cXLuctJxWV0-VZ3hw.png?1731567619)

Step 4: Drag and Drop onto Your Page

    •    Drag the widget from the Installed Apps section and drop it into the part of the page where you want it.

    •    Position it wherever you think it will have the most impact.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036538106/original/aWluSQIiyyFJ_crTuzHrZKy6o8ZEVtGVyw.gif?1731570953)

Step 5: Customize Settings

    •    Click on the widget to adjust its settings. You can change things like margins, padding, or visibility.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036534597/original/BvTtZx4lkXwPvbq0uD48QaXU-1ujVAWJaA.png?1731567492)

Example Scenario:

Let’s say you’re running a fitness coaching website and want to offer a limited-time free trial. With the Countdown Timer widget, you could add a timer to your homepage that shows when the offer expires, creating a sense of urgency. Or if you want to show customer reviews to build trust, you could add a Testimonials widget.

By using the Web Widget Marketplace, you can quickly set up these engaging elements and help drive more actions from visitors—whether that’s clicking a “Sign Up” button, reading more blog posts, or making a purchase.

Summing It Up

title_en: Timesheets in Field Services
source_md:
Know how long work really takes. Timesheets let your staff track hours against each visit, so you can see labor time per visit and per person, with an audit trail for every change. This article explains how timers and time entries work and who can edit them.

```
Note: Field Services is currently in private beta and is available to selected accounts.
```

## In this article

- [What are timesheets?](#what)
- [How to turn on timesheets](#on)
- [How timers work](#timers)
- [Add, edit and delete time entries](#entries)
- [Who can edit time entries?](#who)
- [Frequently asked questions](#faq)
- [Related articles](#related)

---

## What are timesheets?

Timesheets track the hours your staff work on each visit. Each time a staff member starts and stops a timer, Field Services saves a **time entry**. Entries add up per visit and per staff member so you can see how long work really took.

![Timesheets page](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084171902/original/jvNDs4b_gfL6v__shr-g3Warj2rGlaYqoQ.jpg)

---

## How to turn on timesheets

1. Go to **Field Services > Field Services Settings > Global settings**.
2. Under **Operations**, click **Preferences and features**.
3. Turn on **Timesheets** (Let your staff log hours against jobs and visits).
4. Click **Save changes**.

![Preferences and features settings](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084162911/original/mK2qkMHJbWGd3l0DRaflvF55lPVgVXGA9w.jpg?1792999584)

See [Field Services Settings: Jobs, Visits and Preferences](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009386) for the other settings on this page.

---

## How timers work

- A staff member can start a timer on a visit. Each start and stop creates a separate time entry, so one visit can have several entries.
- A staff member can have more than one timer running at the same time, for example on two different visits.
- On a visit with several staff, each person has their own timer. Starting yours does not start anyone else's.
- Timers keep running if you change the visit status, for example from Checked in to Waiting on parts, until you stop them.
- If you mark a visit **Completed**, **Cancelled** or **No show** while a timer is running, you see a warning so the timer is not lost.
- The same timer shows on web and mobile. If you start a timer in one place and open the visit in another, the timer shows as running with the correct time.

See [Visit Statuses in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009378) for visit statuses.

---

## Add, edit and delete time entries

You can correct time without losing the history.

| Action | How it works |
| --- | --- |
| **Add manually** | Choose the visit, the staff member and the start and end time. The duration is calculated for you. The end time must be after the start time. |
| **Edit** | Change the start or end time of an entry. The visit and timesheet totals update straight away. |
| **Delete** | Remove an entry. Totals are recalculated. |
| **Overnight entries** | An entry that runs past midnight, such as 11:30 PM to 12:30 AM, is counted as one hour. |

Every manual change is recorded in an **audit history** that shows the old and new values and who made the change.

---

## Who can edit time entries?

- Staff can add, edit and delete their own entries, if permitted.
- Staff cannot edit another person's entries.
- Admins can add, edit and delete entries for any staff member.

---

## Frequently asked questions

**Where do I see total time for a visit?**  
The visit shows time per staff member and the total labor time across everyone.

**Are completed visits still editable?**  
Historical time on completed visits stays visible and can be edited based on the person's permissions.

**Do timers work for visits scheduled in the past?**  
Timers are not available for visits that already happened. You can still add a time entry manually.

---

## Related articles

- [Visit Statuses in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009378)
- [Scheduling Visits and Finding Availability in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009377)
- [Field Services Settings: Jobs, Visits and Preferences](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009386)
- [Staff in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009372)

title_en: Guide to Changing Agency System Email Templates
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/GQoNOK74-PI?&wmode=opaque)

To help you maintain a cohesive brand experience, we’ve introduced a feature that lets you easily customize system email templates within your agency account. Now, you can tailor Welcome, Password Reset, and Verification emails to match your brand’s identity.

This guide covers everything you need to know about changing system email templates in your agency account.

---

### **What All Can Be Done?**

- **Customizable Templates**: Modify Welcome, Password Reset, and Verification emails to better reflect your brand language.
- **Logo and CTA Color Updates**: Easily update your logo and customize CTA (Call-to-Action) button colors in all three email templates.
- **Easy Access and Management**: Manage email templates directly from your Agency Settings

---

## **How to Use It?**

### 

### **Step 1:** Access System Email Settings

1. **Go to Agency Settings**: In your dashboard, navigate to **Agency Settings**.
2. Select **System Emails** under the Settings section. This is where you’ll find all the system email templates available for customization.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040877282/original/or6WsiS6vwFHGWduGLD6nW8WWm9_zF6xog.png?1738563214)

### **Step 2:** Modify an Existing Template

1. Find the email template you wish to change (e.g., Welcome Email, Password Reset Email, Verification Email).
2. **Click on "Change Template"** next to the email you want to edit.
3. **Select Subaccount**: Choose the Subaccount you wish to apply the changes to.
4. **Choose Template Path**: Select the folder where the template is stored.
5. **Choose the Template**: Click on the template you want to edit and select **Change** to start modifying it.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040877368/original/y2zAjg016h-LeVMx9S57nnu17CvCJ-IJgg.png?1738563300)

### **Template validation and Automatic Fallback**

 

If the system detects an error in the selected or customized System Email template that would prevent the email from sending, HighLevel automatically sends the email using the default system template instead.

 

**What to Expect:**

 

- The email still sends (delivery does not fail because of a broken template).
- The default system template is used only when the selected template contains send-blocking errors.
- Fix the selected template to restore your customized content on future sends.

 

```
Tip: If your branding or merge fields do not appear as expected in a System Email, review the selected template for invalid or unsupported fields.
```

  

### **Step 3:** Create a New Template (Optional)

1. Navigate to **Email Marketing** > **Templates**.
2. Click on **Create New Template with Email Marketing templates**and click on system templates
3. Find your system email and **continue**with it  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040877350/original/9yyf0Uk4SQBu9WACcNFndcC3v_H0S_LtUA.png?1738563271)
4. Design your email as needed, including adding any text, images, or branding elements.

### **Step 4:**Customize the Logo and CTA Colors

1. Within the email template editor, click on **Settings**.
2. Here, you can upload your **brand logo** and adjust the **Call-to-Action button colors** to fit your branding.
3. Save your changes to update the template.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040877378/original/O2BU_8rUCIrnEuclH4Qr44cx3iT5oLeXSg.png?1738563327)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q:****How do I revert changes if I don’t like them?**

If you’d like to undo a change, you can go back to the template editor and either restore a previous version of the template or manually adjust your edits.

**Q:****Can I preview my email changes before sending?**

Yes! You can preview your email changes before applying them using test email or preview feature of email builder

**Q:****If I create a custom template would the settings work?**

If you are using the custom values to add logos or button color from the custom value option we provide in the builder then the settings would work.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040877490/original/pyVOC8mRh5Wf8gUKtfDNVKHGrFA9Ns1amQ.png?1738563440)

title_en: Courses - Import from Media Storage
source_md:
Adding video and audio to course lessons is faster when you can reuse media you’ve already uploaded. With Import from Media Storage, course creators can pull existing audio and video files directly into lessons—without re-uploading or managing duplicates. This article shows how to use the import from media storage feature in HighLevel Courses.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Import from Media Storage Feature in Courses?](#What-is-Import-from-Media-Storage-Feature-in-Courses?)
- [Key Benefits of Import from Media Storage Feature in Courses](#Key-Benefits-of-Import-from-Media-Storage-Feature-in-Courses)
- [How To Import Media from Media Storage into a Course Lesson](#How-To-Import-Media-from-Media-Storage-into-a-Course-Lesson%C2%A0)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Import from Media Storage Feature in Courses?**

Import from Media Storage lets you attach existing audio or video files stored in HighLevel Media Storage to a course lesson. Instead of uploading the same file again, you select it from Media Storage and import it into the lesson.

This approach keeps your content library organized and reduces repetitive work—especially when you reuse the same video or audio across multiple lessons or courses.

---

## **Key Benefits of Import from Media Storage Feature in Courses**

- **No duplicate uploads**: Import existing audio/video instead of uploading the same file multiple times.
- **Faster course building**: Add lesson media in a few clicks using content already in Media Storage.
- **Centralized content management**: Keep course media organized in Media Storage for easier reuse.
- **Cleaner workflows**: Reduce duplicate file versions and simplify media updates across courses.

---

## **How To Import Media from Media Storage into a Course Lesson**

Importing media directly from Media Storage helps you build lessons faster while keeping your media library centralized and reusable.

1. Go to **Memberships** > **Courses > Products**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065595345/original/8GurbWjMl4MAEI78EI3yKRscaYG1lvIM-Q.png?1771941100)
2. **Open** the **course** you want to edit by clicking on it.
3. Navigate to the lesson you want to update.
4. Click to **create** a new lesson or **edit** an existing lesson.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/6Bg2KiruBEo2dVgCeyjd+/GIF+Recording+2026-02-24+at+19.24.24.gif)
5. Click on the **Import from Media Storage**button.
6. Click on the **Click to select from media storage** button to browse your Media Storage library and select the audio/video file you want to use.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/3eYw0OSVaABgmNZBnSmA+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-24+at+19.26.00.png)
7. **Select** the **audio/video file** and click **Insert Media**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/4D9sfLPklAD0JIMjXMYH+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-24+at+19.29.19.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Are images supported?**

No, you can only import audio/video.

**Q: Does importing from Media Storage upload a new copy of the file?**

No. Importing uses the existing audio/video stored in Media Storage so you don’t have to re-upload.

**Q: I don’t see “Import via Media Library” in my lesson. What should I check?**

Confirm you’re in the lesson editor (create/edit) and verify your user role includes access to **Medias** and **Memberships/Courses**.

**Q: Can I reuse the same video in multiple lessons or courses?**

Yes. Importing is designed for reuse. Select the same Media Storage file in as many lessons as needed.

**Q: Will learners see the imported media if the lesson isn’t published?**

Learners only see published content. Save stores your changes; publishing makes them available based on your course visibility settings.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Complete Guide to Media Storage!](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002707)

- [How To Add Disk Space for WordPress Hosting](#How-To-Add-Disk-Space-for-WordPress-Hosting)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Disk Space Add-On for WordPress Hosting?**

The Disk Space Add-On lets you expand WordPress storage on demand in 25 GB increments, no plan upgrade required. This flexibility allows agencies to right-size capacity as sites grow, ensuring uninterrupted performance while maintaining predictable, transparent billing.  
  
**NOTE:**This additional storage is shared across all WordPress sites within the Agency's sub-accounts.

---

## **Key Benefits of Disk Space Add-On**

- **Flexible scaling**: Increase storage in 25 GB blocks exactly when needed.
- **Plan independence**: Expand capacity without upgrading the entire hosting plan.
- **Operational continuity**: Avoid space-related interruptions to uploads, backups, or updates.
- **Centralized management**: Access add-ons and usage from Agency → Reselling → WordPress → Manage.
- **Cost clarity**: Simple pricing at $12/month per 25 GB; add multiple blocks as needed.
- **Control & safety**: Disable unused add-ons when at least 25 GB is free, preventing accidental capacity shortfalls.

---

## **How To Add Disk Space for WordPress Hosting**

Follow these steps to add capacity safely and verify that the additional storage is available before proceeding with large updates or migrations.

1. Login to your **Agency** account.
2. Navigate to **Reselling → WordPress → Manage**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/nL9tI1yAybCgTGFg4v6p+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-27+at+7.46.09+PM.png)
3. Click on the **Add-On**tab.
4. Set the **quantity** of the add on. (1 quantity = 25 GB of additional disk space for $12/month)  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/g0Btw9oLymXF6nB9B2Z2+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-27+at+7.53.55+PM.png)
5. Click on the **Enable** **Add** **On** button.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ZPefodwsIkRCRRdOsXm4+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-27+at+7.55.15+PM.png)
6. Check the confirmation box and click on **Continue**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/6CX133ztELsBs3iHlTvz+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-27+at+7.56.54+PM.png)
7. Your additional disk space and the storage used from that disk space will show in the Add-on page.   
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/WjBiLKhw58CAP30GpzQH+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-27+at+7.59.33+PM.png)
8. To remove unused capacity later, ensure **≥25 GB is unused**, then click on **Disable Add-On.**
9. Select **All or Particular Add-ons** and click on **Disable**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Jy5vKo07GFPKEPOFGThb+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-27+at+8.03.47+PM.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I have to upgrade my plan to get more storage?**

No. You can purchase **25 GB** increments with the Disk Space Add-On and keep your current plan.

**Q: Can I add more than one +25 GB block?**

Yes. Add multiple blocks to scale storage as needed.

**Q: When can I disable an add-on?**

You can disable a block **only when at least 25 GB is unused**. If you’re close to capacity, free up space first.

**Q: How much does it cost?**

**$12/month** per **25 GB** increment. 

**Q: Does this change my site’s plan limits?**

The add-on **expands storage** without requiring a plan upgrade. Other plan limits remain as defined by your selected hosting plan.

---

title_en: How to Use List View in the HighLevel Mobile Calendar
source_md:
# **How to Use List View in the HighLevel Mobile Calendar**

This article will show you how to use the new **List View** in HighLevel’s mobile Calendar module. Designed for fast scanning and clean organization, this view presents your upcoming appointments in a scrollable list—perfect for busy professionals who want clarity without clutter.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is List View in the Mobile Calendar?](#What-is-List-View-in-the-Mobile-Calendar?)
- [Key Benefits of Using List View](#Key-Benefits-of-Using-List-View)
- [How To Switch to List View in the Mobile Calendar](#How-To-Switch-to-List-View-in-the-Mobile-Calendar)
- [Feature Highlight: Perfect for Mobile Planning](#Feature-Highlight%3A-Perfect-for-Mobile-Planning)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is List View in the Mobile Calendar?**

List View is a new calendar display format available in the HighLevel and LeadConnector **mobile apps**. Unlike the traditional grid-based layouts (monthly or weekly), List View displays your calendar events in a **chronologically ordered, scrollable feed**. This setup eliminates visual clutter and allows users to focus on what’s coming up—event by event—especially helpful when using a smaller screen.

## **Key Benefits of Using List View**

**List View is optimized for clarity, speed, and ease-of-use, especially on smaller screens. Here’s why you’ll love it:**

- **Linear Planning**: View events in a straightforward, top-to-bottom list—no calendar grid needed.
- **Mobile-Friendly Display**: Makes the most of limited screen space by minimizing visual distractions.
- **Scroll-Based Navigation**: Browse through your full calendar by simply scrolling—no need to tap between days.
- **Focus-Friendly**: Easily focus on today’s agenda or scroll ahead to prepare for future events.
- **Smooth Toggle Access**: Quickly switch between List View and other views with a single tap.

## 

## **How To Switch to List View in the Mobile Calendar**

**Switching to List View is simple and only takes a few taps, giving you instant access to your full calendar in an easy-to-read format.**

1. **Open the HighLevel mobile app** and go to the **Calendar Module**.

   *Screenshot: Main navigation showing the Calendar icon selected.*
2. **Tap the View Toggle (Grid icon)** in the top-right corner of the calendar screen.

   *Screenshot: Calendar screen with a circle around the Grid icon.*
3. **Select “List View”** from the dropdown menu.

   *Screenshot: Dropdown menu displaying “Monthly View”, “Weekly View”, and “List View”, with List View selected.*
4. Your calendar will now show events in a **vertically stacked list** organized by date and time.

   *Screenshot: Scrolling list of events sorted by day and time, each in its own card or row.*
5. **Scroll down** to browse upcoming events or **scroll up** to view recent activity.
6. To switch back to a grid-based view, simply repeat these steps and select “Monthly View” or “Weekly View”.

## 

## **Feature Highlight: Perfect for Mobile Planning**

**List View is tailor-made for mobile users who want efficiency, visibility, and control in one clean layout.**

On smaller screens, the traditional grid views can feel dense and harder to interpret. With List View, every event is given its own space, and users can move fluidly through their schedule. Whether you’re checking what’s next today or planning out next week, List View simplifies the process and removes friction from your workflow.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is List View available on desktop or only mobile?**

A: List View is currently available in the **mobile version only** (HighLevel and LeadConnector apps). Desktop support may be evaluated in future updates.

**Q: Can I switch back to the monthly calendar view?**

A: Yes! Just tap the same view toggle and choose “Monthly” or “Weekly” to return to the grid layout.

**Q: What types of events are shown in List View?**

A: All types of events—tasks, bookings, appointments—are included in the List View feed.

**Q: Can I filter or search within List View?**

A: Filters are not yet supported in List View, but you can scroll to find your events or use search within the calendar module.

### 

###

# **What is a Prebuilt Mega Menu Header?**

A Prebuilt Mega Menu Header is a ready-made navigation section that can be quickly added to any funnel or website page. These headers feature structured dropdown layouts that are ideal for websites with multiple categories, links, or service areas. They are fully customizable and help users find what they’re looking for more easily.

---

## **Key Benefits of Prebuilt Mega Menu Headers**

Adding a mega menu improves site usability and saves time by eliminating the need to build complex navigation from scratch.

    •    **Ready-to-Use Designs** – Choose from a range of prebuilt templates with professional layouts.

Scroll through the options and choose **“Prebuilt Sections”** from the sidebar menu.

**Q: Can I change the number of columns in the mega menu?**

A: Yes. You can modify the layout using the visual editor to add or remove columns, change widths, or rearrange content blocks.

title_en: Manage Prospect Statuses and Onboarding in Prospecting
source_md:
Prospecting now supports a clearer lead lifecycle. You can mark prospects as Open, Closed Won, or Closed Lost, filter them by status, and move won prospects into onboarding faster. In Agency Prospecting, marking a prospect as Closed Won unlocks Create Sub-Account. This helps agencies track outcomes without relying on spreadsheets or external tools.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Prospect Status Management in Prospecting?](#%E2%80%8BWhat%C2%A0is%C2%A0Prospect%C2%A0Status%C2%A0Management%C2%A0in%C2%A0Prospecting?)
- [Key Benefits of Prospect Status Management in Prospecting](#Key-Benefits-of-Prospect%C2%A0Status%C2%A0Management%C2%A0in%C2%A0Prospecting%E2%80%8B)
- [How to Prospect Status Management in Prospecting](#How-to-%E2%80%8BProspect%C2%A0Status%C2%A0Management%C2%A0in%C2%A0Prospecting)

- [Relevant Article](#Relevant-Article%E2%80%8B)

---

## **What is Prospect Status Management in****Prospecting?**

Prospect status management is a Prospecting feature that helps users track what happens after a lead is generated. Instead of keeping all prospects in one undifferentiated list, users can now update each prospect’s outcome and filter prospects by lifecycle stage.

This feature includes:

- Prospect Statuses: Open, Closed Won, Closed Lost
- Status-based filters
- Create Sub-Account for won prospects in Agency Prospecting
- A Getting Started onboarding card for new Prospecting users

This fills a gap in existing Prospecting coverage, which focuses more on lead generation than post-outreach tracking.

---

## **Key Benefits of Prospect Status Management in Prospecting**

- Track prospect outcomes directly inside Prospecting
- Separate active leads from closed leads
- Identify wins that still need onboarding
- Reduce manual tracking in spreadsheets
- Help new users get started faster with guided onboarding
- Connect prospecting activity to sub-account creation in Agency view

---

## **How to Prospect Status Management in****Prospecting**

### **Update a Prospect’s Status**

1. Open Prospecting.
2. Open the Prospect Card for the record you want to update.
3. Change the status to Open, Closed Won, or Closed Lost.

### **Filter Prospects by Status**

1. Go to your saved prospects list in Prospecting.
2. Open the Status filter.
3. Select one or more of these options:  
   - Open
   - Closed Won
   - Closed Lost

### **Use the Getting Started Card**

1. Open Prospecting as a new user.
2. Review the Getting Started card.
3. Complete key actions such as:  
     
   - Creating your first prospect
   - Generating and sharing reports
   - Sending prospects to CRM
   - Capturing leads
   - Enabling AI discovery

## 

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. What statuses can I assign to a prospect?**You can mark a prospect as Open, Closed Won, or Closed Lost.

**Q. Can I filter prospects by status?**Yes. You can filter by Open, Closed Won, Closed Lost, Sub-Account Created, and Sub-Account Not Created.

What happens when I mark a prospect as Closed Won?  
  
**Q. In Agency Prospecting, marking a prospect as Closed Won makes Create Sub-Account available.****Does this replace categories?**No. Categories and status serve different purposes. Categories organize prospects, while status tracks prospect outcome.  The categorization article is separate and would need a short cross-reference for this distinction.

**Q. Who sees the Getting Started card?**It is intended for users who are new to Prospecting. It hides automatically once users become active or dismiss it enough 

times, based on the release details you provided.

---

title_en: How to Build Recipient Segments in Email Campaigns
source_md:
Marketing • Email • Recipient Segments

How to Build Recipient Segments in Email Campaigns

Recipient Segments let you create dynamic groups of contacts for email campaigns using filters such as tags, contact fields, activity, and engagement. Segments update automatically as contacts meet or stop meeting the selected criteria and can be reused across campaigns.

What You'll Learn

Learn how recipient Segments work, how to build and save a Segment in an email campaign, how AND/OR filtering works, and how Segments differ from Smart Lists.

# What Is a Recipient Segment?

A recipient Segment is a dynamic group of contacts built from filter conditions such as tags, contact fields, email activity, or engagement. Contacts automatically enter or leave the Segment as their data changes.

Saved Segments can be reused when selecting recipients for other email campaigns.

## How to Build a Recipient Segment

Build a recipient Segment while preparing an email campaign to target contacts that match the filter conditions you define.

1. Go to **Marketing → Email → Campaigns**.
2. Create a new campaign or open an existing campaign.
3. In the Email Builder, click **Send or Schedule**.
   ![Email Builder showing the Send or Schedule option](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062565552/original/RJg8GTSM3r1BUWygeEEyEVNoEj_wPSCj6Q.png?1768316252)
4. In the **Recipient (To)** area, select **Build Segments**.
   ![Recipient To area showing Build Segments](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062565596/original/j7Ye4xZ0nh8R8v0hZvgG1BB3trM3jpENyg.png?1768316275)
5. Choose the filters for the Segment. For example:
   - Tag is **Compliant**
   - AND **Pre-Built Segment** is **Contacts Engaged in Last 7 Days**
6. Use **Add Filter** to add additional conditions or **Add OR Filter**to create alternate condition groups.
   ![Segment builder showing filters, AND OR controls, and save options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062565644/original/uB8U7-rq2mgtS4XYrc7jDGFqNm-YgTWQSA.png?1768316299)
7. Click **Save** to reuse the Segment later, or continue to **Review and Send** when preparing the campaign.

## Smart Lists vs. Recipient Segments

Smart Lists and recipient Segments are both dynamic, filter-based groups, but they serve different purposes. Smart Lists are primarily used to organize and work with contacts in the CRM, while recipient Segments are built for selecting audiences in email campaigns.

| Feature | Smart Lists | Recipient Segments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Primary location** | Contacts | Email Campaign Builder |
| **Primary purpose** | Dynamic CRM contact views | Email campaign recipient targeting |
| **Updates automatically** | Yes | Yes |
| **Uses filter criteria** | Yes | Yes |
| **Reusable** | Yes | Yes |
| **Manual contact inclusion** | No; contacts qualify through filters | No; contacts qualify through filters |

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I reuse the same Segment in different email campaigns?

Yes. Saved Segments can be reused across email campaigns.

Q: Are Segments static or automatically updated?

Segments update automatically as contacts meet or stop meeting the configured criteria.

Q: Can I use OR logic in a Segment?

Yes. Use **Add OR Filter** to create alternate groups of conditions alongside your other filters.

Q: What is the difference between a Smart List and a recipient Segment?

Smart Lists are dynamic filtered contact views managed from the Contacts area. Recipient Segments are dynamic audience groups used when selecting recipients for email campaigns.

Q: Can I use a pre-built audience condition inside a custom Segment?

Yes. The Segment builder supports Pre-Built Segment criteria alongside other conditions. For example, you can combine a contact tag with **Contacts Engaged in Last 7 Days**.

Q: Can I manually add or remove contacts from a Segment?

No. Contacts are included or excluded based on the Segment's filter conditions. If you need a manual classification method, use a tag and include that tag as part of your Segment criteria.

title_en: Countdown Timer Placeholder
source_md:
Marketing • Countdown Timers • Email Templates

Countdown Timer Placeholders in Shared Email Templates

When an email template containing a countdown timer is copied to another sub-account, the original timer is replaced with a static placeholder. The copied template must be connected to a countdown timer in the destination sub-account before the timer will work.

What You'll Learn

Learn why countdown timers become placeholders when email templates are copied between sub-accounts, how to copy the template, and how to connect the placeholder to a working timer in the destination sub-account.

# What Is a Countdown Timer Placeholder?

A Countdown Timer Placeholder appears when an email template containing a countdown timer is copied to another sub-account. The placeholder preserves the timer's position in the template but does not function as a countdown until a timer from the destination sub-account is selected.

Countdown Timer placeholders are currently documented for shared email templates.

**Important:** A Countdown Timer Placeholder is not a working timer. Before using the copied email template, select an existing countdown timer from the destination sub-account or create a new one.

## How to Copy an Email Template With a Countdown Timer

Copy the email template normally. The countdown timer will automatically become a placeholder when the template is copied to another sub-account.

1. Go to **Marketing → Emails → Templates**.
2. Create or open an email template that contains a countdown timer.
   ![Email template containing a working countdown timer](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048492527/original/mS0-lZ31j_kEqh4wG-c0tZBaNsJrdDCBJg.png?1750262364)
3. Return to the **Templates** list.
4. Open the template's **three-dot menu** and select **Share**.
   ![Share option for an email template](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082257680/original/MhYfjO5_ZDfC0yJDvZrSNPhCCMSAQtkxjQ.png?1790831281)
5. Configure the sharing permissions and copy the template link.
6. Open the share link and select **Add Template**.
7. Select the destination sub-account, rename the template if needed, and clone the template.

## How to Replace the Countdown Timer Placeholder

The copied template cannot use the original countdown timer automatically. Select a countdown timer available in the destination sub-account before using the email.

1. In the destination sub-account, go to **Marketing → Emails → Templates**.
2. Open the copied email template.
3. Select the **Countdown Timer Placeholder**.
   ![Copied email template showing the Countdown Timer Placeholder selected](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048493171/original/frtmWlkoIc1FybEeVPJfACtoypFkZ-EeoA.png?1750262946)  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082257632/original/x0antuIQaNdYnOlOfLczeeA8imO88Gf9yw.png?1790831186)
4. Choose an existing countdown timer from the destination sub-account
5. If no suitable timer exists, go to **Marketing → Countdown Timers** and create one. Then return to the email template and select the new timer.
6. Save and test the email before using it in a campaign.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why did my countdown timer become a placeholder?

The email template was copied to another sub-account. Countdown timers in copied email templates are replaced with placeholders until a timer from the destination sub-account is selected.

Q: Does the placeholder automatically use the original countdown timer?

No. Select a countdown timer available in the destination sub-account.

Q: What if the destination sub-account does not have a countdown timer?

Create a countdown timer under **Marketing → Countdown Timers**, then return to the copied email template and select it.

Q: Does this placeholder behavior apply to funnels and websites?

Current documentation confirms this placeholder workflow for shared email templates. For funnels and websites, follow the applicable countdown-timer placement instructions.

title_en: Email Blocking for Invalid or Restricted Recipient Domains
source_md:
Email Security

Restricted Domain Blocking for Outbound Emails

A pre-send validation that blocks emails to invalid or restricted recipient domains — protecting your deliverability and reducing security risk.

What You'll Learn

The platform blocks outbound emails before sending when the recipient email domain is invalid or restricted for security reasons. This prevents sends to domains that can increase security risk or lead to failed delivery — keeping your sender reputation safe.

## What Is Restricted Domain Blocking?

Restricted Domain Blocking is a **pre-send validation** that prevents outbound email when a contact's email domain (the part after @) is invalid or restricted. When the block triggers, the platform does not attempt to send the email.

## Key Benefits

**Reduces failed sends** — stops emails that would likely fail delivery anyway.

**Protects deliverability** — fewer hard bounces means less risk to your sender reputation.

**Improves security** — prevents sending to domains restricted for security reasons.

## How It Works

Step 1

Validate the recipient domain

The platform validates the recipient email address domain before attempting to send.

Step 2

Block if invalid or restricted

If the domain is invalid or restricted, the platform blocks the send before it leaves.

Step 3

Email is unusable until updated

The contact's email cannot be used for outbound communications until the address is updated to one on a permitted domain.

![Restricted Domain Blocking validation flow](https://jumpshare.com/share/ipA5rS1VXQct4HANnoqA+/image+%283%29+%282%29.png)

## What You Will See

When an email address is blocked, an inline warning appears under the contact's **Email** field:

Warning Message

"This email address is invalid as the domain is restricted for security reasons."

![Inline warning under the contact's Email field showing the restricted-domain block message](https://jumpshare.com/share/Mm7ljWEF1FhCL3PETxJK+/image+%284%29+%281%29.png)

## How to Resolve

Step 1

Confirm the email address is correct

Check for typos — especially in the domain after the @ symbol.

Step 2

Update the contact with a valid email

Replace the address with a valid email on a permitted domain. Once updated, outbound sends can resume normally.

Step 3

Contact Support if the recipient is business-critical

If this is a recipient domain you genuinely need to reach, raise a Support ticket and include:

- The recipient domain (example: example.com)
- Where you saw the warning (Contact record, Conversations, Campaigns, Workflows, etc.)
- The sub-account name or ID
- The sending method (LC Email, Mailgun, or custom SMTP)

Note

There is no in-app override for the block. The address must be replaced with a permitted one for sending to resume.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I still send to an email address that shows this warning?

No. The platform blocks the send before it leaves the system when the recipient domain is invalid or restricted.

Q: Can I override or bypass the block?

No. You must update the contact with a valid email address on a permitted domain.

Q: Where do I see the warning?

An inline warning appears under the contact's **Email** field whenever a blocked address is loaded or entered.

Q: Does the platform attempt delivery anyway?

No. When this warning appears, no send is attempted — campaigns, workflows, and manual sends to that address are all blocked at the validation step.

Q: How do I prevent this from happening?

Verify recipient email addresses at intake — use form validation, double opt-in, and an email verification service — and proactively correct typos in the domain after @ before attempting to send.

Q: Does this apply to all sending methods?

Yes. The pre-send validation runs regardless of whether you're using LC Email, Mailgun, or a custom SMTP integration.

Q: Do blocked sends count against my bounce rate?

No. Because nothing is ever sent, blocked addresses don't generate a bounce — that's actually one of the protections this feature provides for your sender reputation.

title_en: Show seats per slot for Class booking on the booking widget
source_md:
The “Show seats per slot” setting allows you to display the total remaining seat availability for each time slot on Class Booking calendars. With the updated slot capacity logic, availability now reflects true remaining capacity even when appointments overlap multiple slots.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BOverview)
- [How to Enable “Show Seats Per Slot”](#How-to-Enable-%E2%80%9CShow-Seats-Per-Slot%E2%80%9D)
- [This toggle enables seat display on the public booking widget.](#This-toggle-enables-seat-display-on-the-public-booking-widget.)
- [How Seat Availability Is Calculated (Updated Logic)](#How-Seat-Availability-Is-Calculated-(Updated-Logic))
- [How Seats Appear on the Booking Widget](#How-Seats-Appear-on-the-Booking-Widget)
- [Important Information](#Important-Information)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **Overview**

Class Booking calendars allow multiple attendees to book the same time slot. The **Show seats per slot** option lets you display how many seats remain available for each time slot directly on the booking widget.

This provides:

- Clear visibility of remaining capacity
- Better booking transparency for customers
- Improved scheduling efficiency for high-capacity events

---

## **How to Enable “Show Seats Per Slot”**

To enable seat visibility on your booking widget:

1. Open your Class Booking calendar.
2. Click **Edit**.
3. Navigate to **Customizations**.
4. Under **Calendar Widget Style**, toggle **Show seats per slot**.
5. Click **Save**.

### This toggle enables seat display on the public booking widget.

---

## **How Seat Availability Is Calculated (Updated Logic)**

Seat availability is determined by the **Seats per class** value configured in your calendar settings.

With the updated scheduling logic:

- Each confirmed appointment reduces seat availability by 1.
- If an appointment overlaps multiple slots, only 1 seat is deducted from each affected slot.
- A slot is blocked only when its total seat capacity is fully reached.
- Overlapping appointments no longer fully block all affected slots prematurely.

This ensures more accurate availability and better utilization of high-capacity calendars.

---

## **How Seats Appear on the Booking Widget**

When enabled, the total remaining seats per time slot are displayed directly on the booking widget.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064723901/original/qzsAhmvJsnn32x8qma5F8_AyCB1Vc8h5Ww.png?1770838825)

Customers can view remaining seats before selecting a time slot.

---

## **Important Information**

- This feature is available only for **Class Booking calendars**.
- It requires the **Seats per class** setting to be greater than 1.
- It works with Neo widgets.
- Updated capacity logic applies across:

  - Public booking widget
  - In-app appointment modal
  - Personal calendars
  - Round Robin calendars
  - Event calendars

Slots remain available until their defined capacity limit is reached.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What does “Show seats per slot” do?**

It displays the remaining seat availability for each time slot on Class Booking calendars.

**Q: How is seat availability calculated?**

Each confirmed appointment reduces the slot’s capacity by 1. A slot is blocked only when its defined capacity limit is reached.

**Q: Do overlapping appointments block the entire slot?**

No. Overlapping appointments reduce capacity by 1 per affected slot instead of blocking the slot completely.

**Q: Does this work with recurring class bookings?**

Yes.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Creating Class Booking Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003554)
- [Why Appointment Time Slots Are Missing on Your Calendar](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001181711)
- [Configuring Calendar Widget Style (Classic & Neo)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003552)

##

title_en: Disable Contact Timezone - How to Remove Ability to Adjust Timezones When Scheduling
source_md:
**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Contact Timezone?](#What-is-the-Contact-Timezone?)
- [How to Disable Contact Timezone?](#How-to-Disable-Contact-Timezone?)
- [How to Set Your Business' Timezone (Sub-Account)](#How-to-Set-Your-Business'-Timezone-(Sub-Account))
- [What Contacts Will See When Scheduling](#What-Contacts-Will-See-When-Scheduling)

---

# **What is the Contact Timezone?**

When a contact is scheduling an appointment, they are given the option to select the timezone they reside in so the appointment gets booked for the proper time relative to their schedule.

```
FOR EXAMPLE:
A contact located in New York City schedules an appointment for 5pm with a company located in San Fransisco.  
  
If the contact time zone feature is DISABLED, the appointment will be created for 5pm PST, because that is the time zone in which the HighLevel location resides.  
  
If the contact time zone feature is ENABLED, the appointment would have been created for 5pm EST, since the contact is located in New York, and the business would see an appointment scheduled for 2pm PST.
```

If you want to remove the ability for contacts to adjust the timezone when scheduling appointments, you can turn this feature off and ONLY allow contacts to schedule appointments in the timezone assigned to the HighLevel sub-account.

---

## **How to Disable Contact Timezone?**

Disabling the contact timezone will prevent users from scheduling appointments in time zones other than the business's timezone.

If you have a client whose business is near a timezone border (or maybe the business is in a popular tourist town that receives customers from other time zones), you may want to prevent people from being able to book appointments in their time zones.

To prevent people from being able to book appointments in their time zones, navigate to **Settings > Business Profile**, then scroll down until you see the **"General"** section on the right side of the screen and activate the **"Disable Contact Timezone"** checkbox.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155030185542/original/DgO5KET5wV9we4ObDucJ6JN8nyQqbPLa_A.jpg?1722368528)

```
Click Here To learn more about BUSINESS PROFILE settings
```

---

## **How to Set Your Business' Timezone (****Sub-Account)**

It is very important to have your sub-account's timezone set properly, especially if you are not allowing contacts to adjust the timezone manually when scheduling.

To view and/or adjust your sub-account's timezone, navigate to **Settings > Business Profile** and find the **"Time Zone"** field located on the right side of the screen under the **"Business Physical Address"** options.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155030185645/original/pNMEWsxjngCfxul2zRC9UXhcjrjGQJ9Fmw.jpg?1722368816)

```
Click Here To learn more about BUSINESS PROFILE settings
```

---

## **What Contacts Will See When Scheduling**

The screenshots below are examples of when your calendars will look like depending on whether you have enabled or disabled the Contact Timezone feature.

### **Contact Timezone DISABLED**

With the **"Disable Contact Timezone"** box selected, users will no longer see the time zone dropdown selector in the calendar widget (see screenshot below), and all appointments will be made in whatever time zone is set within the location settings.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155030186366/original/jZ-Jgu1BtPmbg8rscBwSlYD0lnd2gjz7Mw.png?1722370719)

### **Contact Timezone ENABLED (default setting)**

This screenshot shows the default calendar widget with the timezone preference. By default, the contact timezone is enabled, giving your contacts the ability to change the timezone where the appointment is being scheduled.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155030186371/original/3sjZovqDBwEYwt-p7AbqM4Z6LYxzkKnJPw.png?1722370727)

HighLevel's Dashboard Editor makes it easier to customize dashboards, track changes, and collaborate with your team. ## **How To Edit a Dashboard**

### 1. Open the Dashboard Editor

1. From your **Sub-Account**, select **Dashboard**.
2. Select the dashboard you want to edit.
3. Click **Edit dashboard**.
4. Use the widget panel on the left to add or arrange widgets.

---

### 2. Undo Changes or Restore a Previous Version

Use undo/redo for recent changes or version history to restore an earlier dashboard.

1. In the editor, click **Undo** or **Redo** to reverse or reapply a change.
2. To view older versions, click the clock icon (**Version history**).
3. Select a version to preview it.
4. Click **Restore** to use that version.

The current version is labeled **Live**.

### 3. Add Sticky Notes

Sticky notes help your team share reminders and context directly on a dashboard.

3. Drag the note to the desired position.
4. Use the hide-notes control to hide all notes when needed.

Quick Filters help you control which data appears in supported dashboard widgets.

1. Open the dashboard and click **Edit dashboard**.
2. Open the Quick Filters configuration.
3. Add or update your filters.
4. Return to dashboard view mode using the back arrow.

---

### 5. Refresh Dashboard Data

Refresh your dashboard whenever you need updated widget data.

1. Return to dashboard view mode.
2. Hover over the refresh icon to view the last refresh time.
3. ### Click the refresh icon to reload all widgets 6. **Create a Report from a Dashboard**

1. Create a custom report using the widgets already on your dashboard.
2. Open your dashboard in view mode.
3. Click the paper-plane icon (**Send as report**).
4. Select **Create and send**.
5. Your dashboard widgets are copied into a new report under **Reporting → Custom Reports**.
6. Customize, export, send, or schedule the report as needed.

```
Note: The report is a separate copy. Changes to the original dashboard will not automatically update it.
```

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Do I need to save dashboard changes manually?**

No. Dashboard changes save automatically. Look for the **Saved** badge to confirm.

**Q: Can I recover an older dashboard version?**

Yes. Open **Version history** to preview and restore a previous version.

**Q: Can my team see sticky notes?**

Yes. Anyone with access to view the dashboard can see its visible sticky notes.

**Q: Will a custom report update when I change my dashboard?**

No. The report is an independent copy of your dashboard widgets.

title_en: Resolution of Figerprint Issue in Order form on Wordpress
source_md:
If you are facing the fingerprint issue in order form on wordpress. You should be seeing the below error in your order form

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155014402697/original/cP4v-wGDWhkB1EDZBzxOomxLCCr1SCjEVg.png?1701776525)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155014402714/original/meJbprQnM-30iC7DGGjKuXAIcMMyHZ3K5w.png?1701776536)

**As of now, there can be two secnarios of fingerprint error.**

- [Scenario 1](#Scenario-1)
- [Scenario 2](#Scenario-2)
- [Steps to add domain in Funnel:](#Steps-to-add-domain-in-Funnel%3A)
- [Steps to fix existing funnel in WordPress:](#Steps-to-fix-existing-funnel-in-WordPress%3A)

### 

### Scenario 1

- If client faced this issue only on some of the customer's browser. It means due to some customer browser settings, we are not able to access cookies (storage).**Solution:** This is very rare chances of this issue. So for a quick fix, guide customer to update  browser settings & enable cookies access. For a long term fix, we will add warning from our side if we won't able to access cookies

### Scenario 2

- If client faced this issue every time on every devices & browsers, it means funnel domain is not configured properly.**Solution:**If website is hosted on WordPress & they are using our order form funnel inside that as separate path, then WordPress website domain & funnel domain should be same but subdomain should be different. Suppose your WordPress website configured with www.example.com , example.com is your domain & www is subdomain. So now you should not use www.example.com  or example.com  as funnel domain. Use different subdomain (e.g. funnels.example.com ) in funnel.

- **Why need same domain?**

           As per our current implementation, we are using iFrame to render funnel page inside WordPress. For payment,               we need web browser cookies (storage) access & web browser doesn't allow access over cross domain.

### Steps to add domain in Funnel:

1. Go to Settings -> Domains and add the same domain (as WordPress website) with different subdomain. (Make sure there should have not be hosted any other website on that subdomain)
